qe: In whose royal court did the eight celebrated Telugu poets known as 'Ashtadiggajas' reside?
qh: 'अष्टदिग्गज' किस प्रसिद्ध राजा के दरबार में रहते थे?
e: Vijayanagara ke Tuluva dynasty ke famous king Krishnadeva Raya ke court me Telugu literature ke 8 mahan scholars aur poets rehte the, jinhe Ashtadiggajas kaha jata tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 'ashtadiggaj' kis prasiddh raja ke darabar mein rahate the? Isi tathya par Krishnadeva Raya tika hua hai. Vikalp Harihara, Rama Raya, Devaraya I bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Krishnadeva Raya hi milti hai. Exam point: Krishnadeva Raya - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Approximately what percentage of India's population lived in rural villages during the 16th and 17th centuries?
qh: 16वीं-17वीं शताब्दी के दौरान हिंदुस्तान की लगभग कितनी प्रतिशत आबादी गाँवों में रहती थी?
e: Mughal period ke dauran lagbhag 85% population gaon me rehti thi aur directly ya indirectly agriculture par depend karti thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 16vin-17vin shatabdi ke dauran hindustan ki lagabhag kitani pratishat abadi ganvon mein rahati thi? Isliye antim jawab 85% ke roop mein milta hai. 50%, 65%, 75% alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se 85% sahi hai. Exam point: 85% - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which term was predominantly used to designate a peasant in Indo-Persian historical sources of the Mughal period?
qh: मुगल काल में भारतीय-फारसी स्रोतों में किसान के लिए अक्सर किस शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता था?
e: Indo-Persian records me kisan ke liye 'Raiyat' (plural: Riaya) ya 'Muzarian' aur 'Kisan' terms use kiye jaate the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki mugal kal mein bharatiy-pharasi sroton mein kisan ke lie aksar kis shabd ka prayog kiya jata tha? ulema islam ke vidwan tatha dharmik guru the. Isi tathya par Raiyat tika hua hai. Ulema, Amir, Mansabdar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Raiyat sahi hai. Exam point: Raiyat - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In Mughal agrarian society, who were designated as 'Khud-kashta' peasants?
qh: 'खुद-कास्त' (Khud-kashta) किसान किन्हें कहा जाता था?
o: Forest dwellers engaged in shifting cultivation
Peasants who cultivated lands in other villages on contract
Revenue collectors appointed by the crown
Residents who cultivated their own personal lands within their native village
e: Khud-kashta wo resident cultivators the jo usi gaon me rehte the jahan unki apni zameen hoti thi aur wahi kheti karte the. Prashn yah batata hai ki 'khud-kast' (Khud-kashta) kisan kinhein kaha jata tha? Isliye antim jawab Residents who cultivated their own personal lands... ke roop mein milta hai. Forest dwellers engaged in shifting cultivation, Peasants who cultivated lands in other villages on contract, Revenue collectors appointed by the crown anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Residents who cultivated their own personal lands... hi hai. Exam point: Residents who cultivated their own personal lands... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the non-resident peasants who cultivated lands in other villages on a contractual basis called?
qh: वे किसान जो दूसरे गाँवों में ठेके पर खेती करने जाते थे, क्या कहलाते थे?
e: Pahi-kashta nonresident ya migrant peasants the jo revenue concessions ya distress ke chalte doosre gaon jakar contract par kheti karte the. Prashn yah batata hai ki ve kisan jo dusare ganvon mein theke par kheti karane jate the, kya kahalate the? amil lagaan vasoolne wala adhikari tha. Yahi wajah hai ki Pahi-kashta sahi hai. Amil-guzar, Zamindar, Khud-kashta anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Pahi-kashta hai. Exam point: Pahi-kashta - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which comprehensive administrative account of Akbar's reign was authored by his court historian Abul Fazl?
qh: मुगल सम्राट अकबर के दरबारी इतिहासकार अबुल फजल द्वारा लिखित प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ का नाम क्या है?
e: Ain-i-Akbari Akbarnama ka third volume hai jisme Akbar ke administration, army, revenue aur agriculture ka systematic data diya gaya hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki mugal samrat akabar ke darabari itihasakar abul phajal dvara likhit prasiddh granth ka nam kya hai? ain-i-akbari Akbarnama ka hissa thi jismein sasan ke aankde the. In tathyon ke chalte Ain-i-Akbari hi sahi hai. Humayunnama, Baburnama, Amuktamalyada anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Ain-i-Akbari hi milti hai. Exam point: Ain-i-Akbari - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What did the term 'Jins-i-Kamil' denote in the Mughal agricultural revenue administration?
qh: मुगल काल में 'जिन्स-ए-कामिल' (Jins-i-Kamil) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: High-value cash crops yielding superior revenue
e: Jins-i-Kamil ka literal meaning 'perfect crops' tha; ye cotton, sugarcane aur oilseeds jaise cash crops the jinse state ko higher tax milta tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mugal kal mein 'jins-e-kamil' (Jins-i-Kamil) ka kya arth tha? In tathyon ke chalte High-value cash crops yielding superior revenue hi sahi hai. Subsistence rice crops only, Inferior foodgrain crops, Wild uncultivated vegetation is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad High-value cash crops yielding superior revenue hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: High-value cash crops yielding superior revenue - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were the three foundational constituents of the rural community in Mughal India?
qh: मुगल काल में ग्रामीण समुदाय के तीन मुख्य घटक कौन से थे?
o: Cultivators, village panchayat, and village headman
Merchants, urban artisans, and foreign travelers
e: Mughal village community me teen main components the: actual peasants (kisan), village panchayat aur gaon ka headman (Muqaddam/Mandal). Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki mugal kal mein gramin samuday ke tin mukhy ghatak kaun se the? ulema islam ke vidwan tatha dharmik guru the. Isi tathya par Cultivators, village panchayat, and village headman tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - Hereditary zamindars, jagirdars, and emperor, Monarch, army commanders, and ulema, Merchants, urban artisans, and foreign travelers - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Cultivators, village panchayat, and village headman sahi hai. Exam point: Cultivators, village panchayat, and village headman - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What title was given to the village headman who presided over the rural panchayat in Mughal times?
qh: गाँव की पंचायत के मुखिया को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Village panchayat ke chief ko Muqaddam ya Mandal kehte the, jiska election gaon ke elders ki aapsi sehmati se hota tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki ganv ki panchayat ke mukhiya ko kya kaha jata tha? panchayat gaon ke bade logon ki sabha thi jo jhagde tatha niyam ki nigrani karti thi. Isi aadhar par Muqaddam or Mandal chuna jaata hai. Galti Mansabdar, Diwan, Qazi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Muqaddam or Mandal hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Muqaddam or Mandal - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the primary civic responsibility of the village panchayat during the Mughal period?
qh: मुगल काल में 'पंचायत' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Managing community funds, dispensing local justice, and enforcing caste boundaries
Settling foreign immigrants in crown lands
e: Panchayat village welfare fund (kasan) manage karti thi, aapsi disputes settle karti thi aur ensure karti thi ki log caste rules break na karein. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki mugal kal mein 'panchayat' ka mukhy kary kya tha? panchayat gaon ke bade logon ki sabha thi jo jhagde tatha niyam ki nigrani karti thi. Isi aadhar par Managing community funds, dispensing local justice, and enforcing caste boundaries chuna jaata hai. Supervising maize cultivation exclusively, Conducting imperial military campaigns, Settling foreign immigrants in crown lands is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Managing community funds, dispensing local justice, and enforcing caste boundaries hai. Exam point: Managing community funds, dispensing local justice, and enforcing caste boundaries - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In Mughal-era customary property arrangements, what was meant by 'Stridhan'?
qh: मुगलकालीन समाज में महिलाओं की स्थिति के संदर्भ में 'स्त्रीधन' क्या था?
o: Name of a women's village council
Assets and jewelry received by a woman at marriage over which she held ownership
e: Stridhan wo property, cash ya ornaments the jo aurat ko marriage ke waqt gifts ke roop me milte the aur uspe uska exclusive right hota tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mugalakalin samaj mein mahilaon ki sthiti ke sandarbh mein 'stridhan' kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Assets and jewelry received by a woman... sahi nikalta hai. A state land tax, Name of a women's village council, A wooden farming implement in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Assets and jewelry received by a woman at marriage over which she held ownership hi milti hai. Exam point: Assets and jewelry received by a woman... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which crop was introduced into Indian agriculture in the 17th century via Africa and Spain?
qh: किस फसल को भारत में 17वीं सदी में अफ्रीका और स्पेन के रास्ते लाया गया था?
e: Maize (makka) New World se Spain aur Africa hote hue 17th century me India introduce hua aur western parts me major staple bana. Prashn yah batata hai ki kis phasal ko bharat mein 17vin sadi mein aphrika aur spen ke raste laya gaya tha? Isliye antim jawab Maize ke roop mein milta hai. Mustard, Wheat, Rice in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Maize sahi hai. Exam point: Maize - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How were the 'Zamindars' socially and economically positioned in the Mughal Empire?
qh: मुगल काल में 'जमींदार' कौन थे?
o: Peasants who cultivated common village plots
Landed gentry possessing private landholdings and enjoying high social standing
e: Zamindars landed elites the jinki apni personal zameen (milkiyat) hoti thi aur wo state ke behalf par peasants se land revenue collect karte the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mugal kal mein 'jamindar' kaun the? Isi aadhar par Landed gentry possessing private landholdings and enjoying high social standing chuna jaata hai. Peasants who cultivated common village plots, Landless wage laborers, Islamic religious theologians ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Landed gentry possessing private landholdings and enjoying... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Landed gentry possessing private landholdings and enjoying... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In the Mughal land revenue vocabulary, what did the term 'Jama' represent?
qh: मुगल राजस्व प्रणाली में 'जमा' (Jama) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Total assessed revenue amount determined by the state
e: Jama wo total revenue amount thi jo state officials assessment ke baad fix karte the ki itna tax aana chahiye. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki mugal rajasv pranali mein 'jama' (Jama) ka kya arth tha? Isliye antim jawab Total assessed revenue amount determined by the... ke roop mein milta hai. A gold coin denomination, A standard land measurement unit, Actual revenue collected anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Total assessed revenue amount determined by the state hai. Exam point: Total assessed revenue amount determined by the state - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In Mughal fiscal terminology, what was the actual revenue realized and collected called?
qh: मुगल राजस्व प्रणाली में वास्तव में वसूली गई रकम को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Assessed revenue ko 'Jama' kehte the jabki jo amount ground reality me actually collect hoti thi use 'Hasil' kaha jata tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki mugal rajasv pranali mein vastav mein vasuli gai rakam ko kya kaha jata tha? amil lagaan vasoolne wala adhikari tha. Isliye antim jawab Hasil ke roop mein milta hai. Amil-guzar, Jama, Muqaddam is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Hasil hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Hasil - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which imperial revenue official was entrusted with the direct collection of agricultural taxes in a sarkar or pargana?
qh: राजस्व वसूली का काम करने वाले अधिकारी को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Amil-guzar pargana level ka main revenue collection officer tha jiska primary task cultivators se cash ya crop me tax collect karna tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki rajasv vasuli ka kam karane vale adhikari ko kya kaha jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Amil-guzar sahi nikalta hai. Caliph, Patwari, Mansabdar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Amil-guzar hai. Exam point: Amil-guzar - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: The massive influx of bullion via maritime trade during the Mughal era caused which metal's currency to become ubiquitous?
qh: चांदी के बहाव के कारण मुगल काल में किस धातु के रुपयों का प्रचलन बढ़ गया?
e: Global trade ke badhne se Europe se silver India enter hua, jisse Mughal silver rupee currency standard aur widely circulated bana. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki chandi ke bahav ke karan mugal kal mein kis dhatu ke rupayon ka prachalan badh gaya? Isi karan se Silver sahi uttar hai. Gold, Iron, Copper mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Silver hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Silver - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which aspect of administration is detailed in the 'Manzil-abadi' book of the Ain-i-Akbari?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के 'मंजिल-आबादी' (Manzil-abadi) भाग में क्या वर्णित है?
o: The imperial household, palace establishment, and royal maintenance
e: Ain-i-Akbari ka pehla daftaar 'Manzil-abadi' imperial harem, royal mint, kitchen aur royal household management se deal karta hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki ain-e-akabari ke 'manjil-abadi' (Manzil-abadi) bhag mein kya varnit hai? ain-i-akbari Akbarnama ka hissa thi jismein sasan ke aankde the. Isi aadhar par The imperial household, palace establishment, and royal maintenance chuna jaata hai. Provincial military recruitment, Suba-wise agricultural statistics, Philosophical aphorisms of Akbar in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar The imperial household, palace establishment, and royal maintenance hai. Exam point: The imperial household, palace establishment, and royal maintenance - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What subject matter is covered under the 'Sipah-abadi' book of the Ain-i-Akbari?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के 'सिपह-आबादी' (Sipah-abadi) भाग का संबंध किससे है?
o: Military and civil administration, including noble ranks and royal servants
e: Ain-i-Akbari ka second book 'Sipah-abadi' military organization, mansabdars aur civil bureaucratic appointments ko cover karta hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ain-e-akabari ke 'sipah-abadi' (Sipah-abadi) bhag ka sanbandh kisase hai? ain-i-akbari Akbarnama ka hissa thi jismein sasan ke aankde the. Isi baat se Military and civil administration, including noble ranks and royal servants sahi sabit hota hai. Astronomical almanacs, Imperial household budgets, Hindu religious texts is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Military and civil administration, including noble ranks... hi milti hai. Exam point: Military and civil administration, including noble ranks... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the overarching administrative portfolio of the 'Diwan' in the Mughal imperial setup?
qh: मुगल काल में 'दीवान' की मुख्य जिम्मेदारी क्या थी?
o: Supreme command of imperial battlefield infantry
Oversight of imperial revenue collection and fiscal state management
e: Diwan empire ka finance minister aur supreme revenue authority hota tha jo revenue assessments aur expenditure monitor karta tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mugal kal mein 'divan' ki mukhy jimmedari kya thi? Isliye antim jawab Oversight of imperial revenue collection and fiscal... ke roop mein milta hai. Supreme command of imperial battlefield infantry, Supervising construction of mosques, Conducting foreign diplomatic protocol ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Oversight of imperial revenue collection and fiscal state management baithta hai. Exam point: Oversight of imperial revenue collection and fiscal state management - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In the Ahom kingdom of Assam, what were the subjects obligated to render compulsory military and labour service called?
qh: असम के वे लोग जिन्हें जमीन के बदले सैनिक सेवा देनी होती थी, क्या कहलाते थे?
e: Ahom administration me Paiks wo male subjects the jo state ke liye rotational base par compulsory public works aur military service provide karte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki asam ke ve log jinhein jamin ke badale sainik seva deni hoti thi, kya kahalate the? Isi karan se Paiks sahi uttar hai. Muzarians, Raiyats, Ahoms alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Paiks hai. Exam point: Paiks - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Into how many administrative books (daftars) is the Ain-i-Akbari structurally divided?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी में कुल कितनी जिल्दें (किताबें) हैं?
e: Ain-i-Akbari 5 books (daftars) me divided hai: Manzil-abadi, Sipah-abadi, Mulk-abadi aur aakhiri do books religion aur Akbar ke sayings par hain. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki ain-e-akabari mein kul kitani jildein (kitabein) hain? ain-i-akbari Akbarnama ka hissa thi jismein sasan ke aankde the. Yahi wajah hai ki 5 sahi hai. Galti 3, 4, 10 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se 5 sahi hai. Exam point: 5 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In contemporary Mughal records, what term was applied to forest-dwelling tribes who subsisted on hunting and gathering?
qh: गाँव के उस समूह को क्या कहा जाता था जिनका गुजारा जंगल के उत्पादों और शिकार से चलता था?
e: Contemporary Persian sources me forest dwellers ke liye 'Jungli' term use hota tha, jiska matlab unke forest-dependent livelihood se tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ganv ke us samuh ko kya kaha jata tha jinaka gujara jangal ke utpadon aur shikar se chalata tha? Isi karan se Jungli sahi uttar hai. Mansabdar, Shahri, Vyapari ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Jungli hai. Exam point: Jungli - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which province was the historic 'Shah Nahar' canal repaired and deepened during Shah Jahan's reign?
qh: मुगल काल के दौरान उत्तर भारत में सिंचाई के लिए मरम्मत कराई गई 'शाह नहर' कहाँ स्थित थी?
e: Shah Jahan ke dauran Punjab me Ravi river se nikalne wali 'Shah Nahar' ko repair aur extend kiya gaya tha taaki canal irrigation promote ho sake. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mugal kal ke dauran uttar bharat mein sinchai ke lie marammat karai gai 'shah nahar' kahan sthit thi? Yahi wajah hai ki Punjab sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Gujarat, Bengal, Maharashtra - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Punjab hi hai. Exam point: Punjab - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What constituted the primary source of wealth and economic dominance for Mughal-era Zamindars?
qh: जमींदारों की समृद्धि का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: Vast private demesne lands known as 'Milkiyat' cultivated by hired labourers
Exclusive control over coastal maritime trade
e: Zamindars ki personal ownership wali private lands ko 'Milkiyat' kaha jata tha, jise wo hired labour ya sharecroppers se cultivate karate the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki jamindaron ki samriddhi ka mukhy karan kya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Vast private demesne lands known as 'Milkiyat' cultivated by hired labourers sahi hai. Regular military pensions, Direct imperial salary cash grants, Exclusive control over coastal maritime trade is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Vast private demesne lands known as 'Milkiyat' cultivated by hired labourers sahi hai. Exam point: Vast private demesne lands known as 'Milkiyat' cultivated by hired labourers - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: From which geographical territory were tomatoes, potatoes, and chilies imported into India in the 17th century?
qh: 17वीं शताब्दी में आलू, टमाटर और मिर्च कहाँ से भारत आए थे?
e: Columbian exchange ke under Portuguese traders ne New World (Americas) se potatoes, tomatoes aur red chilies India me introduce kiye. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 17vin shatabdi mein alu, tamatar aur mirch kahan se bharat ae the? Isliye sahi nateeja New World (The Americas) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - China, Arabian Peninsula, Central Asia - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad New World (The Americas) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: New World (The Americas) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which book of the Ain-i-Akbari are Emperor Akbar's philosophical maxims and wise sayings compiled?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के किस भाग में अकबर के 'शुभ वचन' संकलित हैं?
e: Ain-i-Akbari ke 5th book me Akbar ke personal philosophical sayings, moral teachings aur administrative observations ko preserve kiya gaya hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki ain-e-akabari ke kis bhag mein akabar ke 'shubh vachan' sankalit hain? ain-i-akbari Akbarnama ka hissa thi jismein sasan ke aankde the. Isi tathya par Fifth book tika hua hai. Third book, Second book, First book alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Fifth book hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Fifth book - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which regional province of Mughal India was noted for extensive judicial settlements through influential caste panchayats?
qh: मुगल काल में जाति पंचायतों के संदर्भ में कौन सा राज्य विवादों के निपटारे के लिए प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Rajasthan ke local records (arhsattas) show karte hain ki wahan Jati Panchayats land disputes, marriage aur caste rituals ko strongly govern karti thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki mugal kal mein jati panchayaton ke sandarbh mein kaun sa rajy vivadon ke nipatare ke lie prasiddh tha? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi aadhar par Rajasthan chuna jaata hai. Bengal, Assam, Odisha ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Rajasthan hi hai. Exam point: Rajasthan - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: According to medieval records, artisans often comprised up to what proportion of total households in certain villages?
qh: गाँव में दस्तकारों (शिल्पकारों) की संख्या कितनी प्रतिशत तक हो सकती थी?
e: 17th-century Maratha aur western records show karte hain ki agricultural services dene wale artisans (blacksmiths, carpenters, potters) 25% households tak form karte the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki ganv mein dastakaron (shilpakaron) ki sankhya kitani pratishat tak ho sakati thi? Isliye antim jawab 25% ke roop mein milta hai. 5%, 10%, 50% in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav 25% hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 25% - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which province of the Mughal Empire was world-renowned for its extensive sugarcane cultivation and fine sugar production?
qh: मुगल काल में कौन सा क्षेत्र 'चीनी' (Sugar) के उत्पादन के लिए सबसे प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Mughal era me Bengal high-grade white sugar aur gur ke production ka sabse largest exporter tha jo domestic aur overseas markets me supply hota tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mugal kal mein kaun sa kshetr 'chini' (Sugar) ke utpadan ke lie sabase prasiddh tha? Isi karan se Bengal sahi uttar hai. Punjab, Malwa, Gujarat alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Bengal hi hai. Exam point: Bengal - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many times did court historian Abul Fazl painstakingly revise the draft text of the Ain-i-Akbari?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के लेखन में कुल कितनी बार संशोधन (Amendments) किए गए थे?
e: Abul Fazl ne Ain-i-Akbari ke factual data aur administrative accuracy ko maintain karne ke liye pure manuscript ko 5 baar revise kiya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki ain-e-akabari ke lekhan mein kul kitani bar sanshodhan (Amendments) kie gae the? ain-i-akbari Akbarnama ka hissa thi jismein sasan ke aankde the. Isliye antim jawab 5 ke roop mein milta hai. 7, 2, 3 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab 5 hai. Exam point: 5 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which year was the Vijayanagara Empire founded by the Sangama brothers Harihara and Bukka?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: Harihara aur Bukka ne 1336 CE me Sage Vidyaranya ki guidance se Tungabhadra river ke bank par Vijayanagara Empire ki foundation rakhi thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki vijayanagar samrajy ki sthapana kis varsh hui thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1336 CE hi sahi baithta hai. 1565 CE, 1326 CE, 1347 CE ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1336 CE hi milti hai. Exam point: 1336 CE - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which ruined architectural site on the banks of the Tungabhadra River served as the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की राजधानी का क्या नाम था?
e: Vijayanagara Empire ki capital Hampi thi, jiske grand structural ruins Karnataka me Tungabhadra river ke kinare situated hain. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki vijayanagar samrajy ki rajadhani ka kya nam tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Hampi nikalta hai. Vikalp Thanjavur, Bijapur, Mysore bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Hampi hi hai. Exam point: Hampi - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which British antiquarian and surveyor brought the ruins of Hampi to modern prominence in 1800?
qh: हम्पी के खंडहरों की खोज सन 1800 में किसने की थी?
e: Colonel Colin Mackenzie ne 1800 me Hampi ke site par survey karke pehla systematic topographic aur architectural map draw kiya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki hampi ke khandaharon ki khoj san 1800 mein kisane ki thi? Isi baat se Colonel Colin Mackenzie sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp John Marshall, James Prinsep, Alexander Cunningham bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Colonel Colin Mackenzie hai. Exam point: Colonel Colin Mackenzie - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What sovereign title did the rulers of the Vijayanagara Empire adopt for themselves?
qh: विजयनगर के शासक अपने आप को क्या कहकर पुकारते थे?
e: Vijayanagara ke monarchs apne titles me 'Raya' prefix use karte the (jaise Krishnadeva Raya) aur local traditions me 'Hindu Raya Suratrana' bhi kehte the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki vijayanagar ke shasak apane ap ko kya kahakar pukarate the? Isi baat se Raya sahi sabit hota hai. Chhatrapati, Sultan, Maharaja in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Raya hi hai. Exam point: Raya - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which was the foundational first dynasty that ruled the Vijayanagara Empire from 1336 to 1485?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य का पहला राजवंश कौन सा था?
e: Harihara aur Bukka ne apne father Sangama ke naam par first ruling line 'Sangama Dynasty' shuru ki thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki vijayanagar samrajy ka pahala rajavansh kaun sa tha? In tathyon ke chalte Sangama dynasty hi sahi hai. Vikalp Tuluva dynasty, Suluva dynasty, Aravidu dynasty bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Sangama dynasty hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Sangama dynasty - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: To which ruling dynasty did the prominent Vijayanagara emperor Krishnadeva Raya belong?
qh: प्रसिद्ध शासक कृष्णदेव राय किस वंश से संबंधित थे?
e: Krishnadeva Raya (1509-1529 CE) third ruling line Tuluva Dynasty ke sabse illustrious aur successful emperor the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki prasiddh shasak krishnadev ray kis vansh se sanbandhit the? In tathyon ke chalte Tuluva dynasty hi sahi hai. Aravidu dynasty, Suluva dynasty, Sangama dynasty mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Tuluva dynasty hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Tuluva dynasty - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the celebrated 'Ashtadiggajas' at the court of Krishnadeva Raya represent?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय के दरबार में रहने वाले 'अष्टदिग्गज' कौन थे?
o: Eight eminent Telugu poets and scholars
e: Ashtadiggajas Krishnadeva Raya ke court ke 8 premier Telugu poets the, jisme Allasani Peddana aur Tenali Ramakrishna shamil the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki krishnadev ray ke darabar mein rahane vale 'ashtadiggaj' kaun the? Isliye antim jawab Eight eminent Telugu poets and scholars ke roop mein milta hai. Eight military generals, Eight foreign ambassadors, Eight royal diplomats anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Eight eminent Telugu poets and scholars hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Eight eminent Telugu poets and scholars - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which classic political treatise on statecraft did Krishnadeva Raya author in the Telugu language?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय ने तेलुगु भाषा में किस प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ की रचना की?
e: Krishnadeva Raya ne Andal ki story par based Telugu me 'Amuktamalyada' compose ki jisme state governance aur diplomacy ka detailed discourse hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki krishnadev ray ne telugu bhasha mein kis prasiddh granth ki rachana ki? Isliye sahi nateeja Amuktamalyada nikalta hai. Jambavati Kalyanam, Baburnama, Ratnamalika is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Amuktamalyada hai. Exam point: Amuktamalyada - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who were the 'Amara-nayakas' within the administrative and military setup of the Vijayanagara Empire?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य में 'अमर-नायक' (Amar-nayakas) कौन थे?
o: Military commanders governing territories assigned by the king
e: Amara-nayaka system Delhi Sultanate ke iqta system se inspired tha jahan military chiefs ko revenue aur troop maintenance ke liye territories di jaati thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki vijayanagar samrajy mein 'amar-nayak' (Amar-nayakas) kaun the? Isi karan se Military commanders governing territories assigned by the... sahi uttar hai. Royal caravan traders, Subordinate village serfs, Chief temple priests is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Military commanders governing territories assigned by the king hi milti hai. Exam point: Military commanders governing territories assigned by the king - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which year was the disastrous Battle of Talikota (Rakshasi-Tangadi) fought?
qh: तालीकोटा का युद्ध (राक्षसी-तांगड़ी) किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
e: 23 January 1565 ko Battle of Talikota me Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar) ke combined front ne Vijayanagara army ko crush kar diya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki talikota ka yuddh (rakshasi-tangadai) kis varsh lada gaya tha? Isi karan se 1565 CE sahi uttar hai. 1526 CE, 1571 CE, 1556 CE is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1565 CE hai. Exam point: 1565 CE - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which century was the extensive Kamalapuram water reservoir constructed in Vijayanagara?
qh: विजयनगर की जल आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के लिए 'कमलापुरम जलाशय' का निर्माण किस शताब्दी में हुआ था?
e: 15th century ke shuruat me banwaya gaya Kamalapuram tank agricultural irrigation aur canal ke through Royal Centre ko water supply karta tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki vijayanagar ki jal avashyakataon ko pura karane ke lie 'kamalapuram jalashay' ka nirman kis shatabdi mein hua tha? Isi baat se 15th century sahi sabit hota hai. 14th century, 16th century, 13th century alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 15th century hi milti hai. Exam point: 15th century - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: From which river did the engineering marvel 'Hiriya Canal' draw its perennial water supply?
qh: 'हिरिया नहर' (Hiriya Canal) का पानी कहाँ से लाया जाता था?
e: Hiriya canal Tungabhadra par bane masonry dam se water divert karti thi aur agricultural valley ko irrigate karte hue Sacred aur Urban centres ko connect karti thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 'hiriya nahar' (Hiriya Canal) ka pani kahan se laya jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Tungabhadra River hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Kaveri River, Godavari River, Krishna River is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Tungabhadra River hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Tungabhadra River - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which architectural monument in Hampi is globally renowned for its stone monolithic chariot temple?
qh: विजयनगर का कौन सा मंदिर अपनी 'नक्काशीदार रथ' संरचना के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Vitthala Temple complex me Garuda ko dedicated famous monolithic Stone Chariot bana hua hai jo Vijayanagara architecture ka icon hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki vijayanagar ka kaun sa mandir apani 'nakkashidar rath' sanrachana ke lie prasiddh hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Vitthala Temple sahi nikalta hai. Virupaksha Temple, Chennakeshava Temple, Hazara Rama Temple ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Vitthala Temple sahi hai. Exam point: Vitthala Temple - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What architectural designation was given to the monumental gateway towers fronting Vijayanagara temples?
qh: विजयनगर में मंदिरों के प्रवेश द्वार को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Temples ke entry par towering gateways banaye jaate the jinhe 'Gopurams' ya royal patronage ke chalte 'Raya Gopurams' kaha jata tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki vijayanagar mein mandiron ke pravesh dvar ko kya kaha jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Gopuram (Raya Gopuram) sahi hai. Mandapa, Garbhagriha, Shikhara mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Gopuram (Raya Gopuram) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Gopuram (Raya Gopuram) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: From which empire was the diplomatic emissary Abdur Razzaq dispatched to Vijayanagara in the 1440s?
qh: अब्दुल रज्जाक (Abdur Razzaq) किस देश से विजयनगर की यात्रा पर आया था?
e: Persian Timurid ruler Shahrukh ke ambassador Abdur Razzaq ne 1443 me Vijayanagara visit kiya aur city ki concentric 7 fortification walls ki tareef ki. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki abdul rajjak (Abdur Razzaq) kis desh se vijayanagar ki yatra par aya tha? Isi baat se Persia (Timurid Empire of Herat) sahi sabit hota hai. Morocco, Portugal, Venetian Republic alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Persia (Timurid Empire of Herat) sahi hai. Exam point: Persia (Timurid Empire of Herat) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What monumental ceremonial structure was the 'Mahanavami Dibba' within the Royal Centre of Vijayanagara?
qh: 'महानवमी डिब्बा' (Mahanavami Dibba) क्या था?
o: A massive carved square stone platform used for royal festivals
e: Mahanavami Dibba ek 11,000 sq ft base aur 40 ft uncha stone platform tha jahan Mahanavami (Navratri/Dussehra) par king military parades aur rituals supervise karta tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 'mahanavami dibba' (Mahanavami Dibba) kya tha? Isi aadhar par A massive carved square stone platform used for royal festivals chuna jaata hai. An underground water filtration sump, A military fortress dungeon, A grand covered grain bazaar in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar A massive carved square stone platform used for royal festivals hai. Exam point: A massive carved square stone platform used for royal festivals - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the local equestrian merchant guilds engaged in horse trade called in Vijayanagara?
qh: घोड़ों के व्यापारियों को विजयनगर में स्थानीय रूप से क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Local horse merchants ko 'Kudirai Chettis' kaha jata tha, jo Arab aur Portuguese traders se high-quality war horses purchase karte the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ghodaon ke vyapariyon ko vijayanagar mein sthaniy rup se kya kaha jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Kudirai Chettis hi sahi baithta hai. Sethis, Ashwapatis, Mahajans mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Kudirai Chettis hai. Exam point: Kudirai Chettis - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Hindu deity was enshrined as the principal divine guardian of the royal dynasty in the Virupaksha Temple?
qh: विजयनगर के 'विरुपाक्ष मंदिर' के मुख्य देवता कौन हैं?
e: Virupaksha Temple Lord Shiva ke localized form Virupaksha ko dedicated tha, aur kings unhi ke guardian authority par order sign karte the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki vijayanagar ke 'virupaksh mandir' ke mukhy devata kaun hain? Isi baat se Lord Shiva (as Virupaksha) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Lord Rama, Lord Vishnu, Lord Krishna - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Lord Shiva (as Virupaksha) hai. Exam point: Lord Shiva (as Virupaksha) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which planned suburban town did Krishnadeva Raya establish and dedicate to his mother Nagala Devi?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय ने अपनी माता के नाम पर किस उपनगर की स्थापना की थी?
e: Krishnadeva Raya ne Vijayanagara ke paas apni mother Nagala Devi ke honour me 'Nagalapuram' township establish ki thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki krishnadev ray ne apani mata ke nam par kis upanagar ki sthapana ki thi? Isliye sahi nateeja Nagalapuram nikalta hai. Hampi, Penukonda, Chandragiri is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Nagalapuram baithta hai. Exam point: Nagalapuram - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: How many salaried rural officials comprised the institutional 'Ayangar' village governance council?
qh: विजयनगर के ग्रामीण प्रशासन में 'अयंगर' (Ayangars) व्यवस्था में कितने अधिकारी होते थे?
e: Ayangar system me har village ke governance aur revenue account management ke liye 12 hereditary functionaries appoint hote the jinhe tax-free manya lands milti thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki vijayanagar ke gramin prashasan mein 'ayangar' (Ayangars) vyavastha mein kitane adhikari hote the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 12 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 15, 10, 8 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 12 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 12 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: During the reign of which Vijayanagara monarch did the Italian traveler Nicolo Conti visit the capital around 1420?
qh: इटली का यात्री निकोलो कोंटी विजयनगर किसके शासनकाल में आया था?
e: Italian merchant traveler Nicolo de Conti ne Sangama king Devaraya I ke time 1420 CE me Vijayanagara visit karke city layout describe kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki itali ka yatri nikolo konti vijayanagar kisake shasanakal mein aya tha? Isi aadhar par Devaraya I chuna jaata hai. Rama Raya, Krishnadeva Raya, Harihara I mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Devaraya I hi milti hai. Exam point: Devaraya I - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who served as the chief regent and supreme military commander of Vijayanagara during the Battle of Talikota?
qh: तालीकोटा के युद्ध के समय विजयनगर की सेना का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Puppet king Sadashiva Raya ke dauran de facto ruler Aliya Rama Raya tha jinhone 1565 me Talikota battlefield par army lead ki thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki talikota ke yuddh ke samay vijayanagar ki sena ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Rama Raya (Aliya Rama Raya) nikalta hai. Achyuta Raya, Tirumala Raya, Sadashiva Raya alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Rama Raya (Aliya Rama Raya) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Rama Raya (Aliya Rama Raya) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: According to regional folklore, Mother Goddess Pampa Devi performed ascetic penance to marry which deity?
qh: हम्पी की मातृदेवी 'पंपा देवी' ने किनसे विवाह के लिए घोर तपस्या की थी?
e: Local mythological belief ke mutabik Pampa Devi ne Hemakuta hill par Lord Virupaksha (Shiva) ko pati ke roop me paane ke liye penance kiya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki hampi ki matridevi 'panpa devi' ne kinase vivah ke lie ghor tapasya ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Lord Virupaksha (Shiva) sahi nikalta hai. Lord Vishnu, Lord Indra, Lord Rama alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Lord Virupaksha (Shiva) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Lord Virupaksha (Shiva) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which regional dynasty ruling coastal Odisha in the 15th century bore the traditional title 'Gajapati'?
qh: 'गजपति' (Gajapati) किस क्षेत्र के शासकों को कहा जाता था?
e: Odisha ke Suryavamsi rulers ko unke massive war elephant fleets ke chalte 'Gajapati' (Lords of Elephants) kaha jata tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 'gajapati' (Gajapati) kis kshetr ke shasakon ko kaha jata tha? Isi aadhar par Rulers of Odisha (Gajapati Kingdom) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp Deccan Sultanates, Zamorins of Kerala, Pandya rulers of Tamil Nadu bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Rulers of Odisha (Gajapati Kingdom) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Rulers of Odisha (Gajapati Kingdom) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year were the monumental architectural remains of Hampi inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
qh: यूनेस्को (UNESCO) ने हम्पी को 'विश्व विरासत स्थल' कब घोषित किया?
e: UNESCO ne Hampi ke ruins ki extraordinary cultural aur architectural value ko dekhte hue use 1986 me World Heritage Site designate kiya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki yunesko (UNESCO) ne hampi ko 'vishv virasat sthal' kab ghoshit kiya? Yahi wajah hai ki 1986 sahi hai. 1996, 1976, 2000 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1986 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1986 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who gave the romantic descriptive moniker 'Lotus Mahal' to the pavilion in the Zenana Enclosure?
qh: 'लोटस महल' (Lotus Mahal) का नामकरण किसने किया था?
e: Lotus Mahal ka original functional naam clear nahi hai; 19th-century British visitors ne iske lotus-like recessed arches ko dekhkar 'Lotus Mahal' naam diya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 'lotas mahal' (Lotus Mahal) ka namakaran kisane kiya tha? Isi baat se 19th-century British travelers and cartographers sahi sabit hota hai. Portuguese merchants, Temple priests of Virupaksha, Krishnadeva Raya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 19th-century British travelers and cartographers hai. Exam point: 19th-century British travelers and cartographers - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Portuguese chronicler spent extensive time at Vijayanagara during the peak reign of Krishnadeva Raya around 1520?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय के समय कौन सा पुर्तगाली यात्री विजयनगर आया था?
e: Portuguese traveler Domingo Paes 1520-22 ke dauran Vijayanagara aaya aur usne Krishnadeva Raya ke personality aur Mahanavami festival ka eyewitness account likha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki krishnadev ray ke samay kaun sa purtagali yatri vijayanagar aya tha? Isi karan se Domingo Paes sahi uttar hai. Galti Marco Polo, Nicolo Conti, Ibn Battuta chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Domingo Paes hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Domingo Paes - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which language was primarily patronized as the official administrative court language of the Vijayanagara rulers?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की आधिकारिक भाषा कौन सी थी?
e: Vijayanagara me Kannada aur Sanskrit dono prominent the, lekin royal court me literary aur official patronage Telugu language ko sabse zyada mila. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki vijayanagar samrajy ki adhikarik bhasha kaun si thi? Isi baat se Telugu sahi sabit hota hai. Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Telugu baithta hai. Exam point: Telugu - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which final dynasty established its reign from Penukonda and Chandragiri after the catastrophic fall of Hampi in 1565?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य के पतन के बाद कौन सा वंश सत्ता में आया?
e: Talikota war ke baad Tirumala Raya ne 4th dynasty 'Aravidu Dynasty' establish ki jo Penukonda aur Chandragiri se southern parts me rule karti rahi. Yahaan Aravidu dynasty se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Yahi wajah hai ki Aravidu dynasty sahi hai. Sangama dynasty, Hoysala dynasty, Suluva dynasty mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Aravidu dynasty hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Aravidu dynasty - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which monarch commissioned the Hazara Rama Temple, famed for sculpted narrative relief panels from the Ramayana?
qh: हजारा राम मंदिर का निर्माण किसने करवाया था?
e: Royal centre me situated Hazara Rama Temple ko Krishnadeva Raya ne banwaya tha jo royal family ka private temple tha aur iski walls par Ramayana ki carvings hain. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki hajara ram mandir ka nirman kisane karavaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Krishnadeva Raya sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Devaraya I, Harihara II, Bukka I - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Krishnadeva Raya hai. Exam point: Krishnadeva Raya - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Around which historical period did the devotional Bhakti movement formally originate in the Tamil country of South India?
qh: भक्ति आंदोलन की शुरुआत मुख्य रूप से किस शताब्दी में हुई थी?
e: Bhakti movement ki pehli wave 6th-7th century CE me Tamil region me shuru hui jahan Alvars aur Nayanars ne emotional personal devotion preach kiya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bhakti andolan ki shuruat mukhy rup se kis shatabdi mein hui thi? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Isi tathya par 6th-7th century CE tika hua hai. Galti 3rd-4th century CE, 10th century CE, 15th century CE chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 6th-7th century CE baithta hai. Exam point: 6th-7th century CE - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What characterizes the foundational theological belief of 'Saguna Bhakti'?
qh: सगुण भक्ति (Saguna Bhakti) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Devotion to an abstract, unmanifest, formless supreme entity
Devotion centered on anthropomorphic divine incarnations and consecrated idol worship
e: Saguna Bhakti me God ko specific physical form, attributes aur human incarnations (jaise Rama, Krishna, Shiva) me visualize karke murti puja ki jaati hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki sagun bhakti (Saguna Bhakti) ka kya arth hai? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Isliye antim jawab Devotion centered on anthropomorphic divine incarnations and... ke roop mein milta hai. Propagating occult superstitions, Devotion to an abstract, unmanifest, formless supreme entity, Solely conducting Vedic fire sacrifices is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Devotion centered on anthropomorphic divine incarnations and consecrated idol worship hi milti hai. Exam point: Devotion centered on anthropomorphic divine incarnations and consecrated idol worship - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who stood as a prominent exponent of the 'Nirguna Bhakti' tradition in medieval North India?
qh: निर्गुण भक्ति (Nirguna Bhakti) के प्रमुख संत कौन थे?
e: Kabir aur Guru Nanak Nirguna Bhakti ke leaders the, jinhone murti puja aur caste rituals reject karke formless, attribute-less supreme reality ko maana. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki nirgun bhakti (Nirguna Bhakti) ke pramukh sant kaun the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Kabir hi sahi baithta hai. Mirabai, Tulsidas, Surdas is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Kabir hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Kabir - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The South Indian 'Nayanar' saint-poets dedicated their ecstatic devotional hymns to which supreme deity?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के 'नयनार' (Nayanars) संत किस देवता के भक्त थे?
e: Nayanars Tamil region ke 63 Shaivite saint-poets the jo Lord Shiva ki devotion me hymns compose karte hue ek temple se doosre travel karte the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki dakshin bharat ke 'nayanar' (Nayanars) sant kis devata ke bhakt the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Lord Shiva hi sahi baithta hai. Lord Indra, Lord Brahma, Lord Vishnu in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Lord Shiva hai. Exam point: Lord Shiva - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the canonical traditional count of the Vaishnavite 'Alvar' saint-poets in early medieval South India?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के 'अलवार' (Alvars) संतों की कुल संख्या कितनी थी?
e: Lord Vishnu ki devotion preach karne wale Alvar saints ki canonical total number 12 thi, jisme Nammalvar aur Andal sabse celebrated the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki dakshin bharat ke 'alavar' (Alvars) santon ki kul sankhya kitani thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 12 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp 24, 10, 63 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 12 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 12 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which celebrated female Alvar poetess is reverently titled the 'Meera of the South'?
qh: प्रसिद्ध महिला अलवार संत कौन थी जिसे 'दक्षिण की मीरा' भी कहा जाता है?
e: Andal akele female Alvar saint thi jinhone Lord Vishnu (Ranganatha) ko apna beloved husband maankar passionate devotional poetry compose ki. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki prasiddh mahila alavar sant kaun thi jise 'dakshin ki mira' bhi kaha jata hai? alvar dakshin bharat ke vaishnav sant the. Isi aadhar par Andal chuna jaata hai. Karaikkal Ammaiyar, Akka Mahadevi, Mirabai ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Andal hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Andal - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which monumental scriptural compilation of 4,000 Tamil devotional hymns is venerated as the 'Tamil Veda'?
qh: 'नलियरा दिव्य प्रबंधनम' किस भक्ति परंपरा का मुख्य ग्रंथ है?
e: 12 Alvar saints ke 4,000 hymns ko Nathamuni ne 'Nalayira Divya Prabandham' me compile kiya, jise South me 5th Veda ya Tamil Veda ka status prapt hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 'naliyara divy prabandhanam' kis bhakti paranpara ka mukhy granth hai? nayanar dakshin bharat ke shaiv sant the. In tathyon ke chalte Alvar tradition hi sahi hai. Vikalp Nayanar tradition, Lingayat tradition, Sikh tradition bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Alvar tradition sahi hai. Exam point: Alvar tradition - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who spearheaded the egalitarian 'Lingayat' (Virashaiva) socio-religious movement in 12th-century Karnataka?
qh: कर्नाटक में 'लिंगायत' (Lingayat) संप्रदाय की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Basavanna (aur unke associates Allama Prabhu aur Akka Mahadevi) ne 12th century me caste hierarchy aur ritualism ke khilaf Virashaiva/Lingayat movement launch kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki karnatak mein 'lingayat' (Lingayat) sanpraday ki sthapana kisane ki thi? Isi baat se Basavanna sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Madhvacharya, Ramanuja, Shankaracharya chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Basavanna hi hai. Exam point: Basavanna - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which pioneering medieval saint is celebrated for transmitting the devotional Bhakti stream from South India to North India?
qh: भक्ति आंदोलन को दक्षिण भारत से उत्तर भारत लाने का श्रेय किसे दिया जाता है?
e: Swami Ramananda ne 14th century me Bhakti tradition ko North India me popularise kiya aur sabhi castes aur women ke liye spiritual doors open kiye. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bhakti andolan ko dakshin bharat se uttar bharat lane ka shrey kise diya jata hai? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Yahi wajah hai ki Ramananda sahi hai. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, Guru Nanak, Kabir alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Ramananda hi milti hai. Exam point: Ramananda - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which sacred city along the Ganges was the mystic weaver-saint Kabir Das born around 1398?
qh: कबीर दास का जन्म 1398 में किस शहर में हुआ था?
e: Kabir ka birth Varanasi (Kashi) me hua tha aur unka upbringing Neeru aur Neema namak Julaha (Muslim weaver) couple ne kiya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kabir das ka janm 1398 mein kis shahar mein hua tha? Isliye antim jawab Varanasi ke roop mein milta hai. Maghar, Allahabad, Mathura ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Varanasi baithta hai. Exam point: Varanasi - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which primary anthology preserves the verses, sakhis, and ramainis of Saint Kabir?
qh: कबीर की शिक्षाओं और वाणियों का संकलन किस पुस्तक में मिलता है?
e: Kabir Panthis ne Kabir ke authentic teachings, verses aur dohas ko 'Bijak' me compile kiya (jiske mukhya parts Sakhi, Sabad aur Ramaini hain). Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kabir ki shikshaon aur vaniyon ka sankalan kis pustak mein milata hai? upanishad wo granth hain jismein gyaan tatha brahma ke baare mein vichar milta hai. Isi karan se Bijak sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Ramcharitmanas, Sur Sagar, Upanishad - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se Bijak sahi hai. Exam point: Bijak - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: At which birthplace in Punjab was Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the revered founder of Sikhism, born in 1469?
qh: सिख धर्म के संस्थापक गुरु नानक देव जी का जन्म कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Guru Nanak ka birth 1469 me Talwandi (modern Nankana Sahib, Pakistan) me hua tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki sikh dharm ke sansthapak guru nanak dev ji ka janm kahan hua tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Talwandi (Nankana Sahib) sahi nikalta hai. Kartarpur, Amritsar, Ludhiana mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Talwandi (Nankana Sahib) hi hai. Exam point: Talwandi (Nankana Sahib) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which egalitarian institution of open community dining was institutionalized by Guru Nanak to eradicate caste bias?
qh: गुरु नानक देव जी ने सामाजिक समानता के लिए किस प्रथा की शुरुआत की थी?
e: Guru Nanak ne 'Langar' (free community kitchen) establish kiya jahan rich, poor, high caste aur low caste log bina discrimination ek sath pangat me baithkar khana khate hain. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki guru nanak dev ji ne samajik samanata ke lie kis pratha ki shuruat ki thi? Yahi wajah hai ki Langar (Community Kitchen) sahi hai. Idol consecration, Ascetic hermitage, Pilgrim tithe mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Langar (Community Kitchen) hai. Exam point: Langar (Community Kitchen) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Whom did the celebrated Rajput mystic-princess Mirabai choose as her spiritual preceptor (Guru)?
qh: मीराबाई के गुरु के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
e: Mirabai ne social orthodoxy aur royal conventions ko reject karte hue leather-worker caste se aane wale saint Ravidas ko apna spiritual Guru banaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki mirabai ke guru ke rup mein kise jana jata hai? Isi aadhar par Ravidas (Raidas) chuna jaata hai. Kabir, Ramananda, Tulsidas is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se Ravidas (Raidas) sahi hai. Exam point: Ravidas (Raidas) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: From which religious category of subjects was the discriminatory 'Jizya' tax historically levied under orthodox Islamic rule?
qh: इस्लाम में 'जजिया' (Jizya) कर किससे वसूला जाता था?
e: Jizya ek per-capita tax tha jo non-Muslim subjects (Zimmis) par unki life, property aur military service exemption ke protection ke badle impose hota tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki islam mein 'jajiya' (Jizya) kar kisase vasula jata tha? jizya gair-musalmanon par lagne wala vyaktigat kar tha. Isi aadhar par Non-Muslim protected subjects (Zimmis) chuna jaata hai. Military cavaliers only, Foreign maritime merchants, Orthodox Muslims is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Non-Muslim protected subjects (Zimmis) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Non-Muslim protected subjects (Zimmis) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Arab general first imposed the Jizya tax in the Indian subcontinent after the conquest of Sindh in 712 CE?
qh: भारत में पहली बार जजिया कर किसने लगाया था?
e: 712 CE me Sindh capture karne ke baad Umayyad general Muhammad bin Qasim ne Indian subcontinent me pehli baar Jizya impose kiya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bharat mein pahali bar jajiya kar kisane lagaya tha? jizya gair-musalmanon par lagne wala vyaktigat kar tha. Isliye sahi nateeja Muhammad bin Qasim nikalta hai. Akbar, Alauddin Khalji, Aurangzeb is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Muhammad bin Qasim hai. Exam point: Muhammad bin Qasim - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which landmark year did Mughal Emperor Akbar abrogate the unpopular Jizya tax across his empire?
qh: मुगल सम्राट अकबर ने जजिया कर कब समाप्त किया था?
e: Akbar ne apni policy of universal tolerance (Sulh-i-Kul) ke tahat 1564 CE me Jizya tax ko poori tarah abolish kar diya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mugal samrat akabar ne jajiya kar kab samapt kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1564 CE hi sahi baithta hai. Galti 1526 CE, 1707 CE, 1580 CE chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav 1564 CE hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 1564 CE - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Among the Five Pillars of Islam, what religious obligation is designated by the term 'Zakat'?
qh: इस्लाम के 'पाँच सिद्धांतों' में 'जकात' (Zakat) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Mandatory charitable almsgiving for the impoverished
e: Zakat Islam ke five pillars me se ek hai, jisme financially able Muslim apni annual wealth ka lagbhag 2.5% needy aur poor logo ke welfare ke liye donate karta hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki islam ke 'panch siddhanton' mein 'jakat' (Zakat) ka kya arth hai? zakat musalmanon ki sampatti par lagne wala dharmik kar tha. Isliye sahi nateeja Mandatory charitable almsgiving for the impoverished nikalta hai. Pilgrimage to Mecca, Daytime fasting, Daily ritual prayers anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Mandatory charitable almsgiving for the impoverished hai. Exam point: Mandatory charitable almsgiving for the impoverished - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which four fundamental doctrinal sources constitute the classical jurisprudence of Islamic 'Shariat'?
qh: 'शरीयत' (Shariat) कानून के चार मुख्य स्तंभ क्या हैं?
e: Islamic law (Shariat) 4 main roots par based hai: Quran (revelation), Hadith (Prophet ke sayings), Ijma (consensus) aur Qiyas (analogical reasoning). Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 'shariyat' (Shariat) kanun ke char mukhy stanbh kya hain? khanqah sufi sadhakon ke rehne tatha zikr karne ka sthan tha. Yahi wajah hai ki Quran, Hadith, Qiyas, and Ijma sahi hai. Vikalp Kalima, Namaz, Roza, and Hajj, Vedas, Puranas, Gita, and Ramayana, Basra, Beshara, Khanqah, and Pir bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Quran, Hadith, Qiyas, and Ijma hi milti hai. Exam point: Quran, Hadith, Qiyas, and Ijma - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What did the institutional term 'Khanqah' denote within medieval Sufi monasticism?
qh: सूफी परंपरा में 'खानका' (Khanqah) किसे कहा जाता था?
o: A hospice and residential community retreat of Sufi saints and disciples
e: Khanqah Sufi master (Shaikh/Pir) ka residential hospice hota tha jahan disciples rehte the, spiritual practice karte the aur common people advice lene aate the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki suphi paranpara mein 'khanaka' (Khanqah) kise kaha jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par A hospice and residential community retreat of Sufi saints and disciples hi sahi baithta hai. An imperial tax on horses, A stringed musical lute, A mourning ritual is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav A hospice and residential community retreat of Sufi saints and disciples hi thehrta hai. Exam point: A hospice and residential community retreat of... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who established the renowned Chishti Sufi order in the Indian subcontinent at Ajmer?
qh: भारत में 'चिश्ती' (Chishti) सिलसिले की शुरुआत किसने की थी?
e: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti ne 1192 CE me Ajmer (Rajasthan) me settle hokar India me Chishti order ki foundation rakhi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bharat mein 'chishti' (Chishti) silasile ki shuruat kisane ki thi? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isi karan se Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti sahi uttar hai. Shaikh Salim Chishti, Nizamuddin Auliya, Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In the mystic vocabulary of Sufism, what relationship is signified by the pairing of 'Pir' and 'Murid'?
qh: सूफी मत में 'पीर' और 'मुरीद' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Sufism me spiritual mentor ya guru ko 'Pir' (ya Shaikh) kaha jata hai aur unke under oath lene wale devoted disciple ko 'Murid' kehte hain. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki suphi mat mein 'pir' aur 'murid' ka kya arth hai? Isi tathya par Spiritual master (Guide) and initiated disciple tika hua hai. Monarch and sovereign subject, Wealthy noble and indentured serf, Divine reality and human soul is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Spiritual master (Guide) and initiated disciple hi milti hai. Exam point: Spiritual master (Guide) and initiated disciple - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which historical metropolis is the revered Dargah of the celebrated Chishti saint Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya located?
qh: प्रसिद्ध सूफी संत निजामुद्दीन औलिया की दरगाह कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya (Mehboob-e-Ilahi) ki grand Dargah Ghiyaspur (modern Nizamuddin West, Delhi) me situated hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki prasiddh suphi sant nijamuddin auliya ki daragah kahan sthit hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Delhi hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti Fatehpur Sikri, Ajmer, Agra chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Delhi hai. Exam point: Delhi - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which celebrated polymath poet and music innovator was the foremost disciple of Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya?
qh: अमीर खुसरो किस सूफी संत के सबसे प्रिय शिष्य थे?
e: Tuti-e-Hind Amir Khusrau Nizamuddin Auliya ke sabse beloved disciple the; unhone Qawwali aur Hindavi poetry develop ki aur unke passing ke theek agle din unki bhi death hui. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki amir khusaro kis suphi sant ke sabase priy shishy the? Isliye sahi nateeja Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya nikalta hai. Baba Farid, Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki, Salim Chishti is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya baithta hai. Exam point: Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which venerated Sufi ascetic did Emperor Akbar visit barefoot at Sikri to pray for a royal male heir?
qh: अकबर किस सूफी संत का आशीर्वाद लेने नंगे पैर फतेहपुर सीकरी गया था?
e: Akbar Shaikh Salim Chishti ke blessings lene Sikri gaya tha; unke aashirwad se beta hone par Akbar ne uska naam Prince Salim (Jahangir) rakha tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki akabar kis suphi sant ka ashirvad lene nange pair phatehapur sikari gaya tha? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isi baat se Shaikh Salim Chishti sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Nizamuddin Auliya, Moinuddin Chishti, Baba Farid - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Shaikh Salim Chishti hi hai. Exam point: Shaikh Salim Chishti - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In Sufi theological classification, what does the designation 'Ba-shari'a' mean?
qh: सूफी शब्दावली में 'बसरा' (Ba-shari'a) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Sufi orders that strictly conform to and practice formal Shariat law
Antinomian Sufis who reject Islamic jurisprudence
e: Ba-shari'a un Sufi lineages (jaise Chishtis, Suhrawardis) ko denote karta hai jo formal Islamic law (Shariat) ko fully adhere aur respect karte the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki suphi shabdavali mein 'basara' (Ba-shari'a) ka kya arth hai? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isliye sahi nateeja Sufi orders that strictly conform to and practice formal Shariat law nikalta hai. Mendicants without monastic lodges, Sufis practicing public idolatry, Antinomian Sufis who reject Islamic jurisprudence alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Sufi orders that strictly conform to and... hi milti hai. Exam point: Sufi orders that strictly conform to and practice formal Shariat law - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the annual death anniversary celebration of a Sufi saint at his shrine called?
qh: सूफी संत की मृत्यु के बाद मनाए जाने वाले उत्सव को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Sufi tradition me saint ki death ko God ke sath 'union' (spiritual marriage) maana jata hai, isliye death anniversary ko 'Urs' ke roop me celebrate karte hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki suphi sant ki mrityu ke bad manae jane vale utsav ko kya kaha jata hai? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isi karan se Urs sahi uttar hai. Ziyarat, Matam, Ibadat is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Urs hai. Exam point: Urs - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which landmark year did the tenth Sikh Guru, Guru Gobind Singh Ji, inaugurate the martial Khalsa Panth at Anandpur Sahib?
qh: सिखों के 10वें गुरु, गुरु गोविंद सिंह जी ने 'खालसा पंथ' की स्थापना कब की थी?
e: 1699 CE me Baisakhi ke din Anandpur Sahib me Guru Gobind Singh Ji ne Khalsa Panth banaya aur 'Panj Pyare' ko baptize kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki sikhon ke 10vein guru, guru govind sinh ji ne 'khalasa panth' ki sthapana kab ki thi? Isi tathya par 1699 CE tika hua hai. 1469 CE, 1540 CE, 1707 CE is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1699 CE baithta hai. Exam point: 1699 CE - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which famous saint uttered the prophetic retort 'Hunuz Dilli Dur Ast' against Sultan Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq?
qh: 'हनुज दिल्ली दूर अस्त' (अभी दिल्ली बहुत दूर है) यह कथन किसका है?
e: Bengal campaign se laut rahe Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq ne order diya tha ki unke aane se pehle Nizamuddin Auliya Delhi chhod dein, tab saint ne kaha tha 'Hunuz Dilli Dur Ast'. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 'hanuj dilli dur ast' (abhi dilli bahut dur hai) yah kathan kisaka hai? Yahi wajah hai ki Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Amir Khusrau, Alauddin Khalji, Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the spiritual meditative practice of 'Zikr' entail in Sufi discipline?
qh: सूफी मत में 'जिक्र' (Zikr) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Repetitive rhythmic chanting and remembrance of divine names of God
e: Zikr Sufi practice hai jisme heart aur mind ko purify karne ke liye God ke divine names aur Quranic phrases ka rhythmic repetition kiya jata hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki suphi mat mein 'jikr' (Zikr) ka kya arth hai? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isliye sahi nateeja Repetitive rhythmic chanting and remembrance of divine names of God nikalta hai. Vikalp Operating equestrian postal lines, Martial combat training, Soliciting public alms bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Repetitive rhythmic chanting and remembrance of divine names of God hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Repetitive rhythmic chanting and remembrance of divine names of God - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is a narrative account of personal journeys and observations composed by a foreign traveler called?
qh: विदेशी यात्रियों द्वारा लिखे गए 'यात्रा वृत्तांत' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Foreign travelers dwara apne travel experiences, route descriptions aur local observations par likhi gayi book ko Travelogue (yatra vrittanta) kehte hain. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki videshi yatriyon dvara likhe gae 'yatra vrittant' ko kya kaha jata hai? Isi karan se Travelogue sahi uttar hai. Manuscript, Inscription, Biography mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Travelogue hi milti hai. Exam point: Travelogue - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which Central Asian region of Khwarizm (modern Uzbekistan) was the polymath Al-Biruni born in 973 CE?
qh: प्रसिद्ध यात्री अलबरूनी (Al-Biruni) का जन्म कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Al-Biruni 973 CE me Khwarizm (modern-day Uzbekistan) me paida hue the, jo us samay learning aur scholarship ka major center tha. Is prashn ka kendra Khwarizm (Uzbekistan) hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Khwarizm (Uzbekistan) nikalta hai. Vikalp Morocco, Afghanistan, Persia bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Khwarizm (Uzbekistan) hai. Exam point: Khwarizm (Uzbekistan) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: With which invading conqueror did Al-Biruni arrive in the Indian subcontinent in the 11th century?
qh: अलबरूनी किसके साथ भारत आया था?
e: 1017 CE me Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni ne Khwarizm capture kiya aur Al-Biruni ko apne court me laya, jahan se wo Punjab aur North India aaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki alabaruni kisake sath bharat aya tha? Isi baat se Mahmud of Ghazni sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Muhammad Ghori, Iltutmish, Babur - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Mahmud of Ghazni hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Mahmud of Ghazni - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the title of the encyclopedic Arabic treatise on Indian culture, science, and philosophy authored by Al-Biruni?
qh: अलबरूनी द्वारा अरबी भाषा में लिखी गई प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Al-Biruni ne Arabic me 'Kitab-ul-Hind' (Tahqiq ma li-l-Hind) likhi, jisme 80 chapters me Indian religion, astronomy, math aur customs ka objective analysis hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki alabaruni dvara arabi bhasha mein likhi gai prasiddh pustak ka nam kya hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Kitab-ul-Hind hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Akbarnama, Humayunnama, Rihla is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se Kitab-ul-Hind sahi hai. Exam point: Kitab-ul-Hind - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which three fundamental barriers did Al-Biruni identify as impeding foreign understanding of Indian society?
qh: अलबरूनी ने भारत को समझने में किन तीन बाधाओं (Barriers) का उल्लेख किया है?
o: Sanskrit language, religious divergence, and insular self-absorption
e: Al-Biruni ne likha ki Sanskrit ki linguistic complexity, fundamental religious differences aur local scholars ka insular pride unhe samajhne me 3 main barriers the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki alabaruni ne bharat ko samajhane mein kin tin badhaon (Barriers) ka ullekh kiya hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Sanskrit language, religious divergence, and insular self-absorption hi sahi baithta hai. Money, military strength, and geography, Literacy, commerce, and legal codes, Climate, cuisine, and unpaved roads in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Sanskrit language, religious divergence, and insular self-absorption hi milti hai. Exam point: Sanskrit language, religious divergence, and insular self-absorption - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: From which North African city and nation did the celebrated globetrotter Ibn Battuta originate?
qh: इब्नबतूता (Ibn Battuta) किस देश का निवासी था?
e: Ibn Battuta North Africa ke Morocco country ke Tangier city ke ek educated family me 1304 CE me paida hue the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki ibnabatuta (Ibn Battuta) kis desh ka nivasi tha? Isliye antim jawab Morocco (Tangier) ke roop mein milta hai. Italy, Egypt, France mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Morocco (Tangier) hai. Exam point: Morocco (Tangier) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the title of the Arabic travelogue authored by Ibn Battuta recounting his travels across Afro-Eurasia?
qh: इब्नबतूता के यात्रा वृत्तांत का क्या नाम है?
e: Ibn Battuta ke travelogue ka title 'Rihla' hai, jise usne Morocco lautne ke baad Ibn Juzayy ki literary assistance se compile karwaya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki ibnabatuta ke yatra vrittant ka kya nam hai? Isliye antim jawab Rihla ke roop mein milta hai. Galti Kitab-ul-Hind, Indica, Safarnama chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Rihla hai. Exam point: Rihla - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who ruled as the Sultan of Delhi when Ibn Battuta arrived at his court in 1333 CE?
qh: इब्नबतूता जब भारत पहुँचा, उस समय दिल्ली का सुल्तान कौन था?
e: Ibn Battuta 1333 CE me overland route se Delhi pahuncha jab wahan Tughlaq sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq rule kar raha tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki ibnabatuta jab bharat pahuncha, us samay dilli ka sultan kaun tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Muhammad bin Tughlaq sahi hai. Alauddin Khalji, Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq, Sikandar Lodi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Muhammad bin Tughlaq hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Muhammad bin Tughlaq - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: To which judicial post in Delhi did Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq appoint the jurist Ibn Battuta?
qh: मोहम्मद बिन तुगलक ने इब्नबतूता को दिल्ली में किस पद पर नियुक्त किया था?
e: Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq ne Ibn Battuta ki Islamic legal expertise (sharia) se impress hokar use Delhi ka Qazi appoint kiya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki mohammad bin tugalak ne ibnabatuta ko dilli mein kis pad par niyukt kiya tha? Isliye antim jawab Qazi (Islamic Judge) of Delhi ke roop mein milta hai. Commander-in-chief, Diplomatic consul, Imperial prime minister alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Qazi (Islamic Judge) of Delhi baithta hai. Exam point: Qazi (Islamic Judge) of Delhi - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which two novel Indian agricultural products astounded Ibn Battuta upon his arrival in India?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने भारत के किन दो 'अनोखे' फलों/पौधों का वर्णन किया है?
e: Ibn Battuta ne human face jaise dikhne wale Coconut aur bina fruit kiye sirf leaves use hone wale Paan (betel) ko exotic plants bataya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki ibnabatuta ne bharat ke kin do 'anokhe' phalon/paudhon ka varnan kiya hai? Yahi wajah hai ki Coconut and Betel leaf (Paan) sahi hai. Dates and grapes, Apples and oranges, Mangoes and plantains ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se Coconut and Betel leaf (Paan) sahi hai. Exam point: Coconut and Betel leaf (Paan) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What two operational categories of the Indian postal communication network were described by Ibn Battuta?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने भारत की किस संचार व्यवस्था (Postal System) का वर्णन किया है?
o: Uluq (Horse post) and Dawa (Foot runner post)
e: Ibn Battuta ne Mughal/Sultanate postal system me har 4 miles par horse-post (Uluq) aur har 1/3 mile par bells leke daudne wale foot-post (Dawa) ka detail diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki ibnabatuta ne bharat ki kis sanchar vyavastha (Postal System) ka varnan kiya hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Uluq (Horse post) and Dawa (Foot runner post) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai.
