Railway and steam mail, Carrier pigeon lines only, Royal smoke signals is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Uluq (Horse post) and Dawa (Foot runner post) hi milti hai. Exam point: Uluq (Horse post) and Dawa (Foot runner... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to Ibn Battuta, how many days did the journey take for travelers to traverse from Sindh to Delhi?
qh: इब्नबतूता के अनुसार सिंध से दिल्ली पहुँचने में कितने दिन लगते थे?
e: Ibn Battuta ne mention kiya ki normal travelers ko Sindh se Delhi aane me 50 days lagte the, jabki news foot-runners ke network se sirf 5 din me pahunchti thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ibnabatuta ke anusar sindh se dilli pahunchane mein kitane din lagate the? Isi aadhar par 50 days chuna jaata hai. 40 days, 100 days, 10 days anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 50 days hi hai. Exam point: 50 days - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which century did the French physician and traveler François Bernier live in Mughal India?
qh: फ्रांसीसी यात्री फ्रेंकोइस बर्नियर (François Bernier) भारत कब आया था?
e: Francois Bernier France se aakar 1656 se 1668 CE (17th century) tak Mughal Empire me 12 saal raha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki phransisi yatri phreinkois barniyar (Fran ois Bernier) bharat kab aya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki 17th century (1656-1668) sahi hai. 11th century, 14th century, 18th century ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se 17th century (1656-1668) sahi hai. Exam point: 17th century (1656-1668) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the professional vocation of the French visitor François Bernier?
qh: फ्रेंकोइस बर्नियर पेशे से क्या था?
e: Francois Bernier Paris university se trained Physician (doctor) tha aur intellectually political philosopher aur historian tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki phreinkois barniyar peshe se kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Physician, political philosopher, and historian nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Sculptor, Military artillery gunner, Diamond merchant - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Physician, political philosopher, and historian baithta hai. Exam point: Physician, political philosopher, and historian - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In what professional capacity did François Bernier serve the eldest Mughal prince Dara Shukoh?
qh: बर्नियर ने मुगल राजकुमार दारा शिकोह के यहाँ किस रूप में सेवा की?
e: Bernier ne Shah Jahan ke eldest son aur liberal intellectual prince Dara Shukoh ke personal physician ke taur par serve kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki barniyar ne mugal rajakumar dara shikoh ke yahan kis rup mein seva ki? Isi tathya par Personal physician tika hua hai. Court tutor, Personal bodyguard, Imperial cook in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Personal physician hi milti hai. Exam point: Personal physician - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the title of François Bernier's published European travel account on the Mughal Empire?
qh: बर्नियर की पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Bernier ne apni observations ko 'Travels in the Mughal Empire' me publish kiya, jo French king Louis XIV ko address thi aur Europe-India binary compare karti thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki barniyar ki pustak ka nam kya hai? Isliye antim jawab Travels in the Mughal Empire ke roop mein milta hai. The Discovery of India, Akbarnama, Rihla ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Travels in the Mughal Empire hi milti hai. Exam point: Travels in the Mughal Empire - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What did François Bernier consider as the root structural cause of agricultural backwardness in Mughal India?
qh: बर्नियर ने भारत में कृषि की अवनति का मुख्य कारण क्या बताया?
o: Total absence of private ownership in land (Crown ownership of all land)
e: Bernier ka thesis tha ki sovereign king saari land ka absolute owner hai; private property rights na hone se peasants zameen par long-term investment nahi karte. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki barniyar ne bharat mein krishi ki avanati ka mukhy karan kya bataya? Isi baat se Total absence of private ownership in land (Crown ownership of all land) sahi sabit hota hai. Excessive seasonal river flooding, Deficiency of draft animal breeds, Recurrent monsoon droughts alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Total absence of private ownership in land (Crown ownership of all land) hi milti hai. Exam point: Total absence of private ownership in land (Crown ownership of all land) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What critical term did François Bernier apply to Mughal urban centers, claiming they depended solely on the royal court?
qh: बर्नियर ने मुगल शहरों को क्या नाम दिया?
e: Bernier ne Mughal cities ko 'Camp Towns' kaha, uska maanna tha ki ye cities tabhi exist karte hain jab imperial court aur army wahan camped hoti hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki barniyar ne mugal shaharon ko kya nam diya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Camp Towns hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp Autonomous commercial republics, Temple cities, Industrial manufacturing hubs bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Camp Towns hai. Exam point: Camp Towns - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which Indian city did Ibn Battuta describe as an immense, heavily populated metropolis with fortified walls?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने दिल्ली के किस शहर को भारत का सबसे बड़ा शहर बताया?
e: Ibn Battuta ne Delhi ko pure Islamic East ka sabse grand, heavily fortified aur vast population wala city describe kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ibnabatuta ne dilli ke kis shahar ko bharat ka sabase bada shahar bataya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Delhi hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Multan, Daulatabad, Lahore - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Delhi hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Delhi - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Al-Biruni compared the social hierarchy of the Indian caste system with which ancient civilization?
qh: अलबरूनी ने भारतीय समाज की किस व्यवस्था का तुलनात्मक अध्ययन किया?
e: Al-Biruni ne explain kiya ki social divisions unique nahi hain, ancient Persia me bhi knights, priests, physicians aur peasants ke 4 classes the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki alabaruni ne bharatiy samaj ki kis vyavastha ka tulanatmak adhyayan kiya? Isi baat se Ancient Persian fourfold social classes sahi sabit hota hai. Feudal European manors, Egyptian dynastic hierarchies, Greco-Roman patrician classes ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Ancient Persian fourfold social classes hi hai. Exam point: Ancient Persian fourfold social classes - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to Bernier's theoretical framework, what did 'Crown ownership of land' imply?
qh: बर्नियर के अनुसार 'क्राउन ओनरशिप ऑफ लैंड' का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Foreign joint-stock trading firms owned the provinces
The Mughal Emperor was the sole proprietor of all land and peasants were mere tenants
Temples and monastic institutions controlled all acreage
e: Bernier ke mutabik king saari territory ka maalik tha jahan koi private inheritance nahi thi aur peasants destitute tenants ki tarah rehte the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki barniyar ke anusar 'kraun onaraship oph laind' ka kya arth tha? Isi baat se The Mughal Emperor was the sole proprietor of all land and peasants were mere tenants sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Foreign joint-stock trading firms owned the provinces, Temples and monastic institutions controlled all acreage, Peasants held absolute hereditary freehold - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar The Mughal Emperor was the sole proprietor of all land and peasants were mere tenants hi hai. Exam point: The Mughal Emperor was the sole proprietor of all land and peasants were mere tenants - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which major urban commercial center in the Deccan was noted by Ibn Battuta as rivaling Delhi in scale?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने किस भारतीय शहर को दिल्ली के समान बड़ा बताया?
e: Maharashtra me situated Daulatabad (Devagiri) ko Ibn Battuta ne size, riches aur bazaars me Delhi ke barabar formidable bataya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki ibnabatuta ne kis bharatiy shahar ko dilli ke saman bada bataya? Isi baat se Daulatabad (Devagiri) sahi sabit hota hai. Agra, Surat, Kannauj is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Daulatabad (Devagiri) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Daulatabad (Devagiri) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In what functional roles were domestic slaves commonly deployed in medieval Indian households?
qh: मध्यकालीन भारत में दासों (Slaves) को किस रूप में उपयोग किया जाता था?
o: Domestic service, palanquin bearing, musicianship, and domestic surveillance
e: Ibn Battuta ke according slaves domestic chores, palanquin lifting, female singers aur nobles ki personal surveillance ke liye widely use hote the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki madhyakalin bharat mein dason (Slaves) ko kis rup mein upayog kiya jata tha? In tathyon ke chalte Domestic service, palanquin bearing, musicianship, and domestic surveillance hi sahi hai. Exclusively deployed in artillery manufacturing, Confined to royal court calligraphy, Strictly segregated to canal digging anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Domestic service, palanquin bearing, musicianship, and domestic surveillance hi hai. Exam point: Domestic service, palanquin bearing, musicianship, and domestic... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In his critique of Sati, where did Bernier observe a harrowing account of a coerced 12-year-old widow?
qh: बर्नियर ने सती प्रथा का वर्णन करते हुए कहाँ की 12 वर्षीय बच्ची का उल्लेख किया?
e: Bernier ne Lahore me ek innocent 12 saal ki young widow ko relatives dwara forcibly pyre me bandhkar jalaye jaane ka horrifying account likha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki barniyar ne sati pratha ka varnan karate hue kahan ki 12 varshiy bachchi ka ullekh kiya? Isi karan se Lahore sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Delhi, Agra, Patna - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Lahore hai. Exam point: Lahore - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which grand empire did the Persian diplomatic envoy Abdur Razzaq visit in the 1440s?
qh: अब्दुल रज्जाक समरकंदी (Abdur Razzaq) भारत के किस साम्राज्य को देखने आया था?
e: Abdur Razzaq ne 1442-43 me southern Vijayanagara Empire visit kiya jab wahan Sangama king Devaraya II rule kar rahe the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki abdul rajjak samarakandi (Abdur Razzaq) bharat ke kis samrajy ko dekhane aya tha? Isi karan se Vijayanagara Empire sahi uttar hai. Chola Empire, Maratha Empire, Mughal Empire is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Vijayanagara Empire hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Vijayanagara Empire - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Delhi Sultan formulated and ruthlessly implemented the autocratic policy of 'Iron and Blood'?
qh: दिल्ली के किस सुल्तान ने 'लौह एवं रक्त' की नीति अपनाई थी?
e: Ghiyasuddin Balban ne Mewatis aur recalcitrant Rajput chiefs ko suppress karne aur sultanate ki prestige restore karne ke liye 'Iron and Blood' policy chalaayi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki dilli ke kis sultan ne 'lauh evan rakt' ki niti apanai thi? Isi baat se Ghiyasuddin Balban sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Shamsuddin Iltutmish, Alauddin Khalji, Muhammad bin Tughluq - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Ghiyasuddin Balban hi milti hai. Exam point: Ghiyasuddin Balban - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Between which two commanders was the decisive First Battle of Panipat fought on 21 April 1526?
qh: पानीपत का प्रथम युद्ध (1526) किसके बीच लड़ा गया था?
e: 21 April 1526 ko Babur ne gunpowder field artillery aur Tulghuma tactics use karke Delhi Sultan Ibrahim Lodi ko defeat kiya aur Mughal rule shuru kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki panipat ka pratham yuddh (1526) kisake bich lada gaya tha? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi tathya par Babur and Ibrahim Lodi tika hua hai. Babur and Rana Sanga, Humayun and Sher Shah Suri, Akbar and Hemu mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Babur and Ibrahim Lodi hi hai. Exam point: Babur and Ibrahim Lodi - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who were the dual founders who established the sovereign kingdom of Vijayanagara in 1336?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Sangama dynasty ke do brothers Harihara aur Bukka ne Kampili ke fall ke baad Vijayanagara kingdom ki foundation rakhi thi. Yahaan Harihara I and Bukka I se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi baat se Harihara I and Bukka I sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp Devaraya I and Devaraya II, Krishnadeva Raya and Achyuta Raya, Sadashiva Raya and Rama Raya bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Harihara I and Bukka I hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Harihara I and Bukka I - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the foundational etymological meaning of the French word 'Renaissance'?
qh: पुनर्जागरण या 'रिनेसां' (Renaissance) शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
e: Renaissance ka literal meaning French me 'Rebirth' hota hai; ye 14th se 17th century ke classical Greek aur Roman intellectual revival ko darshata hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki punarjagaran ya 'rinesan' (Renaissance) shabd ka shabdik arth kya hai? Yahi wajah hai ki Rebirth (Cultural resurgence of classical learning) sahi hai. Vikalp Monastic asceticism, Holy crusade war, Mercantile expansion bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Rebirth (Cultural resurgence of classical learning) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Rebirth (Cultural resurgence of classical learning) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which geographic region did the cultural Renaissance first take root in 14th-century Europe?
qh: यूरोप में पुनर्जागरण (Renaissance) की शुरुआत सबसे पहले किस देश से हुई थी?
e: Renaissance sabse pehle Northern Italy ke prosperous merchant city-states (jaise Florence, Venice, Milan, Padua) me shuru hua. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki yurop mein punarjagaran (Renaissance) ki shuruat sabase pahale kis desh se hui thi? Yahi wajah hai ki Italian City-States (Florence, Venice) sahi hai. England, France, Germany anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Italian City-States (Florence, Venice) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Italian City-States (Florence, Venice) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the core educational philosophy of 'Humanism' during the European Renaissance?
qh: पुनर्जागरण के दौरान 'मानवतावाद' (Humanism) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Education emphasizing human agency, critical reason, grammar, history, and moral philosophy
e: Humanism (Studia humanitatis) ecclesiastical religion ke bajay insaan ke reason, liberal arts, classical literature aur potential par focus karta tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki punarjagaran ke dauran 'manavatavad' (Humanism) shabd ka prayog kisake lie kiya jata tha? Isi aadhar par Education emphasizing human agency, critical reason, grammar, history, and moral philosophy chuna jaata hai. Vikalp Financial philanthropy for the aristocracy, Rigid scholastic theological dogma, Strict animal welfare only bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Education emphasizing human agency, critical reason, grammar,... hai. Exam point: Education emphasizing human agency, critical reason, grammar, history, and moral philosophy - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who authored the seminal work 'The Civilization of the Renaissance in Italy' published in 1860?
qh: 1860 में 'द सिविलाइजेशन ऑफ द रिनेसां इन इटली' नामक प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
e: Swiss historian Jacob Burckhardt ne 1860 me ye book likhkar Renaissance ko modern rational worldview ka birth point establish kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 1860 mein 'd sivilaijeshan oph d rinesan in itali' namak prasiddh pustak kisane likhi thi? Isi karan se Jacob Burckhardt sahi uttar hai. Francesco Petrarch, Leopold von Ranke, Marcus Cicero mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Jacob Burckhardt hi hai. Exam point: Jacob Burckhardt - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Italian poet and scholar is widely venerated as the 'Father of Humanism'?
qh: किस इटालियन कवि को 'मानवतावाद का जनक' (Father of Humanism) माना जाता है?
e: Petrarch ne forgotten classical Latin manuscripts collect kiye aur individual human consciousness aur eloquence par zor diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kis italiyan kavi ko 'manavatavad ka janak' (Father of Humanism) mana jata hai? Yahi wajah hai ki Francesco Petrarch sahi hai. Vikalp Dante Alighieri, Michelangelo, Niccolo Machiavelli bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Francesco Petrarch hai. Exam point: Francesco Petrarch - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What did the ideal archetype of a 'Renaissance Man' (L'uomo universale) signify?
qh: पुनर्जागरण काल में 'रिनेसां मैन' (Renaissance Man) किसे कहा जाता था?
o: An ordained cardinal in the Papal Curia
A specialized knight in heavy armor
A versatile polymath excelling across fine arts, sciences, languages, and athletics
e: Renaissance man ek aisi personality ko kehte the jo multiple diverse domains (art, math, science, philosophy, sports) me equally proficient ho. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki punarjagaran kal mein 'rinesan main' (Renaissance Man) kise kaha jata tha? Isliye sahi nateeja A versatile polymath excelling across fine arts, sciences, languages, and athletics nikalta hai. Vikalp An overseas chartered merchant, An ordained cardinal in the Papal Curia, A specialized knight in heavy armor bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar A versatile polymath excelling across fine arts, sciences, languages, and athletics baithta hai. Exam point: A versatile polymath excelling across fine arts,... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which quintessential polymath artist painted the celebrated masterpieces 'Mona Lisa' and 'The Last Supper'?
qh: प्रसिद्ध पेंटिंग 'मोनालिसा' और 'द लास्ट सपर' के रचनाकार कौन थे?
e: Florentine genius Leonardo da Vinci ne Mona Lisa aur The Last Supper create kiye the; wo painter, engineer aur anatomist the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki prasiddh peinting 'monalisa' aur 'd last sapar' ke rachanakar kaun the? Isi karan se Leonardo da Vinci sahi uttar hai. Galti Michelangelo Buonarroti, Donatello, Raphael Sanzio chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Leonardo da Vinci hai. Exam point: Leonardo da Vinci - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which sculptor-painter spent four years painting the monumental ceiling frescoes of the Sistine Chapel in Rome?
qh: माइकल एंजेलो ने किस प्रसिद्ध चर्च की छत पर 'सिस्टाइन चैपल' (Sistine Chapel) की पेंटिंग बनाई थी?
e: Michelangelo ne 1508 se 1512 ke beech Vatican ke Sistine Chapel ceiling par Genesis aur Creation of Adam ke frescoes paint kiye. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki maikal enjelo ne kis prasiddh charch ki chhat par 'sistain chaipal' (Sistine Chapel) ki peinting banai thi? Isi karan se Sistine Chapel sahi uttar hai. St. Paul's Cathedral, St. Peter's Basilica, Florence Duomo is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Sistine Chapel hai. Exam point: Sistine Chapel - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which political realism treatise did Florentine diplomat Niccolo Machiavelli author in 1513?
qh: पुनर्जागरण काल के प्रसिद्ध लेखक निकोलो मचियावेली की पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Machiavelli ne 'The Prince' (Il Principe) me state survival aur political expediency par focus kiya, morality ko statecraft se alag kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki punarjagaran kal ke prasiddh lekhak nikolo machiyaveli ki pustak ka nam kya hai? Isi karan se The Prince sahi uttar hai. Praise of Folly, The Divine Comedy, Utopia in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab The Prince hai. Exam point: The Prince - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which country hailed the famous Christian humanist scholar Desiderius Erasmus?
qh: प्रसिद्ध मानवतावादी विद्वान इरास्मस (Erasmus) किस देश से संबंधित थे?
e: Desiderius Erasmus Rotterdam (Holland) ke leading Christian humanist the jinhone 'Praise of Folly' likhkar clerical corruption ko satirize kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki prasiddh manavatavadi vidvan irasmas (Erasmus) kis desh se sanbandhit the? Isi aadhar par Holland (The Netherlands) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - Spain, Italy, England - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Holland (The Netherlands) hai. Exam point: Holland (The Netherlands) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which historical millennium was designated by Renaissance humanists as the intellectual 'Dark Ages'?
qh: यूरोप में 'डार्क एजेस' (Dark Ages) का काल किसे माना जाता है?
e: Humanists ne classical Roman empire ke collapse se lekar apne time (5th se 14th century) ke intermediate feudal phase ko Dark Ages term kiya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki yurop mein 'dark ejes' (Dark Ages) ka kal kise mana jata hai? Isi aadhar par 5th to 14th century CE (The Middle Ages) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp 1st to 4th century CE, Modern Age, 16th century CE bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 5th to 14th century CE (The Middle Ages) baithta hai. Exam point: 5th to 14th century CE (The Middle Ages) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Scholars of which civilization preserved, translated, and commented on ancient Greek philosophy and science during the European Middle Ages?
qh: यूरोप में किस देश के दार्शनिकों ने प्राचीन यूनानी ग्रंथों को अरबी में अनुवाद करके सुरक्षित रखा था?
e: Baghdad aur Cordoba ke Arab scholars (Ibn Rushd, Ibn Sina) ne Aristotle, Plato aur Galen ko Arabic me translate karke Europe tak wapas transmit kiya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki yurop mein kis desh ke darshanikon ne prachin yunani granthon ko arabi mein anuvad karake surakshit rakha tha? Isi tathya par The Arabs and Islamic world tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - The Franks, The Teutonic knights, Anglo-Saxons - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan The Arabs and Islamic world hi milti hai. Exam point: The Arabs and Islamic world - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the humanist scholar Lorenzo Valla expose regarding the papal territorial charter 'Donation of Constantine'?
qh: 'डोनेशन ऑफ कांसटेनटाइन' नामक दस्तावेज को मानवतावादियों ने क्या घोषित किया?
e: Humanist Lorenzo Valla ne linguistic analysis se prove kiya ki Papacy ka claim karne wala 'Donation of Constantine' document 8th century ka forged fake paper tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 'doneshan oph kansatenatain' namak dastavej ko manavatavadiyon ne kya ghoshit kiya? Isi aadhar par A medieval linguistic forgery chuna jaata hai. Vikalp An imperial testament, A legitimate Roman imperial decree, Sacred scripture bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab A medieval linguistic forgery hai. Exam point: A medieval linguistic forgery - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What artistic revolution distinguished Renaissance art from its flat, two-dimensional medieval predecessors?
qh: पुनर्जागरण काल की कला में 'यथार्थवाद' (Realism) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Realistic anatomical accuracy, natural proportions, and linear optical perspective
e: Renaissance artists ne linear perspective, chiaroscuro (light/shade) aur human anatomy dissect karke life-like visual Realism achieve kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki punarjagaran kal ki kala mein 'yatharthavad' (Realism) se kya tatpary hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Realistic anatomical accuracy, natural proportions, and linear optical perspective hi sahi baithta hai. Strict mosaic gilding, Monochrome line tracing, Pure geometric abstraction ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Realistic anatomical accuracy, natural proportions, and linear optical perspective baithta hai. Exam point: Realistic anatomical accuracy, natural proportions, and linear optical perspective - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which intellectual Renaissance noblewoman ruled the court of Mantua as a model of statesmanship and artistic patronage?
qh: प्रसिद्ध मानवतावादी महिला इसाबेला डे एस्टे (Isabella d'Este) कहाँ की शासिका थीं?
e: Isabella d'Este Mantua ki marchesa thi jinhone political leadership sambhali aur great Renaissance artists aur humanists ko patronize kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki prasiddh manavatavadi mahila isabela de este (Isabella d'Este) kahan ki shasika thin? Isi baat se Mantua sahi sabit hota hai. Florence, Venice, Rome is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Mantua hai. Exam point: Mantua - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which seismic geopolitical event in 1453 accelerated the flight of Greek scholars and classical manuscripts to Italy?
qh: 1453 में किस घटना के कारण कई यूनानी विद्वान भागकर इटली आ गए?
o: The Ottoman conquest of Constantinople by Sultan Mehmed II
e: 1453 me Ottoman Turks ne Constantinople conquer kiya jisse Greek scholars precious ancient texts ke sath Italy migrate ho gaye. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 1453 mein kis ghatana ke karan kai yunani vidvan bhagakar itali a gae? In tathyon ke chalte The Ottoman conquest of Constantinople by Sultan Mehmed II hi sahi hai. Galti Lisbon earthquake, Outbreak of the Black Death, The storming of the Bastille chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab The Ottoman conquest of Constantinople by Sultan Mehmed II hai. Exam point: The Ottoman conquest of Constantinople by Sultan Mehmed II - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which linguistic root was the term 'Feudalism' derived by modern historians?
qh: फ्रांस के इतिहास में 'सामंतवाद' (Feudalism) शब्द की उत्पत्ति किस भाषा के शब्द से हुई है?
o: Germanic word 'Feud' (meaning a piece of land)
e: Feudalism German root word 'Feud' se derive hua hai jiska basic meaning land-tenure ya fief (zameen ka conditional tukda) hota hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki phrans ke itihas mein 'samantavad' (Feudalism) shabd ki utpatti kis bhasha ke shabd se hui hai? Isi karan se Germanic word 'Feud' (meaning a piece of... sahi uttar hai. Anglo-Saxon, Old French, Classical Latin mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Germanic word 'Feud' (meaning a piece of... hai. Exam point: Germanic word 'Feud' (meaning a piece of land) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Medieval European society was traditionally conceptualized as divided into which 'Three Orders'?
qh: मध्यकालीन यूरोपीय समाज किन 'तीन वर्गों' (Three Orders) में विभाजित था?
o: Merchants, Guild Masters, and Day Laborers
e: Medieval clergy ne society ko functional three orders me categorize kiya tha: Those who pray (Clergy), Those who fight (Nobles), aur Those who work (Peasants). Sawaal is baat ka hai ki madhyakalin yuropiy samaj kin 'tin vargon' (Three Orders) mein vibhajit tha? Isi aadhar par Clergy, Nobility, and Peasantry chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - King, Queen, and Household Serfs, Patricians, Plebeians, and Slaves, Merchants, Guild Masters, and Day Laborers - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Clergy, Nobility, and Peasantry baithta hai. Exam point: Clergy, Nobility, and Peasantry - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the fortified country estate and agricultural domain of a feudal lord termed?
qh: नोबल्स (अभिजात वर्ग) के विशाल निजी निवास और उनके खेतों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Manor feudal lord ka self-sufficient rural economic estate hota tha jisme uska fortified manor house, fields, mill, bakery aur peasant cottages hote the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki nobals (abhijat varg) ke vishal niji nivas aur unake kheton ko kya kaha jata tha? In tathyon ke chalte Feudal Manor hi sahi hai. Chateau, Garrison, Monastery anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Feudal Manor hi milti hai. Exam point: Feudal Manor - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which ecclesiastical tax, amounting to one-tenth of annual agricultural harvest, was collected by the Catholic Church?
qh: चर्च द्वारा किसानों से वसूला जाने वाला वह कर कौन सा था जो उनकी उपज का दसवां हिस्सा होता था?
e: Church peasants se unki crop output ka 1/10th hissa religiously claim karta tha jise 'Tithe' kaha jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki charch dvara kisanon se vasula jane vala vah kar kaun sa tha jo unaki upaj ka dasavan hissa hota tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Tithe hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Corvee, Taille, Fief chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Tithe hi milti hai. Exam point: Tithe - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the royal direct personal tax levied by the French crown upon commoner peasantry?
qh: राजा द्वारा किसानों पर सीधे तौर पर लगाए गए कर को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: French monarchy third estate (peasants) par direct property/poll tax impose karti thi jise 'Taille' kehte the, jisse clergy aur nobility exempt the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki raja dvara kisanon par sidhe taur par lagae gae kar ko kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Taille hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Tithe, Gabelle, Banalite in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Taille hai. Exam point: Taille - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who constituted the specialized armored equestrian fighting caste in the European feudal order?
qh: सामंती व्यवस्था में 'नाइट्स' (Knights) कौन थे?
o: Professional mounted heavy cavalry warriors tied to lords
e: Knights armored mounted cavalry warriors the jinhe lords unki military service ke badle fief (land) aur protection dete the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki samanti vyavastha mein 'naits' (Knights) kaun the? Isi karan se Professional mounted heavy cavalry warriors tied to lords sahi uttar hai. Urban merchant guildsmen, Wandering mendicant friars, Unfree agrarian sharecroppers is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Professional mounted heavy cavalry warriors tied to... hai. Exam point: Professional mounted heavy cavalry warriors tied to lords - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What legal category of unfree cultivators was bound to the soil of the feudal lord's manor?
qh: सामंतवाद के तहत 'सर्फ' (Serf) किन्हें कहा जाता था?
o: Serfs (Bonded agricultural tenants tied to land)
e: Serfs wo unfree peasants the jo lord ki land se legally bound the; wo bina lord ki permission ke estate chhod nahi sakte the aur unhe unpaid labour (corvee) deni padti thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki samantavad ke tahat 'sarph' (Serf) kinhein kaha jata tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Serfs (Bonded agricultural tenants tied to land) nikalta hai. Apprentice artisans, Free yeoman farmers, Equestrian vassals is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Serfs (Bonded agricultural tenants tied to land) hai. Exam point: Serfs (Bonded agricultural tenants tied to land) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who served as the supreme ecclesiastical head of the Western Catholic Church headquartered in Rome?
qh: कैथोलिक चर्च के सर्वोच्च मुखिया को क्या कहा जाता था, जो रोम में रहता था?
e: Rome ka Bishop poore Western Catholic Christian world ka supreme spiritual authority hota tha jise Pope (Holy Father) kaha jata hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki kaitholik charch ke sarvochch mukhiya ko kya kaha jata tha, jo rom mein rahata tha? Isi karan se The Pope sahi uttar hai. The Abbot, The Grand Prior, Archbishop of Canterbury ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar The Pope hi hai. Exam point: The Pope - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which secluded, self-contained monastic retreats did Christian monks and nuns reside?
qh: यूरोप में 'भिक्षु' (Monks) कहाँ रहते थे?
e: Monks aur nuns worldly life se door isolated self-sufficient religious settlements me rehte the jinhe Monasteries ya Abbeys kehte the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki yurop mein 'bhikshu' (Monks) kahan rahate the? Isi baat se Monasteries or Abbeys sahi sabit hota hai. Municipal guildhalls, Feudal knight barracks, Imperial citadels in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Monasteries or Abbeys hi hai. Exam point: Monasteries or Abbeys - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Norman Duke invaded and conquered Anglo-Saxon England at the Battle of Hastings in 1066?
qh: 11वीं शताब्दी में किस फ्रांसीसी ड्यूक ने इंग्लैंड को जीता और वहाँ सामंतवाद लागू किया?
e: Duke William of Normandy ne 1066 me England conquer kiya aur Anglo-Saxon nobility ko replace karke French-style feudal land tenure introduce kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 11vin shatabdi mein kis phransisi dyuk ne inglaind ko jita aur vahan samantavad lagu kiya? Yahi wajah hai ki William the Conqueror (Duke of Normandy) sahi hai. Louis XIV, Philip Augustus, Charlemagne is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar William the Conqueror (Duke of Normandy) hi hai. Exam point: William the Conqueror (Duke of Normandy) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What environmental shift beginning around the 11th century stimulated agrarian productivity across Western Europe?
qh: यूरोप में 11वीं शताब्दी से कृषि के विस्तार का मुख्य पर्यावरणीय कारण क्या था?
o: Medieval Warm Period (Milder temperatures and longer growing seasons)
e: 11th century me Europe ek Warm Phase me enter hua jisse frosts kam hui, growing season lambi hui aur agriculture production rapidly expand hua. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki yurop mein 11vin shatabdi se krishi ke vistar ka mukhy paryavaraniy karan kya tha? Isi karan se Medieval Warm Period (Milder temperatures and longer... sahi uttar hai. Intense glacial expansion, Severe perennial droughts, Widespread seismic instability is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Medieval Warm Period (Milder temperatures and longer... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Medieval Warm Period (Milder temperatures and longer... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which innovative crop rotation method replaced the wasteful two-field system in medieval European farming?
qh: खेती में सुधार के लिए 'दो खेत व्यवस्था' की जगह कौन सी नई पद्धति अपनाई गई?
e: Three-field system me land ko 3 parts me baanta gaya: autumn wheat, spring oats/legumes aur one part fallow, jisse soil nitrogen maintain rahi aur output 66% tak badha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kheti mein sudhar ke lie 'do khet vyavastha' ki jagah kaun si nai paddhati apanai gai? Isi karan se Three-field crop rotation system sahi uttar hai. Hydroponic terracing, Slash and burn clearing, Monoculture planting in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Three-field crop rotation system hi hai. Exam point: Three-field crop rotation system - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the associations formed by urban master craftsmen and traders to regulate commerce called?
qh: कस्बों के व्यापारियों और कारीगरों के संघ को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Towns me har craft aur trade ka organized association hota tha jise Guild kehte the; ye quality, prices, training aur entry regulate karti thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki kasbon ke vyapariyon aur karigaron ke sangh ko kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Guilds hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Senates, Abbeys, Chapters alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Guilds hi hai. Exam point: Guilds - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What grand, soaring stone churches featuring stained-glass windows were erected across France from the 12th century?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी से फ्रांस में बने विशाल और भव्य चर्चों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: 12th century se urban centers me bishops aur guild merchants ke donation se grand Gothic Cathedrals (jaise Notre Dame, Chartres) banaye gaye. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 12vin shatabdi se phrans mein bane vishal aur bhavy charchon ko kya kaha jata hai? Yahi wajah hai ki Cathedrals (Gothic Cathedrals) sahi hai. Ziggurats, Chateaux, Stupas is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Cathedrals (Gothic Cathedrals) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Cathedrals (Gothic Cathedrals) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which devastating bubonic pandemic decimated between one-third and one-half of Europe's population in the 1340s?
qh: 14वीं शताब्दी के दौरान यूरोप में किस महामारी ने जनसंख्या का एक बड़ा हिस्सा खत्म कर दिया?
e: 1347 se 1351 ke beech 'Black Death' (plague) ne Europe ke millions logon ko kill kiya jisse acute labour shortage hui aur serfdom collapse hone laga. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 14vin shatabdi ke dauran yurop mein kis mahamari ne janasankhya ka ek bada hissa khatm kar diya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par The Black Death (Bubonic Plague) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Smallpox outbreak, Yellow fever, Cholera epidemic mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan The Black Death (Bubonic Plague) hi milti hai. Exam point: The Black Death (Bubonic Plague) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the conditional estate of land granted by a feudal lord to a knight in exchange for military service called?
qh: लॉर्ड द्वारा नाइट्स को दी गई जमीन के टुकड़े को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Lord dwara knight ko unki military obligation ke exchange me di gayi landed property ko 'Fief' (feodum) kehte the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki lord dvara naits ko di gai jamin ke tukadae ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi baat se Fief sahi sabit hota hai. Borough, Manor, Villa anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Fief sahi hai. Exam point: Fief - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which emerging socio-economic class in chartered towns came to be viewed as the 'Fourth Order'?
qh: समाज का 'चौथा वर्ग' (Fourth Order) किन्हें कहा जाता था?
o: Urban burghers, townspeople, and mercantile professionals
e: Trade revolution se medieval towns me rise hone wale wealthy merchants, free citizens aur craftsmen ko 'Fourth Order' (Burghers) kaha gaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki samaj ka 'chautha varg' (Fourth Order) kinhein kaha jata tha? Isi tathya par Urban burghers, townspeople, and mercantile professionals tika hua hai. Monastic friars, Imperial mercenaries, Manorial serfs is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Urban burghers, townspeople, and mercantile professionals hai. Exam point: Urban burghers, townspeople, and mercantile professionals - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What were the mendicant Christian monks called who chose not to live isolated in abbeys but preached among common urban people?
qh: उन भिक्षुओं को क्या कहा जाता था जो मठों में नहीं रहते थे और घूम-घूम कर उपदेश देते थे?
e: 13th century me Friars (jaise Franciscans aur Dominicans) emerge hue jo property hold nahi karte the aur sadko par ghummakkad jeevan jeete hue bhashan dete the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki un bhikshuon ko kya kaha jata tha jo mathon mein nahin rahate the aur ghum-ghum kar upadesh dete the? Isi baat se Friars (Franciscans and Dominicans) sahi sabit hota hai. Cardinals, Abbots, Deacons is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Friars (Franciscans and Dominicans) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Friars (Franciscans and Dominicans) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Anglo-Saxon monarch was defeated by William of Normandy at the Battle of Hastings in 1066?
qh: 1066 ईस्वी में विलियम ने इंग्लैंड के किस कबीले के राजा को हराकर सत्ता प्राप्त की थी?
e: Battle of Hastings (1066) me William the Conqueror ne Anglo-Saxon king Harold Godwinson ko defeat karke England ki gaddi capture ki. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 1066 isvi mein viliyam ne inglaind ke kis kabile ke raja ko harakar satta prapt ki thi? Isi karan se Anglo-Saxon king Harold II sahi uttar hai. Vikings of York, Franks, Welsh chieftains is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Anglo-Saxon king Harold II hai. Exam point: Anglo-Saxon king Harold II - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Benedictine abbess was celebrated across 12th-century Europe as a visionary composer and naturalist?
qh: भिक्षुओं और नन द्वारा गाए जाने वाले प्रार्थना गीतों में सुधार करने वाली एबेस (Abbass) कौन थीं?
e: German abbess Hildegard of Bingen ek gifted musical composer, medical writer aur mystic thi jinhone community chant liturgies compose kiye. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bhikshuon aur nan dvara gae jane vale prarthana giton mein sudhar karane vali ebes (Abbass) kaun thin? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Hildegard of Bingen hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Catherine of Siena, Joan of Arc, Mary Magdalene in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Hildegard of Bingen hai. Exam point: Hildegard of Bingen - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Frankish monarch was crowned by Pope Leo III as the first 'Holy Roman Emperor' on Christmas Day in 800 CE?
qh: पवित्र रोमन सम्राट (Holy Roman Emperor) की उपाधि चर्च ने सबसे पहले किस फ्रेंच राजा को दी थी?
e: Pope Leo III ne Rome me 800 CE ko Frankish king Charlemagne ko 'Imperator Romanorum' (Holy Roman Emperor) crown kiya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki pavitr roman samrat (Holy Roman Emperor) ki upadhi charch ne sabase pahale kis phreinch raja ko di thi? Isi baat se Charlemagne (Charles the Great) sahi sabit hota hai. Clovis I, Louis XIV, William I mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Charlemagne (Charles the Great) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Charlemagne (Charles the Great) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the consultative advisory assembly of the Three Estates summoned by the kings of France called?
qh: फ्रांस की परामर्शदात्री सभा (Consultative Assembly) को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: French monarchy jab taxation aur crises par teeno orders (clergy, nobility, commoners) ke representatives ko bulati thi, use 'Estates-General' kehte the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki phrans ki paramarshadatri sabha (Consultative Assembly) ko kya kaha jata tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isliye sahi nateeja Estates-General nikalta hai. Cortes, Parliament of Paris, Reichstag anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Estates-General hi milti hai. Exam point: Estates-General - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What were the two institutional houses of the English Parliament that crystallized by the 14th century?
qh: इंग्लैंड की संसद (Parliament) के दो सदनों के नाम क्या थे?
o: House of Lords and House of Commons
House of Princes and House of Paupers
e: English Parliament 2 chambers me evolve hui: House of Lords (hereditary nobility aur bishops) aur House of Commons (knights aur town burgesses). Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki inglaind ki sansad (Parliament) ke do sadanon ke nam kya the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par House of Lords and House of Commons hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Upper Curia and Lower Curia, Senate and Tribune Council, House of Princes and House of Paupers ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se House of Lords and House of Commons sahi hai. Exam point: House of Lords and House of Commons - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which metallurgical innovation protected draft horses' hooves and revolutionized land transportation in the 11th century?
qh: घोड़ों के पैरों की सुरक्षा के लिए सामंती काल में किस नई तकनीक का आविष्कार हुआ?
e: Iron horseshoe aur shoulder horse-collar ke introduction se horses ki pulling power multiple times badh gayi aur unke pair soft zameen par safe rahe. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki ghodaon ke pairon ki suraksha ke lie samanti kal mein kis nai takanik ka avishkar hua? Isliye sahi nateeja Iron Horseshoe nikalta hai. Wooden sabots, Hardened bronze clamps, Leather gaiters is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Iron Horseshoe sahi hai. Exam point: Iron Horseshoe - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Following the death of which Mughal Emperor in 1707 did the centralized empire fragment rapidly?
qh: मुगल साम्राज्य का पतन मुख्य रूप से किस मुगल शासक की मृत्यु के बाद तेजी से शुरू हुआ?
e: 1707 me Aurangzeb ki death ke baad weak successors, jagirdari crisis aur Maratha attacks ke chalte Mughal Empire disintegrate ho gaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mugal samrajy ka patan mukhy rup se kis mugal shasak ki mrityu ke bad teji se shuru hua? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Aurangzeb hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Akbar, Shah Jahan, Jahangir ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Aurangzeb hi hai. Exam point: Aurangzeb - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Persian conqueror invaded Delhi in 1739, plundering the Peacock Throne and the Koh-i-Noor diamond?
qh: 1739 में ईरान के किस शासक ने दिल्ली पर आक्रमण किया और भारी लूटपाट मचाई?
e: Nadir Shah ne Battle of Karnal (1739) ke baad Delhi ko sack kiya aur Shah Jahan ka Peacock Throne aur Kohinoor loot kar le gaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 1739 mein iran ke kis shasak ne dilli par akraman kiya aur bhari lutapat machai? Yahi wajah hai ki Nadir Shah sahi hai. Ahmad Shah Abdali, Genghis Khan, Timur mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Nadir Shah hi milti hai. Exam point: Nadir Shah - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who founded the autonomous princely state of Hyderabad in the Deccan in 1724?
qh: अठारहवीं शताब्दी में हैदराबाद राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Chin Qilich Khan (Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah) ne Delhi court politics se alag hokar 1724 me Hyderabad state ki sovereign foundation rakhi. Prashn yah batata hai ki atharahavin shatabdi mein haidarabad rajy ki sthapana kisane ki thi? Isi karan se Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah (Chin Qilich Khan) sahi uttar hai. Alivardi Khan, Saadat Khan, Murshid Quli Khan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah (Chin Qilich Khan) hi milti hai. Exam point: Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah (Chin Qilich Khan) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who established the autonomous hereditary governorship of Awadh in 1722?
qh: अवध के स्वतंत्र राज्य का संस्थापक किसे माना जाता है?
e: Saadat Khan Burhan-ul-Mulk ne 1722 me Awadh ka subadar appoint hokar regional dynasty establish ki aur local zamindars ko subdue kiya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki avadh ke svatantr rajy ka sansthapak kise mana jata hai? In tathyon ke chalte Burhan-ul-Mulk Saadat Khan hi sahi hai. Safdarjung, Asaf-ud-Daula, Wajid Ali Shah anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Burhan-ul-Mulk Saadat Khan hi hai. Exam point: Burhan-ul-Mulk Saadat Khan - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Under which provincial administrator did Bengal emerge as an autonomous regional polity detached from Delhi's control?
qh: मुर्शिद कुली खान के नेतृत्व में कौन सा क्षेत्र मुगल नियंत्रण से अलग होकर एक स्वतंत्र राज्य बना?
e: Murshid Quli Khan ne provincial capital Murshidabad shift ki aur Bengal ke financial revenue system ko consolidate karke independent nawabi run ki. Is prashn ka kendra Bengal hai. Isi karan se Bengal sahi uttar hai. Awadh, Hyderabad, Carnatic anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Bengal hi milti hai. Exam point: Bengal - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What did the fiscal system of 'Ijaradari' denote in 18th-century successor states?
qh: अठारहवीं शताब्दी के राज्यों में 'इजारदारी' (Ijaradari) प्रथा का संबंध किससे था?
o: Revenue farming system leased to the highest bidding contractors
e: Ijaradari revenue-farming contract system tha jahan state fixed sum ke badle tax collection rights highest bidder (ijaradar) ko lease kar deta tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki atharahavin shatabdi ke rajyon mein 'ijaradari' (Ijaradari) pratha ka sanbandh kisase tha? Isi karan se Revenue farming system leased to the highest bidding contractors sahi uttar hai. Secular educational grants, Military draft conscription, Religious patronage stipends is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Revenue farming system leased to the highest bidding contractors hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Revenue farming system leased to the highest bidding contractors - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Sikh Guru transformed the Sikh community into the martial and political order of the Khalsa in 1699?
qh: सिखों को एक राजनीतिक और सैन्य शक्ति के रूप में संगठित करने का श्रेय किसे दिया जाता है?
e: Guru Gobind Singh Ji ne 1699 me Khalsa order create kiya jisse Sikhs Mughal oppression ke against saint-soldier community ban gaye. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki sikhon ko ek rajanitik aur sainy shakti ke rup mein sangathit karane ka shrey kise diya jata hai? Isi aadhar par Guru Gobind Singh chuna jaata hai. Banda Singh Bahadur, Guru Nanak Dev, Maharaja Ranjit Singh mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Guru Gobind Singh hai. Exam point: Guru Gobind Singh - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who assumed military command of the Sikh forces following Guru Gobind Singh's assassination in 1708?
qh: गुरु गोबिंद सिंह की मृत्यु के बाद सिखों का नेतृत्व किसने किया और मुगलों के खिलाफ विद्रोह जारी रखा?
e: Banda Singh Bahadur ne Punjab me peasant uprising organize kiya, Guru Nanak aur Guru Gobind Singh ke coins issue kiye aur Lohgarh ko capital banaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki guru gobind sinh ki mrityu ke bad sikhon ka netritv kisane kiya aur mugalon ke khilaph vidroh jari rakha? Isi karan se Banda Singh Bahadur sahi uttar hai. Ranjit Singh, Jassa Singh Ahluwalia, Kapur Singh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Banda Singh Bahadur baithta hai. Exam point: Banda Singh Bahadur - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the combined military confederacy of the various Sikh Jathas and Misls termed?
qh: सिखों के विभिन्न जत्थों और मिसलों की संयुक्त सेना को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Sikh jathas ke unified army umbrella ko 'Dal Khalsa' kehte the jo Baisakhi aur Diwali par Amritsar me collective decisions (Gurmata) leti thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki sikhon ke vibhinn jatthon aur misalon ki sanyukt sena ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi tathya par Dal Khalsa tika hua hai. Khalsa Fauj, Nihang Jatha, Akal Sena anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Dal Khalsa hi milti hai. Exam point: Dal Khalsa - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who founded the sovereign Maratha state in the 17th century by challenging Bijapur and the Mughals?
qh: मराठा साम्राज्य की नींव 17वीं शताब्दी में किसने रखी थी?
e: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj ne Western Ghats me guerrilla (ganimi kava) warfare se Deccan me sovereign Swarajya establish kiya aur 1674 me Raigad me coronation karwaya. Prashn yah batata hai ki maratha samrajy ki ninv 17vin shatabdi mein kisane rakhi thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj hi sahi baithta hai. Sambhaji, Balaji Vishwanath, Baji Rao I is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj hi milti hai. Exam point: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: To which executive office was the post of 'Peshwa' equivalent in the Maratha Empire?
qh: मराठा प्रशासन में 'पेशवा' (Peshwa) का पद किसके समान था?
e: Shahu Maharaj ke tenure se Balaji Vishwanath aur unke successors (Peshwas) Maratha confederacy ke de facto chief ministers aur leaders ban gaye. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki maratha prashasan mein 'peshava' (Peshwa) ka pad kisake saman tha? peshwa Maratha sangh ka mukhya pradhan hota tha tatha ashta pradhan mandal ka sabse bada pad tha. Isi karan se Chief Prime Minister / Executive Head sahi uttar hai. Foreign ambassador, Commander-in-Chief (Senapati), High Royal Judge in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Chief Prime Minister / Executive Head sahi hai. Exam point: Chief Prime Minister / Executive Head - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the tax amounting to 25% of land revenue demanded by the Marathas from non-Maratha territories?
qh: मराठों द्वारा पड़ोसी राज्यों से वसूले जाने वाले भू-राजस्व के 25% हिस्से को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Chauth (literal 1/4th) standard 25% land revenue demand thi jo Marathas neighbouring kingdoms se raiding avoid karne aur military protection ke badle lete the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki marathon dvara padaosi rajyon se vasule jane vale bhu-rajasv ke 25% hisse ko kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Chauth hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Jizya, Kharaj, Sardeshmukhi ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Chauth hai. Exam point: Chauth - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the additional 9-10% revenue levy collected by Marathas as hereditary overlords of the Deccan?
qh: मराठों द्वारा मुख्य राजस्व अधिकारी होने के नाते लिया जाने वाला 9-10% अतिरिक्त कर क्या कहलाता था?
e: Sardeshmukhi 9-10% surcharge tha jo Shivaji Maharaj aur unke successors Deccan ke hereditary head headman (Sardeshmukh) hone ke ground par collect karte the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki marathon dvara mukhy rajasv adhikari hone ke nate liya jane vala 9-10% atirikt kar kya kahalata tha? zakat musalmanon ki sampatti par lagne wala dharmik kar tha. In tathyon ke chalte Sardeshmukhi hi sahi hai. Vikalp Zakat, Bali, Chauth bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Sardeshmukhi hi hai. Exam point: Sardeshmukhi - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Between which two formidable powers was the Third Battle of Panipat fought on 14 January 1761?
qh: 1761 में पानीपत की तीसरी लड़ाई मराठों और किसके बीच हुई थी?
o: Ahmad Shah Abdali (Durrani) and the Marathas
The English East India Company and Marathas
e: 14 January 1761 ko Afghan king Ahmad Shah Abdali ne Sadashivrao Bhau ki command wali Maratha confederacy army ko Panipat me defeat kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1761 mein panipat ki tisari ladai marathon aur kisake bich hui thi? Shivaji Maratha raj ke sansthapak the jinhone apne rajy mein vyavasthit sasan khada kiya. Isi karan se Ahmad Shah Abdali (Durrani) and the Marathas sahi uttar hai. Aurangzeb and Shivaji, Nadir Shah and Marathas, The English East India Company and Marathas anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Ahmad Shah Abdali (Durrani) and the Marathas baithta hai. Exam point: Ahmad Shah Abdali (Durrani) and the Marathas - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Under which dynamic ruler did the Jat kingdom of Bharatpur attain its apex of political and military power?
qh: भरतपुर के जाट राज्य को एक शक्तिशाली राज्य के रूप में किसने संगठित किया?
e: Maharaja Suraj Mal ne Bharatpur ko strong kingdom banaya, unhe administrative brilliance aur diplomacy ke chalte 'Plato of the Jat tribe' kaha jata hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharatapur ke jat rajy ko ek shaktishali rajy ke rup mein kisane sangathit kiya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Maharaja Suraj Mal hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Churaman, Badan Singh, Jawahar Singh ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Maharaja Suraj Mal hi milti hai. Exam point: Maharaja Suraj Mal - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In the Mughal court hierarchy, who were designated by the collective plural term 'Umara'?
qh: मुगल काल में 'उमरा' (Umara) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: High-ranking imperial nobility and grand mansabdars
e: Umara (Amir ka plural) Mughal administration ke top-tier elite mansabdars aur high-ranking nobles ke group ko denote karta tha. Is sawaal mein High-ranking imperial nobility and grand mansabdars ki baat hai. Isi aadhar par High-ranking imperial nobility and grand mansabdars chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - Village peasantry, Guild financiers, Artisan day laborers - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar High-ranking imperial nobility and grand mansabdars hi hai. Exam point: High-ranking imperial nobility and grand mansabdars - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were the hereditary ancestral estates of the Rajput princes recognized by the Mughal crown called?
qh: राजपूत शासकों को मुगल साम्राज्य के तहत दी गई उनकी जागीरें क्या कहलाती थीं?
e: Mughals Rajput rulers ko unki hereditary homeland territories me internal autonomy dete the jise 'Watan Jagir' kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki rajaput shasakon ko mugal samrajy ke tahat di gai unaki jagirein kya kahalati thin? iqta ek jagir wali vyavastha thi jismein sultan sipahiyon ko zameen ki aay ka haq deta tha. Isi karan se Watan Jagirs sahi uttar hai. Iqta jagirs, Khalisa, Madad-i-Maash anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Watan Jagirs hi milti hai. Exam point: Watan Jagirs - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which premier historic city did Maharaja Ranjit Singh establish as his sovereign capital in 1799?
qh: 1799 में महाराजा रणजीत सिंह ने किस शहर को अपनी राजधानी बनाया था?
e: Maharaja Ranjit Singh ne rival Sikh misls ko unite karke 1799 me Lahore conquer kiya aur use apni sovereign Sikh kingdom ki political capital banaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1799 mein maharaja ranajit sinh ne kis shahar ko apani rajadhani banaya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Lahore nikalta hai. Ludhiana, Patiala, Amritsar mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Lahore sahi hai. Exam point: Lahore - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: How many times did Afghan ruler Ahmad Shah Abdali invade and plunder North India between 1748 and 1761?
qh: अफ़गान शासक अहमद शाह अब्दाली ने 1748 से 1761 के बीच उत्तर भारत पर कितनी बार आक्रमण किया?
e: Ahmad Shah Abdali ne Punjab aur Delhi par 1748 se 1761 ke beech 5 major invasions kiye aur Mughal authority ko shatter kar diya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki aphagan shasak ahamad shah abdali ne 1748 se 1761 ke bich uttar bharat par kitani bar akraman kiya? Isi tathya par Five times tika hua hai. Three times, Ten times, Once ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Five times hai. Exam point: Five times - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which astronomer-king of Amber/Jaipur constructed the famous Jantar Mantar masonry observatories?
qh: जयपुर के किस शासक ने खगोलीय वेधशालाओं (जंतर-मंतर) का निर्माण करवाया था?
e: Sawai Jai Singh II ne accurate celestial calculations ke liye Delhi, Jaipur, Ujjain, Mathura aur Varanasi me 5 Jantar Mantar observatories banwayi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki jayapur ke kis shasak ne khagoliy vedhashalaon (jantar-mantar) ka nirman karavaya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Sawai Jai Singh II nikalta hai. Vikalp Ajit Singh, Maharaja Suraj Mal, Raja Man Singh bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Sawai Jai Singh II hai. Exam point: Sawai Jai Singh II - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The 9th-century Chera kingdom of Mahodayapuram was situated in which present-day state of India?
qh: 9वीं शताब्दी में स्थापित 'महोदयपुरम का चेर राज्य' वर्तमान भारत के किस राज्य का हिस्सा था?
e: 9th century me Mahodayapuram (modern Kodungallur) me re-established Chera kingdom Kerala ke coastal belt me situated tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 9vin shatabdi mein sthapit 'mahodayapuram ka cher rajy' vartaman bharat ke kis rajy ka hissa tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Kerala sahi nikalta hai. Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Kerala hi hai. Exam point: Kerala - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which regional vernacular language and script were officially introduced by the Cheras in their royal inscriptions?
qh: चेर शासकों ने अपने अभिलेखों में किस क्षेत्रीय भाषा और लिपि का प्रयोग सबसे पहले शुरू किया था?
e: Chera rulers ne apne official temple inscriptions me regional language Malayalam use karna start kiya, jo vernacular state use ka early example hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki cher shasakon ne apane abhilekhon mein kis kshetriy bhasha aur lipi ka prayog sabase pahale shuru kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Malayalam hi sahi baithta hai. Tamil, Kannada, Telugu anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Malayalam hai. Exam point: Malayalam - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which composite literary style ('diamonds and corals') was the 14th-century grammatical text 'Lilatilakam' written?
qh: 14वीं शताब्दी का ग्रंथ 'लीलातिलकम' (Lilatilakam), जो व्याकरण और काव्यशास्त्र से संबंधित है, किस शैली में लिखा गया था?
e: Lilatilakam grammar text 'Manipravalam' (mani = ruby/coral, pravalam = pearl/diamond) style me likha gaya tha jo Sanskrit aur Malayalam ka blend tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 14vin shatabdi ka granth 'lilatilakam' (Lilatilakam), jo vyakaran aur kavyashastr se sanbandhit hai, kis shaili mein likha gaya tha? Isi baat se Manipravalam sahi sabit hota hai. Nagara, Vesara, Dravida mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Manipravalam hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Manipravalam - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: With which supreme Hindu divinity is the celebrated temple of Lord Jagannatha at Puri identified?
qh: ओडिशा के पुरी में स्थित 'जगन्नाथ मंदिर' का संबंध किस मुख्य देवता से है?
o: Lord Vishnu (as Lord of the World)
e: Puri ke Jagannath temple me tribal deity origin se evolve hokar Lord Jagannath ko Lord Vishnu/Krishna ka supreme form maana jata hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki odisha ke puri mein sthit 'jagannath mandir' ka sanbandh kis mukhy devata se hai? Isliye antim jawab Lord Vishnu (as Lord of the World) ke roop mein milta hai. Lord Shiva, Lord Surya, Lord Brahma mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Lord Vishnu (as Lord of the World) hi hai. Exam point: Lord Vishnu (as Lord of the World) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Ganga dynasty monarch commissioned the construction of the monumental Jagannatha Temple at Puri in the 12th century?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी में किस शासक ने पुरी में 'पुरुषोत्तम जगन्नाथ' के लिए मंदिर बनवाने का निश्चय किया था?
e: Eastern Ganga dynasty ke ruler Anantavarman Chodaganga ne 12th century me Purushottama Jagannath ke grand temple construction ka order diya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 12vin shatabdi mein kis shasak ne puri mein 'purushottam jagannath' ke lie mandir banavane ka nishchay kiya tha? Isi karan se Anantavarman Chodaganga sahi uttar hai. Raja Man Singh, Rajaraja I, Anangabhima III mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Anantavarman Chodaganga baithta hai. Exam point: Anantavarman Chodaganga - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: By what overarching territorial designation did British colonial records refer to the region of present-day Rajasthan?
qh: ब्रिटिश अधिकारी वर्तमान राजस्थान के अधिकांश भाग को किस नाम से पुकारते थे?
e: 19th century me Britishers modern Rajasthan ke Rajput-dominated princely states ke geographic belt ko 'Rajputana' kehte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki british adhikari vartaman rajasthan ke adhikansh bhag ko kis nam se pukarate the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Rajputana hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Marusthali, Mewar Agency, Marwar Provice anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Rajputana hai. Exam point: Rajputana - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which class of hereditary bardic minstrels preserved and recited the heroic ballads of Rajput warriors?
qh: राजपूत शासकों के दरबारों में उनकी बहादुरी की कहानियों को गीतों के रूप में कौन गाते थे?
e: Charans aur Bhats professional bard communities thi jo Rajput heroes ke valor, sacrifice aur chivalric tales ko poetic songs me compose aur preserve karte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki rajaput shasakon ke darabaron mein unaki bahaduri ki kahaniyon ko giton ke rup mein kaun gate the? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isi tathya par Charans and Bhats (Minstrels) tika hua hai. Galti Foreign scribes, Brahmin priests, Sufi dervishes chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Charans and Bhats (Minstrels) baithta hai. Exam point: Charans and Bhats (Minstrels) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What heroic custom of collective self-immolation did Rajput women enact upon facing imminent military defeat?
qh: राजपूत स्त्रियों के वीरतापूर्ण कार्यों में 'जौहर' का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Jauhar (Mass voluntary self-immolation in funeral flames)
e: Defeat ke situation me enemy ke dishonor se bachne ke liye Rajput women mass level par fire pyre me jump karke 'Jauhar' karti thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki rajaput striyon ke viratapurn karyon mein 'jauhar' ka kya arth tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Jauhar (Mass voluntary self-immolation in funeral flames) sahi nikalta hai. Vikalp Undertaking diplomatic emissary roles, Surrendering as military captives, Founding private dynastic shrines bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Jauhar (Mass voluntary self-immolation in funeral flames) hi hai. Exam point: Jauhar (Mass voluntary self-immolation in funeral flames) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: From which region and tradition of northern temple storytellers did the classical dance 'Kathak' originate?
qh: 'कथक' (Kathak) नृत्य शैली का मूल रूप से संबंध किस क्षेत्र से है?
e: Kathak word 'Katha' (story) se bana hai; ye originally North India ke temples me devotional stories recite karne wale storytellers (kathakars) ka dance tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 'kathak' (Kathak) nrity shaili ka mul rup se sanbandh kis kshetr se hai? Isliye antim jawab North India ke roop mein milta hai. Manipur valleys, Coastal Odisha, South India in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab North India hai. Exam point: North India - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Under the patronage of which last Nawab of Awadh did Kathak evolve into an expressive, recognized classical court dance?
qh: अवध के किस अंतिम नवाब के संरक्षण में 'कथक' एक प्रमुख कला रूप में विकसित हुआ?
e: Awadh ke last nawab Wajid Ali Shah khud trained dancer aur poet the; unke royal court patronage me Lucknow gharana of Kathak flourish hua. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki avadh ke kis antim navab ke sanrakshan mein 'kathak' ek pramukh kala rup mein vikasit hua? Isi karan se Wajid Ali Shah sahi uttar hai. Asaf-ud-Daula, Saadat Khan, Shuja-ud-Daula ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Wajid Ali Shah hi milti hai. Exam point: Wajid Ali Shah - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What art style designates the fine, small-scale paintings executed in watercolors on palm leaf, paper, or cloth?
qh: राजस्थान और हिमाचल प्रदेश के क्षेत्रों में विकसित लघु चित्रों की शैली को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Small-scale detailed paintings jo watercolours se paper, cloth ya wood par execute ki jaati thi, unhe 'Miniatures' (laghu chitra) kehte hain. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rajasthan aur himachal pradesh ke kshetron mein vikasit laghu chitron ki shaili ko kya kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Miniatures hi sahi baithta hai. Illuminated steles, Oil canvases, Fresco murals is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Miniatures hai. Exam point: Miniatures - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which bold, emotionally intense early school of miniature painting blossomed in the Himalayan foothills of Basohli?
qh: हिमाचल प्रदेश की तलहटी में विकसित लघु चित्रकला की साहसी और भावप्रवण शैली को क्या नाम दिया गया है?
e: 17th century ke end me Jammu/Himachal foothills me vibrant bold colors aur high emotional intensity wali 'Basohli school' of painting emerge hui. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki himachal pradesh ki talahati mein vikasit laghu chitrakala ki sahasi aur bhavapravan shaili ko kya nam diya gaya hai? Isi baat se Basohli style sahi sabit hota hai. Mewar style, Mughal court style, Kangra school is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Basohli style hi hai. Exam point: Basohli style - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where did Mughal court artists seek asylum following Nadir Shah's sacking of Delhi in 1739, giving birth to the Kangra style?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी के मध्य में नादिर शाह के आक्रमण के बाद मुगल कलाकार कहाँ शरण लेने भाग गए थे?
e: Delhi me political chaos aur Nadir Shah ke loot ke baad Mughal trained painters Himachal/Pahari hills bhaage jahan Kangra school of art originate hua. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 18vin shatabdi ke madhy mein nadir shah ke akraman ke bad mugal kalakar kahan sharan lene bhag gae the? Isi aadhar par Himalayan foothills (Pahari region) chuna jaata hai. Coastal Coromandel, Deccan sultanates, Sri Lankan royal court is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Himalayan foothills (Pahari region) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Himalayan foothills (Pahari region) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: From which classical language is the formal grammar and early vocabulary of Bengali derived?
qh: बंगाली भाषा का उद्भव मूल रूप से किस भाषा से माना जाता है?
e: Bengali language Magadhi Prakrit ke through Sanskrit roots se derive hui hai, halanki ispe Persian, Arabic aur tribal languages ka heavy influence raha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki bangali bhasha ka udbhav mul rup se kis bhasha se mana jata hai? Isi tathya par Sanskrit tika hua hai. Classical Pali, Modern Hindi, Persian is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Sanskrit hai. Exam point: Sanskrit - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In the historical context of deltaic Bengal, who was reverentially referred to as a 'Pir'?
qh: बंगाल में 'पीर' (Pir) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: A revered spiritual preceptor, saint, or pioneering community leader
e: Bengal ke forest settlements me local communities Sufi saints, spiritual guides aur forest clearance karne wale respected leaders ko 'Pir' kehti thi. Yahaan A revered spiritual preceptor, saint, or pioneering community leader se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isliye sahi nateeja A revered spiritual preceptor, saint, or pioneering community leader nikalta hai. A marine pilot, A royal tax collector, An armed cavalryman ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan A revered spiritual preceptor, saint, or pioneering community leader hi milti hai. Exam point: A revered spiritual preceptor, saint, or pioneering... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What architectural roof form featuring two sloped curved thatch-style gables developed in medieval Bengal?
qh: बंगाल के मंदिरों की छतों की विशिष्ट शैली, जिसमें दो ढलान वाली छतें होती थीं, क्या कहलाती थी?
e: Bengal me curved bamboo thatch roofs ko replicate karke temples banaye jaate the: 2-roofs wale structure ko 'Do-chala' aur 4-roofs wale ko 'Chau-chala' kehte the. Prashn yah batata hai ki bangal ke mandiron ki chhaton ki vishisht shaili, jisamein do dhalan vali chhatein hoti thin, kya kahalati thi? Isi karan se Do-chala sahi uttar hai. Flat trabeated terrace, Hexagonal dome, Chau-chala alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Do-chala hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Do-chala - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which 13th-century Sanskrit ritual manual from Bengal officially relaxed dietary taboos to permit local Brahmins to consume fish?
qh: 13वीं शताब्दी के किस संस्कृत ग्रंथ ने बंगाल के ब्राह्मणों को मछली खाने की अनुमति दी थी?
e: Brihaddharma Purana ne Bengal me fish ki high dietary ubiquity ko recognize karte hue local Brahmins ko specific white-scaled fish khane ki religious sanction di. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 13vin shatabdi ke kis sanskrit granth ne bangal ke brahmanon ko machhali khane ki anumati di thi? arthashastra Kautilya ki wo kitaab hai jo rajya chalane ki niti batati hai. Yahi wajah hai ki Brihaddharma Purana sahi hai. Manusmriti, Yajnavalkya Smriti, Arthashastra anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Brihaddharma Purana hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Brihaddharma Purana - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: For what exquisite decorative exterior finish are the historic temples of Bishnupur in Bankura (Bengal) renowned?
qh: बंगाल के बांकुरा जिले में स्थित 'बिष्णुपुर' के मंदिर अपनी किस सजावट के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं?
o: Ornate carved terracotta brick tiles and bas-relief murals
e: Malla kings ke Bishnupur temples me brick walls par Ramayana aur Krishna-leela ke scenes carved Terracotta tiles se decorate kiye gaye hain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bangal ke bankura jile mein sthit 'bishnupur' ke mandir apani kis sajavat ke lie prasiddh hain? Isi karan se Ornate carved terracotta brick tiles and bas-relief murals sahi uttar hai. White Makrana marble panels, Stained Venetian mirrors, Gold leaf gilding is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Ornate carved terracotta brick tiles and bas-relief murals hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Ornate carved terracotta brick tiles and bas-relief... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What aesthetic qualities defined the lyrical Kangra school of Pahari painting?
qh: कांगड़ा चित्रकला शैली (Kangra school of painting) की मुख्य विशेषता क्या थी?
o: Soft lyrical execution using cool blues and greens with poetic treatment of Krishna themes
e: Kangra painting cool blues aur greens ke delicate use, lyrical poetry aur Radha-Krishna ke bhakti themes ke graceful representation ke liye famous hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki kangada chitrakala shaili (Kangra school of painting) ki mukhy visheshata kya thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Soft lyrical execution using cool blues and greens with poetic treatment of Krishna themes hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Harsh monochromatic brushwork, Unpolished stone engraving, Martial combat depictions only chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Soft lyrical execution using cool blues and... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Soft lyrical execution using cool blues and... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who emerged as the foremost saint-leader of the ecstatic Gaudiya Vaishnava Bhakti movement in Bengal?
qh: बंगाल में वैष्णव भक्ति आंदोलन के सबसे प्रमुख नेता कौन थे?
e: 16th century me Chaitanya Mahaprabhu ne Bengal me Gaudiya Vaishnavism lead kiya aur group singing (Sankirtana) ke through Krishna bhakti spread ki. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bangal mein vaishnav bhakti andolan ke sabase pramukh neta kaun the? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Isi aadhar par Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (Chaitanya Deva) chuna jaata hai. Namdev, Ramanuja, Kabir anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (Chaitanya Deva) hi hai. Exam point: Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (Chaitanya Deva) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who propounded the influential philosophical system of radical non-dualism known as 'Advaita' in 8th-century India?
qh: भक्ति आंदोलन के संदर्भ में 'अद्वैतवाद' (Advaita) का सिद्धांत किसने प्रतिपादित किया था?
e: Kerala me born Adi Shankaracharya ne Advaita philosophy di jiske according Atman aur Param-Brahman identical hain aur material world Maya hai.
