Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bhakti andolan ke sandarbh mein 'advaitavad' (Advaita) ka siddhant kisane pratipadit kiya tha? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. In tathyon ke chalte Adi Shankaracharya hi sahi hai. Basavanna, Ramanuja, Namdev mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Adi Shankaracharya hi milti hai. Exam point: Adi Shankaracharya - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to the philosophy of Shankaracharya, what is the fundamental nature of ultimate 'Brahman'?
qh: शंकराचार्य के अनुसार 'ब्रह्म' का स्वरूप कैसा है?
o: Nirguna, formless, attribute-less, and the sole immutable cosmic reality
e: Shankaracharya ne sikhaya ki Brahman 'Nirguna' aur 'Nirakara' (without physical attributes/form) hai aur knowledge (Jnana) se hi uski realization possible hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki shankarachary ke anusar 'brahm' ka svarup kaisa hai? Isi karan se Nirguna, formless, attribute-less, and the sole immutable cosmic reality sahi uttar hai. Physical human king, Anthropomorphic Saguna form, Plural assembly of local deities is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Nirguna, formless, attribute-less, and the sole immutable cosmic reality hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Nirguna, formless, attribute-less, and the sole immutable cosmic reality - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which theological doctrine of qualified non-dualism was expounded by the 11th-century Tamil saint Ramanuja?
qh: 11वीं शताब्दी में तमिलनाडु में जन्मे 'रामानुज' (Ramanuja) किस विचारधारा के समर्थक थे?
e: Ramanuja ne 'Vishishtadvaita' diya jiske according soul (Atman) Supreme God (Brahman) se unite hone ke baad bhi apni conscious individuality preserve karti hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 11vin shatabdi mein tamilanadu mein janme 'ramanuj' (Ramanuja) kis vicharadhara ke samarthak the? Isliye antim jawab Vishishtadvaita (Qualified Non-Dualism) ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - Shunyavada, Kevala Advaita, Dvaita - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Vishishtadvaita (Qualified Non-Dualism) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Vishishtadvaita (Qualified Non-Dualism) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Tamil devotional saint-poets deeply inspired the theological formulations of Ramanuja?
qh: रामानुज किन संतों से बहुत अधिक प्रभावित थे?
e: Ramanuja Vishnu-bhakta Alvars ke hymns se deeply influenced the aur unhone devotional surrender (Prapatti) ko salvation ka highest path maana. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki ramanuj kin santon se bahut adhik prabhavit the? vedic kaal woh samay hai jab ved tatha yagya-karm pramukh the. Isi baat se The Alvars sahi sabit hota hai. Vedic sacrificial hotras, Nayanars, Nathpanthis is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad The Alvars hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: The Alvars - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The South Indian 'Nayanar' saints were the devotional worshippers of which Hindu divinity?
qh: नयनार (Nayanars) संत किस हिंदू देवता के उपासक थे?
e: Nayanars Lord Shiva ke ardent devotees the, jabki Alvars Lord Vishnu ke worshippers the. Yah prashn nayanar se juda hai. nayanar dakshin bharat ke shaiv sant the. Isliye antim jawab Lord Shiva ke roop mein milta hai. Lord Vishnu, Lord Brahma, Goddess Durga ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Lord Shiva hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Lord Shiva - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What are the traditional canonical counts of the Nayanar and Alvar saints respectively?
qh: नयनार और अलवार संतों की कुल संख्या क्रमशः कितनी मानी जाती है?
e: Tamil tradition me 63 Shaivite Nayanars (Tevaram me collected) aur 12 Vaishnavite Alvars record kiye gaye hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki nayanar aur alavar santon ki kul sankhya kramashah kitani mani jati hai? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi karan se 63 Nayanars and 12 Alvars sahi uttar hai. 100 Nayanars and 50 Alvars, 24 Nayanars and 10 Alvars, 12 Nayanars and 63 Alvars in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 63 Nayanars and 12 Alvars hi milti hai. Exam point: 63 Nayanars and 12 Alvars - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who initiated the Virashaiva socio-religious movement through revolutionary Kannada Vachana poetry?
qh: कर्नाटक में 'वीरशैव आंदोलन' (Virashaiva movement) की शुरुआत किसने की थी?
e: Basavanna, Allama Prabhu aur Akka Mahadevi ne 12th century Kalachuri court me Virashaiva movement chalaya jo Shiva par focused tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki karnatak mein 'virashaiv andolan' (Virashaiva movement) ki shuruat kisane ki thi? Isi aadhar par Basavanna chuna jaata hai. Ramanuja, Eknath, Jnaneshwar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Basavanna hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Basavanna - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Against which entrenched socio-religious orthodoxies did the Virashaiva movement vehemently protest?
qh: वीरशैवों ने किस सामाजिक बुराई के विरुद्ध प्रबल तर्क दिए थे?
o: Brahmanical caste hierarchies, temple ritualism, and institutional gender discrimination
e: Virashaivas ne caste inequality, idol worship, temple monopoly aur women ke subjugation ko Vachanas ke through fiercely reject kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki virashaivon ne kis samajik burai ke viruddh prabal tark die the? Isi karan se Brahmanical caste hierarchies, temple ritualism, and institutional gender discrimination sahi uttar hai. Agricultural barter, Universal literacy, Widow remarriage ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Brahmanical caste hierarchies, temple ritualism, and institutional... hai. Exam point: Brahmanical caste hierarchies, temple ritualism, and institutional gender discrimination - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which pilgrimage temple at Pandharpur served as the supreme epicentre for the Varkari Bhakti saints of Maharashtra?
qh: महाराष्ट्र के पंढरपुर में भक्ति का केंद्र कौन सा मंदिर था?
e: Pandharpur ka Vitthala (Vithoba - Vishnu ka localized avatar) temple Maharashtra ke Varkari saints (Dnyaneshwar, Tukaram) ki Bhakti ka main center tha. Is sawaal mein bhakti ki baat hai. bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Isliye sahi nateeja Vitthala Temple nikalta hai. Golden Temple, Somnath Temple, Virupaksha Temple is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Vitthala Temple hai. Exam point: Vitthala Temple - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: To which social caste, traditionally classified as 'untouchable', did the Marathi saint-poet Chokhamela belong?
qh: महाराष्ट्र के प्रसिद्ध संत 'चोखामेला' (Chokhamela) किस वर्ग से संबंधित थे?
e: Sant Chokhamela Mahar community se belong karte the; unke abhangas social discrimination aur pure inner devotion ka deep record hain. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki maharashtr ke prasiddh sant 'chokhamela' (Chokhamela) kis varg se sanbandhit the? Isi karan se Mahar caste sahi uttar hai. Vaishya grain merchant, Maratha warrior gentry, Brahmin priestly order is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Mahar caste hai. Exam point: Mahar caste - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What spiritual path to ultimate liberation was championed by the Nathpanthis, Siddhas, and Yogis?
qh: नाथपंथियों, सिद्धों और योगियों ने मोक्ष पाने के लिए किस पर बल दिया?
o: Intensive mind-body discipline through yogic postures, breath control, and meditation on the formless reality
e: Nathpanthis aur Yogis ne world renunciation, asanas (postures), pranayama (breathing) aur meditation se Sahaja realization par stress diya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki nathapanthiyon, siddhon aur yogiyon ne moksh pane ke lie kis par bal diya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Intensive mind-body discipline through yogic postures, breath control, and meditation on the formless reality hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Lavish temple financial donations, Martial combat rituals, Exclusive Vedic Sanskrit recitation - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Intensive mind-body discipline through yogic postures, breath control, and meditation on the formless reality baithta hai. Exam point: Intensive mind-body discipline through yogic postures, breath control, and meditation on the formless reality - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In Sufi institutional nomenclature, what is meant by a 'Silsila'?
qh: सूफी संतों के संदर्भ में 'सिलसिला' (Silsila) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: A continuous spiritual genealogy and lineage connecting masters back to Prophet Muhammad
e: Silsila Sufi orders ki spiritual genealogy (unbroken chain) hoti hai jisme har master apne successor ko spiritual lineage pass karta hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki suphi santon ke sandarbh mein 'silasila' (Silsila) shabd ka kya arth hai? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isi aadhar par A continuous spiritual genealogy and lineage connecting masters back to Prophet Muhammad chuna jaata hai. A communal kitchen menu, A musical instrument, An iron penitential chain alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se A continuous spiritual genealogy and lineage connecting masters back to Prophet Muhammad sahi hai. Exam point: A continuous spiritual genealogy and lineage connecting masters back to Prophet Muhammad - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which became the most culturally pervasive and widely embraced Sufi order across the Indian subcontinent?
qh: भारत में सबसे प्रभावशाली सूफी सिलसिला कौन सा था?
e: Chishti silsila India me sabse popular aur integrated bana kyunki unhone musical gatherings (Sama), local idioms aur open hospitality adopt ki. Prashn yah batata hai ki bharat mein sabase prabhavashali suphi silasila kaun sa tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Chishti Silsila sahi nikalta hai. Naqshbandi, Qadiri, Suhrawardi mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Chishti Silsila hi milti hai. Exam point: Chishti Silsila - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the specialized communal lodging and assembly complex of a Sufi master called?
qh: सूफी संत जहाँ अपनी सभाएँ आयोजित करते थे, उन स्थानों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Khanqah Sufi master ka monastic community centre hota tha jahan murids spiritual training lete the aur communal langar chalta tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki suphi sant jahan apani sabhaen ayojit karate the, un sthanon ko kya kaha jata tha? vihara bhikshuon ke rehne wala vihar hota tha. Isi karan se Khanqah (Hospice) sahi uttar hai. Vihara, Akhara, Matha is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Khanqah (Hospice) baithta hai. Exam point: Khanqah (Hospice) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which occupational household community was the saint-poet Kabir Das raised in Varanasi?
qh: संत कबीर का पालन-पोषण किस परिवार में हुआ था?
e: Kabir ka palan-poshan Varanasi me ek newly-converted Muslim weaver (Julaha) family me hua tha, jo unki textile metaphors me jhalakta hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki sant kabir ka palan-poshan kis parivar mein hua tha? Isi karan se Muslim Julaha (Weaver) household sahi uttar hai. Brahmin temple clergy, Khatri merchant home, Rajput warrior lineage alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Muslim Julaha (Weaver) household baithta hai. Exam point: Muslim Julaha (Weaver) household - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which textual repositories preserve the revolutionary verses and sakhis composed by Sant Kabir?
qh: कबीर की रचनाओं और उपदेशों को किन ग्रंथों में सुरक्षित किया गया है?
o: Both Bijak/Panchvani and the Guru Granth Sahib
e: Kabir ke verses Bijak (Kabirpanthi tradition), Panchvani (Dadu panth, Rajasthan) aur Adi Granth (Sikh tradition) teeno me preserved hain. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kabir ki rachanaon aur upadeshon ko kin granthon mein surakshit kiya gaya hai? Isi karan se Both Bijak/Panchvani and the Guru Granth Sahib sahi uttar hai. Bijak and Panchvani, The Guru Granth Sahib, Valmiki Ramayana exclusively in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Both Bijak/Panchvani and the Guru Granth Sahib hi hai. Exam point: Both Bijak/Panchvani and the Guru Granth Sahib - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What linguistic medium was employed by Sant Kabir to ensure his verses resonated with common masses?
qh: कबीर की कविता की भाषा कैसी थी जिससे वे आम लोगों के बीच लोकप्रिय हुए?
e: Kabir ne dialectical spoken Hindi (Sadhukkadi) use ki jo aam logon ki bhasha thi, sath hi unhone shocking paradoxical Ulatbansi poetry likhi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kabir ki kavita ki bhasha kaisi thi jisase ve am logon ke bich lokapriy hue? Isi tathya par Vernacular colloquial Hindi (Sadhukkadi / Khari Boli) tika hua hai. Scholastic Paninian Sanskrit, Classical Qur'anic Arabic, High court Persian mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Vernacular colloquial Hindi (Sadhukkadi / Khari Boli) hai. Exam point: Vernacular colloquial Hindi (Sadhukkadi / Khari Boli) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Where was Guru Nanak Dev Ji born in 1469 in the Punjab province?
qh: गुरु नानक देव का जन्म 1469 में कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Guru Nanak ka birth 1469 me village Talwandi Rai Bhoe (ab Nankana Sahib, Pakistan) me hua tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki guru nanak dev ka janm 1469 mein kahan hua tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Talwandi (Nankana Sahib) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Delhi, Kartarpur, Amritsar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Talwandi (Nankana Sahib) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Talwandi (Nankana Sahib) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the universal community kitchen instituted by Guru Nanak at Kartarpur called?
qh: गुरु नानक ने करतारपुर में अपने अनुयायियों के लिए जो साझा रसोई शुरू की थी, उसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: Kartarpur me Guru Nanak ne Langar establish kiya jahan sabhi followers ek sath baithkar khana khate the, jo caste distinctions ko reject karta tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki guru nanak ne karatarapur mein apane anuyayiyon ke lie jo sajha rasoi shuru ki thi, use kya kahate hain? khanqah sufi sadhakon ke rehne tatha zikr karne ka sthan tha. Yahi wajah hai ki Langar sahi hai. Bhandara, Bhojanalaya, Khanqah is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Langar hai. Exam point: Langar - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Whom did Guru Nanak Dev choose as his devoted successor, conferring upon him the name Guru Angad?
qh: गुरु नानक देव ने अपना उत्तराधिकारी किसे चुना था?
e: Guru Nanak ne apne dedicated disciple Bhai Lehna ko choose kiya aur unhe 'Angad' (mere shareer ka hissa) naam dekar successor banaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki guru nanak dev ne apana uttaradhikari kise chuna tha? Isi baat se Bhai Lehna (Guru Angad) sahi sabit hota hai. Baba Farid, Guru Gobind Singh, Guru Arjan Dev is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Bhai Lehna (Guru Angad) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Bhai Lehna (Guru Angad) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which fifth Sikh Guru compiled the holy Adi Granth at Amritsar in 1604?
qh: सिखों के पवित्र ग्रंथ 'गुरु ग्रंथ साहिब' का संकलन 1604 में किसने पूरा किया था?
e: 5th Guru Arjan Dev Ji ne 1604 me Adi Granth compile kiya jisme Sikh Gurus ke sath-sath Kabir, Namdev, Ravidas aur Baba Farid ki bani shamil ki. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki sikhon ke pavitr granth 'guru granth sahib' ka sankalan 1604 mein kisane pura kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Guru Arjan Dev sahi nikalta hai. Guru Tegh Bahadur, Guru Nanak, Guru Gobind Singh is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Guru Arjan Dev hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Guru Arjan Dev - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What military fraternity of the Sikh faith was forged by Guru Gobind Singh at Anandpur Sahib in 1699?
qh: गुरु गोबिंद सिंह ने 1699 में सिखों के किस सैन्य और राजनीतिक संगठन की स्थापना की थी?
e: 1699 me Guru Gobind Singh Ji ne Khalsa Panth banaya jisme baptized Sikhs ko 'Panch Kakar' (5 Ks) aur martial identity assign ki gayi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki guru gobind sinh ne 1699 mein sikhon ke kis sainy aur rajanitik sangathan ki sthapana ki thi? Isliye antim jawab Khalsa Panth ke roop mein milta hai. Namdhari, Shiromani, Misl anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Khalsa Panth hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Khalsa Panth - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which three cardinal ethical pillars summarize the practical teachings of Guru Nanak?
qh: गुरु नानक की शिक्षाओं का सार किन तीन शब्दों में निहित है?
o: Nam, Dan, Isnan (Right worship, welfare of others, and purity of conduct)
e: Guru Nanak ki philosophy 'Nam Japna' (divine remembrance), 'Kirat Karni' (honest earning) aur 'Vand Chhakkna' (sharing/Dan) par based thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki guru nanak ki shikshaon ka sar kin tin shabdon mein nihit hai? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Isi karan se Nam, Dan, Isnan (Right worship, welfare of... sahi uttar hai. Satya, Ahimsa, Tyaga, Bhakti, Shakti, Yukti, Karma, Dharma, Marma ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Nam, Dan, Isnan (Right worship, welfare of... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Nam, Dan, Isnan (Right worship, welfare of... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which vernacular dialect of Hindi did Goswami Tulsidas compose the celebrated epic 'Ramcharitmanas'?
qh: तुलसीदास ने रामचरितमानस की रचना किस भाषा में की थी?
e: Tulsidas ne Ramayana ko Sanskrit se aam logon tak pahunchane ke liye Eastern Uttar Pradesh ki vernacular bhasha 'Awadhi' me Ramcharitmanas likha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki tulasidas ne ramacharitamanas ki rachana kis bhasha mein ki thi? Isliye antim jawab Awadhi ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp Magadhi, Classical Sanskrit, Braj Bhasha bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Awadhi baithta hai. Exam point: Awadhi - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Whom did the celebrated Mewari princess-saint Mirabai accept as her spiritual master?
qh: राजपूत राजकुमारी मीराबाई ने किसे अपना आध्यात्मिक गुरु बनाया था?
e: Mirabai ne untouchable tanner caste se aane wale mystic poet Sant Ravidas (Raidas) ko apna guru accept karke caste orthodoxy ko defy kiya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rajaput rajakumari mirabai ne kise apana adhyatmik guru banaya tha? Isi baat se Sant Ravidas sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Tulsidas, Kabir, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Sant Ravidas hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Sant Ravidas - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which 15th-century Gujarati saint-poet authored the famous hymn 'Vaishnava Jana To Tene Kahiye'?
qh: किस प्रसिद्ध गुजराती संत ने कहा था - 'वैष्णव जन तो तेने कहिये जे पीर पराई जाणे रे'?
e: Gujarat ke Vaishnava saint Narsinh Mehta ne ye hymn likha tha jo empathy aur compassion ko sacha religious character batata hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kis prasiddh gujarati sant ne kaha tha - 'vaishnav jan to tene kahiye je pir parai jane re'? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Narsinh Mehta hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp Surdas, Jnaneshwar, Namdev bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Narsinh Mehta hai. Exam point: Narsinh Mehta - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which 15th-century reformer-saint pioneered the Neo-Vaishnavite Bhakti resurgence in the Brahmaputra Valley of Assam?
qh: असम में भक्ति मार्ग को लोकप्रिय बनाने वाले प्रमुख संत कौन थे?
e: Srimanta Sankaradeva ne Assam me Ekasarana Dharma preach kiya aur devotional community centres ke roop me 'Sattras' aur 'Namghars' establish kiye. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki asam mein bhakti marg ko lokapriy banane vale pramukh sant kaun the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Srimanta Sankaradeva hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Guru Nanak, Kabir, Chaitanya Deva is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Srimanta Sankaradeva hai. Exam point: Srimanta Sankaradeva - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In Sufi ritual assembly, what does the mystical practice of 'Sama' refer to?
qh: सूफी शब्दावली में 'समा' (Sama) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Spiritual music, singing, and audition designed to induce divine ecstasy
e: Sama Sufi devotional gathering thi jahan spiritual poetry aur Qawwali ke zariye mystic ecstasy (hal/wajd) experience kiya jata tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki suphi shabdavali mein 'sama' (Sama) ka kya arth hai? sufi islam ke andar ke sadhak the jo ishq tatha khuda ke milan par jor dete the. Isi karan se Spiritual music, singing, and audition designed to induce divine ecstasy sahi uttar hai. Silent sensory fasting, Scholastic theological debate, Desert pilgrimage in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Spiritual music, singing, and audition designed to induce divine ecstasy hai. Exam point: Spiritual music, singing, and audition designed to... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Sikh Guru was executed in 1606 under the imperial orders of Mughal Emperor Jahangir?
qh: मुगल सम्राट जहाँगीर ने 1606 में किस सिख गुरु को मृत्युदंड देने का आदेश दिया था?
e: Rebel prince Khusrau ko blessings dene aur Sikh community ke growing political influence ke suspicion me Jahangir ne Guru Arjan Dev Ji ko execute karwaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki mugal samrat jahangir ne 1606 mein kis sikh guru ko mrityudand dene ka adesh diya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Guru Arjan Dev hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Guru Angad, Guru Tegh Bahadur, Guru Ram Das mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Guru Arjan Dev hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Guru Arjan Dev - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who spearheaded the Protestant Reformation in Germany in 1517 by challenging the Catholic Church's sale of indulgences?
qh: 16वीं शताब्दी में जर्मनी में 'धर्म सुधार आंदोलन' (Reformation) का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Martin Luther ne 1517 me Wittenberg church door par 95 Theses nail karke Catholic Church ke indulgences aur papal authority ko challenge kiya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 16vin shatabdi mein jarmani mein 'dharm sudhar andolan' (Reformation) ka netritv kisane kiya tha? In tathyon ke chalte Martin Luther hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Pope Leo X, Henry VIII, John Calvin - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Martin Luther hai. Exam point: Martin Luther - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which normative prescriptions were predominantly disregarded by independent tribal societies in medieval India?
qh: मध्यकाल में जनजातीय समाज ब्राह्मणों द्वारा बनाए गए किन नियमों का पालन नहीं करता था?
o: Brahmanical caste hierarchies and elaborate ritualistic taboos
e: Tribal societies egalitarian clans par based thi aur wo varna-based caste rules aur Brahmanical rituals ko follow nahi karti thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki madhyakal mein janajatiy samaj brahmanon dvara banae gae kin niyamon ka palan nahin karata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Brahmanical caste hierarchies and elaborate ritualistic taboos sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Military drill codes, Terrace agrarian practices, Metallic currency rules - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Brahmanical caste hierarchies and elaborate ritualistic taboos hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Brahmanical caste hierarchies and elaborate ritualistic taboos - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which primary historical repository is utilized by anthropologists and historians to construct tribal histories?
qh: जनजातीय समूहों के बारे में जानकारी प्राप्त करने के लिए इतिहासकार मुख्य रूप से किस स्रोत का उपयोग करते हैं?
o: Richly preserved oral traditions and folklore
e: Tribal societies me written manuscripts nahi the; unki history unke oral folk songs, folklore aur community memory se reconstruct ki jaati hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki janajatiy samuhon ke bare mein janakari prapt karane ke lie itihasakar mukhy rup se kis srot ka upayog karate hain? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Richly preserved oral traditions and folklore sahi nikalta hai. Monolithic stone steles, Gold numismatic catalogs, Colonial court records exclusively mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Richly preserved oral traditions and folklore hai. Exam point: Richly preserved oral traditions and folklore - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which tribal confederacy in Bihar and Jharkhand was subdued by Akbar's general Raja Man Singh in 1591?
qh: अकबर के प्रसिद्ध सेनापति राजा मानसिंह ने 1591 में किस जनजातीय समूह को पराजित किया था?
e: Raja Man Singh ne 1591 me Chero chieftains par attack karke unhe loot liya aur defeat kiya, halanki wo poori tarah subdue Aurangzeb ke time hue. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki akabar ke prasiddh senapati raja manasinh ne 1591 mein kis janajatiy samuh ko parajit kiya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Cheros hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp Ahoms, Bhils, Mundas bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Cheros hai. Exam point: Cheros - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which tribal chieftain of the Gakkhar community was elevated to the status of an imperial Mansabdar by Emperor Akbar?
qh: मुगल सम्राट अकबर के शासनकाल में 'कमाल खान गक्खड़' को किस पद पर नियुक्त किया गया था?
e: Punjab ke Potwar region ke Gakkhar chief Kamal Khan Gakkhar ki loyalty aur military leadership dekhkar Akbar ne use Mansabdar banaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki mugal samrat akabar ke shasanakal mein 'kamal khan gakkhad' ko kis pad par niyukt kiya gaya tha? kotwal sheher mein aman tatha kanoon sambhalne wala adhikari tha. Isliye sahi nateeja Mansabdar nikalta hai. Town Kotwal, Imperial Grand Vizier, Foreign Consul is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Mansabdar hi milti hai. Exam point: Mansabdar - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why were pastoral nomadic communities continually mobile across vast geographical tracts?
qh: खानाबदोश पशुपालक अपने जानवरों के साथ एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान क्यों घूमते थे?
o: Cyclical search for seasonal grazing pastures and water resources for herds
e: Pastoral nomads apne sheep, goats aur cattle ke seasonal grazing needs aur water availability ke according alag-alag ecological zones me move karte the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki khanabadosh pashupalak apane janavaron ke sath ek sthan se dusare sthan kyon ghumate the? Isi karan se Cyclical search for seasonal grazing pastures and water resources for herds sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Fleeing constant dynastic wars, Conducting inter-state retail trade, Tribal entertainment bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Cyclical search for seasonal grazing pastures and... hi milti hai. Exam point: Cyclical search for seasonal grazing pastures and water resources for herds - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who constituted the paramount pastoral-trader nomads transporting grain for armies across medieval India?
qh: मध्यकालीन भारत में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण व्यापारी खानाबदोश (Trader Nomads) कौन थे?
e: Banjaras premier nomadic grain merchants the jo oxen par thousands of quintals grain load karke military campaigns aur urban markets me supply karte the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki madhyakalin bharat mein sabase mahatvapurn vyapari khanabadosh (Trader Nomads) kaun the? Isi karan se Banjaras sahi uttar hai. Ahoms, Santhals, Gonds mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Banjaras hi milti hai. Exam point: Banjaras - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the extensive caravan or collective convoy of the Banjaras termed?
qh: बंजारों के कारवां या काफिले को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: Banjaras ke caravan ko 'Tanda' kehte the; ek Tanda me thousands of bullocks aur hundreds of families ek sath move karti thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki banjaron ke karavan ya kaphile ko kis nam se jana jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Tanda sahi nikalta hai. Jatha, Sangha, Girda mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Tanda hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Tanda - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: According to the Akbarnama, how many villages were administratively unified within the Gond kingdom of Garha Katanga?
qh: अकबरनामा के अनुसार, गोंड राज्य 'गढ़ कटंगा' में कुल कितने गाँव शामिल थे?
e: Abul Fazl ne Akbarnama me mention kiya hai ki Gond state of Garha Katanga (Mandla/Jabalpur) me 70,000 populated villages the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki akabaranama ke anusar, gond rajy 'gadh katanga' mein kul kitane ganv shamil the? Yahi wajah hai ki 70,000 sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - 10,000, 100,000, 50,000 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 70,000 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 70,000 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In the administrative structure of the Gond kingdom, what was a 'Chaurasi'?
qh: गोंड प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था में 'चौरासी' (Chaurasi) क्या था?
e: Gond kingdom Garhs me divided tha; har Garh 84 villages ki unit 'Chaurasi' me batta tha, jo aage 12 villages ke 'Barhots' me sub-divided hota tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gond prashasanik vyavastha mein 'chaurasi' (Chaurasi) kya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki An administrative unit comprising 84 villages sahi hai. Galti A shrine cluster of 84 idols, An imperial gold ornament, A cavalry regiment of 84 horses chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se An administrative unit comprising 84 villages sahi hai. Exam point: An administrative unit comprising 84 villages - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which prestigious Rajput title did Aman Das, the Gond Raja of Garha Katanga, adopt to elevate his status?
qh: गढ़ कटंगा के गोंड राजा अमन दास ने कौन सी उच्च उपाधि धारण की थी?
e: Aman Das ne Rajput Kshatriya status assert karne ke liye 'Sangram Shah' ka title adopt kiya aur apne bete Dalpat ki marriage Chandel princess Durgavati se karwayi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki gadh katanga ke gond raja aman das ne kaun si uchch upadhi dharan ki thi? Isliye sahi nateeja Sangram Shah nikalta hai. Maharajadhiraja, Vikramaditya, Padshah mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Sangram Shah hai. Exam point: Sangram Shah - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Against which Mughal commander did the heroic Gond warrior-queen Rani Durgavati fight to her death in 1565?
qh: रानी दुर्गावती ने 1565 में किस मुगल सेनापति के विरुद्ध लड़ते हुए वीरगति प्राप्त की थी?
e: 1565 me Mughal general Asaf Khan ne Garha Katanga par attack kiya; Rani Durgavati ne bravery se fight kiya aur surrender karne ke bajay suicide choose kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki rani durgavati ne 1565 mein kis mugal senapati ke viruddh ladate hue viragati prapt ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Asaf Khan sahi nikalta hai. Raja Man Singh, Bairam Khan, Shaista Khan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Asaf Khan hai. Exam point: Asaf Khan - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: From which modern Southeast Asian country did the Tai-Ahom group migrate into the Brahmaputra Valley in the 13th century?
qh: अहोम (Ahom) जनजाति 13वीं शताब्दी में वर्तमान के किस देश से आकर ब्रह्मपुत्र घाटी में बसी थी?
e: Tai-Ahom group 1228 CE me Sukaphaa ke leadership me upper Myanmar ke Mong Mao se Patkai hills cross karke Assam me settle hua. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki ahom (Ahom) janajati 13vin shatabdi mein vartaman ke kis desh se akar brahmaputr ghati mein basi thi? Isi karan se Myanmar (Burma) sahi uttar hai. Bhutan, China, Thailand ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Myanmar (Burma) hi hai. Exam point: Myanmar (Burma) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In Ahom society, who were the conscripted labourers bound to render mandatory state service?
qh: अहोम समाज में वे लोग कौन थे जिन्हें राज्य के लिए जबरन काम करना पड़ता था?
e: Ahom administration Paik system par based tha jahan common villagers compulsory rotational public works aur military service provide karte the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ahom samaj mein ve log kaun the jinhein rajy ke lie jabaran kam karana padata tha? Isi tathya par Paiks tika hua hai. Samantas, Subadars, Adimai mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Paiks hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Paiks - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: On what administrative mechanism was the state service of the Ahom Paiks systematically extracted?
qh: अहोम शासन के दौरान जनगणना के आधार पर पाइक (Paiks) को किस आधार पर सेवा देनी पड़ती थी?
o: On a rotational roster basis determined by a systematic village census
e: State census maintain karta tha aur heavily populated villages se logon ko dusri jagah shift karke rotational basis par Paiks se kaam karwata tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki ahom shasan ke dauran janaganana ke adhar par paik (Paiks) ko kis adhar par seva deni padati thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par On a rotational roster basis determined by a systematic village census hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Only during defensive mobilizations, Exclusively on religious harvest festivals, Against contractual cash wages chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab On a rotational roster basis determined by... hai. Exam point: On a rotational roster basis determined by a systematic village census - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In the clan-based social hierarchy of the Ahoms, what was a 'Khel'?
qh: अहोम प्रशासन की सबसे छोटी इकाई 'कुल' या 'खेल' (Khel) का नियंत्रण मुख्य रूप से किस पर था?
o: An organized kinship-based guild or administrative clan controlling groups of villages
e: Ahom society me 'Khel' clan-based guilds hoti thi jo unke command me aane wale multiple villages aur Paiks ke groups ko administratively govern karti thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ahom prashasan ki sabase chhoti ikai 'kul' ya 'khel' (Khel) ka niyantran mukhy rup se kis par tha? Isi aadhar par An organized kinship-based guild or administrative clan controlling groups of villages chuna jaata hai. Galti The royal bullion depository, A naval battalion, A frontier trade outpost chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan An organized kinship-based guild or administrative clan controlling groups of villages hi milti hai. Exam point: An organized kinship-based guild or administrative clan controlling groups of villages - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Mughal viceroy of Bengal invaded the Ahom kingdom and captured their capital Garhgaon in 1662?
qh: 17वीं शताब्दी के उत्तरार्ध में अहोमों के विरुद्ध मुगल आक्रमण का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: 1662 me Aurangzeb ke general Mir Jumla ne Ahom capital Garhgaon capture ki, halanki continuous guerrilla resistance se Mughals permanent control nahi rakh paaye. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 17vin shatabdi ke uttarardh mein ahomon ke viruddh mugal akraman ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Aurangzeb Mughal badshah tha jiske samay mein Maratha sangharsh tatha rajy ka vistar hua. Isliye sahi nateeja Mir Jumla nikalta hai. Emperor Aurangzeb, Asaf Khan, Raja Man Singh ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Mir Jumla baithta hai. Exam point: Mir Jumla - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the official court chronicles written in the Ahom language and subsequently in Assamese called?
qh: अहोम राज्य के ऐतिहासिक वृत्तांतों को क्या कहा जाता है, जिन्हें पहले अहोम और फिर असमिया भाषा में लिखा गया?
e: Ahom state me detailed historical chronicles maintain kiye jaate the jinhe 'Buranji' kaha jata tha; pehle ye Ahom language me aur baad me Assamese me likhe gaye. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki ahom rajy ke aitihasik vrittanton ko kya kaha jata hai, jinhein pahale ahom aur phir asamiya bhasha mein likha gaya? Isliye antim jawab Buranjis ke roop mein milta hai. Akbarnama, Tawarikh, Prashastis is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Buranjis hai. Exam point: Buranjis - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which prominent pastoral shepherd community inhabited the Western Himalayas?
qh: पश्चिमी हिमालय में रहने वाली मुख्य जनजातीय गड़रिया जाति कौन सी थी?
e: Himachal Pradesh aur Jammu ke Western Himalayan valleys me 'Gaddi' pastoral shepherd tribe rehti thi jo seasonal migration karti thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki pashchimi himalay mein rahane vali mukhy janajatiy gadariya jati kaun si thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Gaddis sahi nikalta hai. Nagas, Bhils, Khokhars is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Gaddis hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Gaddis - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which ancestral agrarian technique was traditionally practiced by the Gond tribes in central India?
qh: गोंड लोग खेती के लिए किस प्राचीन पद्धति का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Gonds traditionally forest patches ko cut aur burn karke shifting cultivation (jise locally Bewar ya Dahiya kehte the) practice karte the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki gond log kheti ke lie kis prachin paddhati ka upayog karate the? Isi karan se Shifting Cultivation (Slash-and-burn / Bewar) sahi uttar hai. Drip tube irrigation, Perennial masonry canal networks, Mountain contour terracing in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Shifting Cultivation (Slash-and-burn / Bewar) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Shifting Cultivation (Slash-and-burn / Bewar) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which indigenous kingdom of Northeast India manufactured gunpowder and used cannons as early as the 1530s?
qh: किस जनजातीय समूह ने 1530 के दशक में ही आग्नेयास्त्रों (Firearms) और बारूद का प्रभावी उपयोग शुरू कर दिया था?
e: Ahoms ne 1530s me hi firearms utilize karna shuru kar diya tha aur 17th century tak unke paas high-quality saltpetre gunpowder aur cannons banane ki expertise thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kis janajatiy samuh ne 1530 ke dashak mein hi agneyastron (Firearms) aur barud ka prabhavi upayog shuru kar diya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Ahoms sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Bhils, Marathas, Gonds - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Ahoms hi hai. Exam point: Ahoms - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: During the imperial Chola reign, what multifunctional urban role did the royal capital of Thanjavur exemplify?
qh: चोल काल के दौरान 'तंजावुर' नगर किस प्रकार के केंद्र का एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण था?
o: A grand imperial administrative capital and vibrant temple town
e: Thanjavur Chola empire ki political capital thi jahan imperial bureaucracy, markets, Rajarajeshvara temple aur cultural activities ek sath hub banaye hue the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki chol kal ke dauran 'tanjavur' nagar kis prakar ke keindr ka ek utkrisht udaharan tha? Isi karan se A grand imperial administrative capital and vibrant... sahi uttar hai. A border garrison outpost, A coastal salt port exclusively, An isolated monastic retreat is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar A grand imperial administrative capital and vibrant temple town baithta hai. Exam point: A grand imperial administrative capital and vibrant temple town - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which sovereign Chola monarch commissioned the construction of the monumental Rajarajeshvara Temple at Thanjavur?
qh: तंजावुर में स्थित प्रसिद्ध 'राजराजेश्वर मंदिर' का निर्माण किस चोल शासक ने करवाया था?
e: Rajaraja I ne 1010 CE me Thanjavur me Brihadisvara (Rajarajeshvara) temple banwaya jo Dravidian stone architecture ka pinnacle hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki tanjavur mein sthit prasiddh 'rajarajeshvar mandir' ka nirman kis chol shasak ne karavaya tha? Isi tathya par Rajaraja Chola I tika hua hai. Vijayalaya, Rajendra I, Kulothunga I is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Rajaraja Chola I baithta hai. Exam point: Rajaraja Chola I - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What socio-economic urbanization process characterized settlements developing around medieval pilgrimage shrines?
qh: मध्यकाल में मंदिरों के आसपास बस्तियाँ बसने और नगरों के विकसित होने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Medieval period me temples land grants, banking, crafts aur fairs ke economic hubs ban gaye, jisse unke chaaro taraf 'Temple Towns' ka urbanization hua. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki madhyakal mein mandiron ke asapas bastiyan basane aur nagaron ke vikasit hone ki prakriya ko kya kaha jata hai? Yahi wajah hai ki Temple Town Urbanization sahi hai. Industrial assembly expansion, Rural agrarian dispersion, Frontier military cantonment is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Temple Town Urbanization hai. Exam point: Temple Town Urbanization - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the international commercial function of South Indian merchant guilds like 'Manigramam' and 'Nanadesi'?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के प्रसिद्ध व्यापारिक संघों (Guilds) में 'मणिग्रामम्' और 'नानादेशी' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Conducting extensive long-distance maritime and overland trade across Southeast Asia and China
e: Manigramam aur Nanadesi powerful South Indian trade guilds thi jo internal India aur overseas Southeast Asia aur China ke sath maritime commerce chalati thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki dakshin bharat ke prasiddh vyaparik sanghon (Guilds) mein 'manigramam' aur 'nanadeshi' ka mukhy kary kya tha? Isi tathya par Conducting extensive long-distance maritime and overland trade... tika hua hai. Extracting state poll taxes, Constructing royal fortifications, Direct agrarian cultivation anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Conducting extensive long-distance maritime and overland trade... hai. Exam point: Conducting extensive long-distance maritime and overland trade across Southeast Asia and China - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which Deccan artisanal town gave its name to the fine metallic inlay craft of silver and copper on zinc alloys?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'बिदरी' (Bidri) शिल्प का नाम किस स्थान के नाम पर पड़ा जहाँ के शिल्पकार तांबे और चाँदी में जड़ाई के काम के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे?
e: Bahmani/Barid Shahi capital Bidar ke artisans zinc-copper alloy par fine silver aur brass inlay work karte the jise 'Bidriware' kaha gaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki madhyakal mein 'bidari' (Bidri) shilp ka nam kis sthan ke nam par pada jahan ke shilpakar tanbe aur chandi mein jadai ke kam ke lie prasiddh the? Isliye sahi nateeja Bidar nikalta hai. Golkonda, Ahmadnagar, Bijapur ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Bidar hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Bidar - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In the river basin of which two Deccan waterways was the fortified city of Hampi strategically established?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की राजधानी 'हम्पी' किन नदियों के बेसिन में स्थित थी?
e: Hampi dry Krishna-Tungabhadra doab basin me granite hills ke natural defense ring ke beech establish ki gayi thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki vijayanagar samrajy ki rajadhani 'hampi' kin nadiyon ke besin mein sthit thi? Isliye antim jawab Krishna and Tungabhadra ke roop mein milta hai. Godavari and Bhima, Narmada and Tapti, Kaveri and Pennar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Krishna and Tungabhadra sahi hai. Exam point: Krishna and Tungabhadra - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What remarkable mortarless stonemasonry technique was implemented to erect the defensive walls of Hampi?
qh: हम्पी की किलेबंदी की दीवारों के निर्माण में किस विशिष्ट तकनीक का प्रयोग किया गया था?
o: Interlocking wedge technique without the use of any mortar or cementing agent
e: Hampi ki outer fortification walls me kisi mortar ya cement ka use nahi hua; massive granite blocks ko trapezoidal interlocking pattern me wedge kiya gaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki hampi ki kilebandi ki divaron ke nirman mein kis vishisht takanik ka prayog kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Interlocking wedge technique without the use of... sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Thick adobe mud facing, Hydraulic lime-mortar bonding, Reinforced iron tie-beams - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Interlocking wedge technique without the use of any mortar or cementing agent sahi hai. Exam point: Interlocking wedge technique without the use of any mortar or cementing agent - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Why was the bustling Gujarati port of Surat designated the 'Gate to Mecca' during the Mughal era?
qh: गुजरात का 'सूरत' शहर मुगल काल में किस नाम से प्रसिद्ध था क्योंकि यहाँ से मक्का के लिए यात्री जहाज रवाना होते थे?
e: Surat Mughal Empire ka premier port tha jahan se Hajj pilgrims ke ships Red Sea ke liye sail karte the, isliye use 'Bab-ul-Makkah' kehte the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gujarat ka 'surat' shahar mugal kal mein kis nam se prasiddh tha kyonki yahan se makka ke lie yatri jahaj ravana hote the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Gate to Mecca (Bab-ul-Makkah) hi sahi baithta hai. Diamond Harbor, Commercial Gateway, The White City mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se Gate to Mecca (Bab-ul-Makkah) sahi hai. Exam point: Gate to Mecca (Bab-ul-Makkah) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: For what exquisite gold-lace border craftsmanship were the cotton textiles of Surat internationally celebrated?
qh: सूरत के सूती वस्त्र अपने किस काम के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे, जिनका बाजार पश्चिम एशिया, अफ्रीका और यूरोप में फैला था?
e: Surat cotton aur silk textiles apne genuine gold aur silver thread borders ('Zari') ke liye famous the jo West Asia aur Europe export hote the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki surat ke suti vastr apane kis kam ke lie prasiddh the, jinaka bajar pashchim eshiya, aphrika aur yurop mein phaila tha? Isi aadhar par Zari (Gold lace thread embroidery) chuna jaata hai. Chikan shadow work, Kalamkari painting, Ajrakh block resist is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Zari (Gold lace thread embroidery) baithta hai. Exam point: Zari (Gold lace thread embroidery) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What commercial and financial instrument was designated by the term 'Hundi' in medieval Indian banking?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'हुंडी' (Hundi) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: A bill of exchange recording a financial deposit redeemable at a distant location
e: Hundi ek financial bill of exchange hota tha jisme merchant credit deposit record hota tha; ise bina cash carry kiye kisi doosri city me merchant redeem kar sakta tha. Yah prashn A bill of exchange recording a financial deposit redeemable at a distant location se juda hai. Isi karan se A bill of exchange recording a financial deposit redeemable at a distant location sahi uttar hai. A standard grain measurement, An armored convoy detachment, An imperial customs transit tax is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad A bill of exchange recording a financial deposit redeemable at a distant location hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: A bill of exchange recording a financial deposit redeemable at a distant location - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the primary geopolitical identity of Masulipatnam (Machilipatnam) on the Andhra coast in the 17th century?
qh: आंध्र तट पर स्थित 'मसूलीपट्टनम' (मछलीपट्टनम) 17वीं शताब्दी में किस चीज का प्रमुख केंद्र था?
o: A flourishing international port contested by Dutch and English East India Companies
e: Golkonda kingdom ke control me Masulipatnam Andhra coast ka main trade port tha jahan Dutch aur Britishers ne textile export ke liye factories banayi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki andhr tat par sthit 'masulipattanam' (machhalipattanam) 17vin shatabdi mein kis chij ka pramukh keindr tha? Isi baat se A flourishing international port contested by Dutch and English East India Companies sahi sabit hota hai. Agrarian paddy plantation, Monastic theological academy, Subsistence fishing harbor only is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan A flourishing international port contested by Dutch... hi milti hai. Exam point: A flourishing international port contested by Dutch and English East India Companies - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who resided in the segregated residential quarters termed 'Black Towns' in 18th-century colonial presidency cities?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी में यूरोपीय कंपनियों द्वारा बसाए गए 'ब्लैक टाउन' (Black Towns) में कौन लोग रहते थे?
o: Native Indian merchants, artisans, and weavers
e: Colonial Madras aur Calcutta me Britishers Fort area (White Town) me rehte the, jabki native Indian weavers, traders aur artisans ko 'Black Towns' me segregate kiya gaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 18vin shatabdi mein yuropiy kanpaniyon dvara basae gae 'blaik taun' (Black Towns) mein kaun log rahate the? Isliye antim jawab Native Indian merchants, artisans, and weavers ke roop mein milta hai. African indentured sailors exclusively, British military garrisons, European colonial governors is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Native Indian merchants, artisans, and weavers sahi hai. Exam point: Native Indian merchants, artisans, and weavers - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In overland Asian commerce during the Mughal period, for which trade were Kabul and Qandahar famously known?
qh: मुगल काल के दौरान 'काबुल' और 'कंधार' व्यापारिक रूप से किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध थे?
o: High-value horse trade and dry fruits
e: Kabul aur Qandahar overland Silk Route transit points the jahan se Central Asia se thousands of fine cavalry horses aur dry fruits India aate the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki mugal kal ke dauran 'kabul' aur 'kandhar' vyaparik rup se kisake lie prasiddh the? Isi karan se High-value horse trade and dry fruits sahi uttar hai. Cotton textiles exclusively, Spice trade networks, Maritime pearl fisheries is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab High-value horse trade and dry fruits hai. Exam point: High-value horse trade and dry fruits - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which sophisticated metallurgical method was utilized to cast hollow and solid Chola bronze sculptures?
qh: चोलकालीन कांस्य मूर्तियाँ बनाने के लिए किस विशिष्ट तकनीक का प्रयोग किया जाता था?
e: Chola bronzes (jaise Nataraja) Lost-Wax process (Cire Perdue) se banaye jaate the jisme beeswax model par clay coat karke molten metal pour kiya jata tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki cholakalin kansy murtiyan banane ke lie kis vishisht takanik ka prayog kiya jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Lost-Wax Technique (Cire Perdue) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Open clay die-stamping, Repousse sheet hammering, Direct cold chiseling is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Lost-Wax Technique (Cire Perdue) hi hai. Exam point: Lost-Wax Technique (Cire Perdue) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which major overseas banking centers were the credit Hundis issued by Surat merchant bankers reliably honored?
qh: सूरत का बैंकिंग नेटवर्क इतना मजबूत था कि उसकी 'हुंडियों' को किन विदेशी बाजारों में मान्यता प्राप्त थी?
e: Surat ke Mahajans ka financial credibility itna solid tha ki unki Hundis Cairo, Basra aur Europe ke Antwerp bazaar me directly cash exchange hoti thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki surat ka bainking netavark itana majabut tha ki usaki 'hundiyon' ko kin videshi bajaron mein manyata prapt thi? Isi aadhar par Cairo (Egypt), Basra (Iraq), and Antwerp (Belgium) chuna jaata hai. Galti Tokyo and Kyoto, London and Paris, New York and Beijing chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Cairo (Egypt), Basra (Iraq), and Antwerp (Belgium) hai. Exam point: Cairo (Egypt), Basra (Iraq), and Antwerp (Belgium) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: At which monumental platform did the Vijayanagara king conduct state rituals and receive vassal tributes during the Mahanavami festival?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य में 'महानवमी' उत्सव के दौरान राजा अपनी शक्ति और प्रतिष्ठा का प्रदर्शन कहाँ करता था?
e: Mahanavami festival ke 9 dino me king Mahanavami Dibba par baithkar state rituals, wrestling, animal sacrifices aur tributary nayakas ki army reviews leta tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki vijayanagar samrajy mein 'mahanavami' utsav ke dauran raja apani shakti aur pratishtha ka pradarshan kahan karata tha? Isi karan se The Mahanavami Dibba platform sahi uttar hai. Underground chamber, Wild elephant stable, Agricultural riverside field in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se The Mahanavami Dibba platform sahi hai. Exam point: The Mahanavami Dibba platform - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What socio-economic role was performed by the 'Banjaras' in medieval Indian logistics?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'बंजारे' (Banjaras) मुख्य रूप से क्या थे?
o: Nomadic merchant-caravan transporters of essential grain and provisions
e: Banjaras nomadic merchant communities thi jo transport bullocks ke zariye large scale par foodgrains gaon se cities aur military camps me supply karti thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki madhyakal mein 'banjare' (Banjaras) mukhy rup se kya the? Isi baat se Nomadic merchant-caravan transporters of essential grain and provisions sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Royal palace architects, Imperial court bodyguards, Forest hermit hermits chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Nomadic merchant-caravan transporters of essential grain and... hi hai. Exam point: Nomadic merchant-caravan transporters of essential grain and provisions - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What direct commercial factor triggered the decline of the port city of Masulipatnam in the late 17th and 18th centuries?
qh: मसूलीपट्टनम का पतन 18वीं शताब्दी में क्यों शुरू हुआ?
o: The shift of European commercial centers to the fortified colonial ports of Bombay, Calcutta, and Madras
e: Mughals dwara Golkonda capture hone aur British/French companies ke Bombay, Madras aur Calcutta shift hone se Masulipatnam ka trade collapse ho gaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki masulipattanam ka patan 18vin shatabdi mein kyon shuru hua? Isliye antim jawab The shift of European commercial centers to... ke roop mein milta hai. Total ban on cloth manufacturing, Catastrophic tsunami flooding, Exhaustion of Krishna river fish ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar The shift of European commercial centers to the fortified colonial ports of Bombay, Calcutta, and Madras hai. Exam point: The shift of European commercial centers to the fortified colonial ports of Bombay, Calcutta, and Madras - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the definitive historical catalyst for the destruction and abandonment of the imperial city of Hampi?
qh: हम्पी के विनाश का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: The military sacking by the allied Deccan Sultanates following the Battle of Talikota in 1565
e: 1565 me Battle of Talikota ke baad allied Deccan Sultanates ki victorious armies ne Hampi city me enter karke use thoroughly pillage aur ruin kar diya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki hampi ke vinash ka mukhy karan kya tha? Isi karan se The military sacking by the allied Deccan... sahi uttar hai. Tectonic earthquake collapse, European naval bombardment, Perennial river drought mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad The military sacking by the allied Deccan... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: The military sacking by the allied Deccan... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The holy Pushkar Lake situated near Ajmer is celebrated for housing the rare temple of which Hindu divinity?
qh: अजमेर के पास स्थित 'पुष्कर' झील किस देवता के एकमात्र मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Ajmer ke paas Pushkar Lake ancient pilgrimage site hai jahan world ka sabse prominent temple of Lord Brahma situated hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki ajamer ke pas sthit 'pushkar' jhil kis devata ke ekamatr mandir ke lie prasiddh hai? Isi karan se Lord Brahma sahi uttar hai. Lord Ganesha, Lord Vishnu, Lord Shiva anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Lord Brahma hi hai. Exam point: Lord Brahma - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who initiated the construction of the base storey of the monumental Qutub Minar in Delhi around 1199 CE?
qh: कुतुब मीनार की पहली मंज़िल का निर्माण लगभग 1199 में किसने करवाया था?
e: Qutbuddin Aibak ne 1199 me Qutub Minar ki first storey banwayi thi, jiske baad remaining 3 storeys Iltutmish ne complete karwayi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kutub minar ki pahali manjail ka nirman lagabhag 1199 mein kisane karavaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Qutbuddin Aibak hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Firuz Shah Tughlaq, Alauddin Khalji, Shamsuddin Iltutmish anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Qutbuddin Aibak hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Qutbuddin Aibak - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What characterizes the classical 'Trabeate' (corbelled) structural technique in early medieval temple and palace architecture?
qh: 8वीं से 13वीं शताब्दी के बीच मंदिरों और इमारतों में छत, दरवाजे और खिड़कियाँ बनाने की 'ट्रैबिएट' (Trabeate) तकनीक क्या थी?
o: Placing a horizontal cross-beam across two upright vertical pillars
Constructing a true radiating keystone arch
e: Trabeate (anuparastha toda) technique me do vertical pillars par ek horizontal stone beam rakhkar roofs, doors aur windows banaye jaate the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 8vin se 13vin shatabdi ke bich mandiron aur imaraton mein chhat, daravaje aur khidakiyan banane ki 'traibiet' (Trabeate) takanik kya thi? Isi baat se Placing a horizontal cross-beam across two upright vertical pillars sahi sabit hota hai. Building true hollow brick domes, Erecting iron suspension cables, Constructing a true radiating keystone arch in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Placing a horizontal cross-beam across two upright vertical pillars hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Placing a horizontal cross-beam across two upright... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Chandela dynasty king commissioned the construction of the magnificent Kandariya Mahadeva Temple at Khajuraho in 999 CE?
qh: खजुराहो में स्थित 'कंदरिया महादेव मंदिर' का निर्माण 999 ईस्वी में किस वंश के राजा धंगदेव द्वारा किया गया था?
e: Chandela ruler Dhangadeva ne 999 CE me Khajuraho complex me Lord Shiva ko dedicated grand Kandariya Mahadeva Temple construct karwaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki khajuraho mein sthit 'kandariya mahadev mandir' ka nirman 999 isvi mein kis vansh ke raja dhangadev dvara kiya gaya tha? Isi karan se Chandela dynasty (King Dhangadeva) sahi uttar hai. Gupta dynasty, Pala dynasty, Chola dynasty alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Chandela dynasty (King Dhangadeva) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Chandela dynasty (King Dhangadeva) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who built the grand Rajarajeshvara Temple at Thanjavur, which possessed the tallest temple Shikhara of its era?
qh: तंजौर के 'राजराजेश्वर मंदिर' का शिखर अपने समय के मंदिरों में सबसे ऊँचा था। इसका निर्माण किसने करवाया था?
e: Chola emperor Rajaraja I ne Thanjavur me ye temple banwaya jiska shikhara 66 meters uncha tha aur iske top par 90-ton stone dome install kiya gaya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki tanjaur ke 'rajarajeshvar mandir' ka shikhar apane samay ke mandiron mein sabase uncha tha. isaka nirman kisane karavaya tha? In tathyon ke chalte Rajaraja Deva (Rajaraja I) hi sahi hai. Dhangadeva, Rajendra I, Vijayalaya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Rajaraja Deva (Rajaraja I) hai. Exam point: Rajaraja Deva (Rajaraja I) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What engineering solution was implemented by Chola architects to roll a 90-ton granite stone to the apex of the Rajarajeshvara Temple?
qh: राजराजेश्वर मंदिर के 90 टन भारी पत्थर को शिखर तक पहुँचाने के लिए वास्तुकारों ने कौन सा रास्ता बनाया था?
o: A graded, four-kilometer-long earthen incline ramp path
e: Cranes na hone ke karan architects ne 4 km door village (Charupallam) se sloping earthen incline path banaya jisse 90-ton stone ko top tak roll kiya gaya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki rajarajeshvar mandir ke 90 tan bhari patthar ko shikhar tak pahunchane ke lie vastukaron ne kaun sa rasta banaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par A graded, four-kilometer-long earthen incline ramp path hi sahi baithta hai. Vertical counterweight elevators, A hydraulic lever crane, Subterranean tunneling anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab A graded, four-kilometer-long earthen incline ramp path hai. Exam point: A graded, four-kilometer-long earthen incline ramp path - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In the 'Arcuate' architectural style that emerged in the 12th century, what was the structural function of the 'Keystone'?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी में वास्तुकला की 'मेहराबदार' (Arcuate) शैली में 'की-स्टोन' (Key-stone) का क्या महत्व था?
o: Locking the central arch to transfer superstructure weight to vertical abutments
e: Arcuate style me arch ke center me wedge-shaped 'Keystone' (daat) lagta tha jo superstructure ke downward load ko arch pillars par transfer karta tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 12vin shatabdi mein vastukala ki 'meharabadar' (Arcuate) shaili mein 'ki-ston' (Key-stone) ka kya mahatv tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Locking the central arch to transfer superstructure... sahi nikalta hai. Pure decorative finial, Plaster painting surface, Latching double gates is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Locking the central arch to transfer superstructure weight to vertical abutments hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Locking the central arch to transfer superstructure weight to vertical abutments - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was the grand public water reservoir 'Hauz-i-Sultani' (King's Reservoir) constructed by Sultan Iltutmish?
qh: दिल्ली के सुल्तान इल्तुतमिश ने 'हौज़-ए-सुल्तानी' का निर्माण कहाँ करवाया था, जिसके लिए उन्हें बहुत सम्मान मिला?
o: Just outside the settlement walls of Dehli-i-Kuhna
e: Iltutmish ne common public ke water access ke liye Dehli-i-Kuhna city ke outside broad reservoir 'Hauz-i-Sultani' banwaya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki dilli ke sultan iltutamish ne 'hauj-e-sultani' ka nirman kahan karavaya tha, jisake lie unhein bahut samman mila? Isliye sahi nateeja Just outside the settlement walls of Dehli-i-Kuhna nikalta hai. In the city of Agra, Near Ajmer Sharif, Inside the Red Fort palace is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Just outside the settlement walls of Dehli-i-Kuhna hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Just outside the settlement walls of Dehli-i-Kuhna - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Beyond displaying wealth and military might, why did medieval kings patronize monumental temples and mosques?
qh: मध्यकाल में मंदिर और मस्जिदें शासकों द्वारा अपनी शक्ति और धन के प्रदर्शन के अलावा और किसलिए बनाई जाती थीं?
o: Exclusively for storage of foreign merchandise
To proclaim divine legitimacy and demonstrate intimacy with the supreme divine power
e: Medieval rulers religious structures build karke claim karte the ki wo God ke chosen representatives ya shadow of God (Zill-i-Ilahi) hain taaki moral legitimacy mile. Prashn yah batata hai ki madhyakal mein mandir aur masjidein shasakon dvara apani shakti aur dhan ke pradarshan ke alava aur kisalie banai jati thin? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isliye antim jawab To proclaim divine legitimacy and demonstrate intimacy... ke roop mein milta hai. Solely for festival theatricals, Exclusively for storage of foreign merchandise, To house standing military infantry is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad To proclaim divine legitimacy and demonstrate intimacy with the supreme divine power hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: To proclaim divine legitimacy and demonstrate intimacy with the supreme divine power - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which 9th-century Pandya monarch invaded Sri Lanka and carried off a priceless golden statue of Buddha from the jewel palace?
qh: 9वीं शताब्दी के दौरान किस पाण्ड्य राजा ने श्रीलंका पर आक्रमण कर बुद्ध की स्वर्ण प्रतिमा छीन ली थी?
e: Pandya king Shrimara Shrivallabha ne Sri Lanka invade kiya aur King Sena I ke palace se pure gold Buddha statue loot kar Tamil country le aaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 9vin shatabdi ke dauran kis pandy raja ne shrilanka par akraman kar buddh ki svarn pratima chhin li thi? Isliye antim jawab Shrimara Shrivallabha ke roop mein milta hai. Galti Rajaraja I, Sena I, Vijayalaya chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Shrimara Shrivallabha baithta hai. Exam point: Shrimara Shrivallabha - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: With statues pillaged from which vanquished rulers did Chola king Rajendra I adorn his imperial Shiva temple?
qh: चोल राजा राजेंद्र प्रथम ने अपने द्वारा निर्मित शिव मंदिर को किन शासकों से लूटी गई मूर्तियों से भर दिया था?
o: Chalukyas, Kalingas, and Palas of Bengal
e: Rajendra I ne Gangaikondacholapuram temple me defeated Chalukyas (Surya pitha), Kalingas (Bhairava/Nandi) aur Bengal ke Palas (Kali) se captured murtis install ki. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki chol raja rajeindr pratham ne apane dvara nirmit shiv mandir ko kin shasakon se luti gai murtiyon se bhar diya tha? In tathyon ke chalte Chalukyas, Kalingas, and Palas of Bengal hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Rajput desert chieftains, Foreign Roman governors, Mughal emperors exclusively - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Chalukyas, Kalingas, and Palas of Bengal hi milti hai. Exam point: Chalukyas, Kalingas, and Palas of Bengal - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which formal geometric garden layout did Mughal Emperor Babur popularize and describe in his autobiography?
qh: मुगल सम्राट बाबर ने अपनी आत्मकथा में किस प्रकार के उद्यानों में अपनी रुचि का वर्णन किया है?
e: Babur ne apni memoirs Baburnama me 'Chahar Bagh' garden layout me deep interest express kiya jisme walled garden ko intersecting canals se 4 equal parts me baanta jata tha. Is prashn ka kendra Chahar Bagh (Symmetrical four-quadrant formal gardens) hai. Isi baat se Chahar Bagh (Symmetrical four-quadrant formal gardens) sahi sabit hota hai. Wild botanical gardens, Floating lotus terraces, Terraced hillside steps ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Chahar Bagh (Symmetrical four-quadrant formal gardens) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Chahar Bagh (Symmetrical four-quadrant formal gardens) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What characterizes the decorative inlay architectural technique known as 'Pietra Dura'?
qh: मुगल वास्तुकला में 'पितरा-दूरा' (Pietra Dura) तकनीक का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Inlaying precious and semi-precious coloured stones into carved depressions in marble or sandstone
e: Pietra Dura (Parchin Kari) me white marble par lapis lazuli, onyx aur jasper jaise semi-precious stones ko carve karke floral patterns embed kiye jaate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mugal vastukala mein 'pitara-dura' (Pietra Dura) takanik ka kya arth hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Inlaying precious and semi-precious coloured stones into carved depressions in marble or sandstone hi sahi baithta hai. Polishing structural iron pillars, Timber lattice joinery, Fresco wall whitewash alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Inlaying precious and semi-precious coloured stones into carved depressions in marble or sandstone hai. Exam point: Inlaying precious and semi-precious coloured stones into carved depressions in marble or sandstone - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Greek mythological figure is depicted in Pietra Dura behind Shah Jahan's throne in the Diwan-i-Am of the Red Fort?
qh: शाहजहाँ ने दिल्ली के लाल किले में अपने सिंहासन के पीछे किस ग्रीक देवता को वीणा बजाते हुए 'पितरा-दूरा' में चित्रित करवाया था?
e: Red Fort ke Diwan-i-Am me throne ke peeche Greek god Orpheus ki pietra dura picture hai jiska lute music violent beasts ko tame kar deta tha, representing royal justice. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki shahajahan ne dilli ke lal kile mein apane sinhasan ke pichhe kis grik devata ko vina bajate hue 'pitara-dura' mein chitrit karavaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Orpheus (playing the lute) hi sahi baithta hai. Apollo, Hercules, Zeus alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Orpheus (playing the lute) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Orpheus (playing the lute) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In the 'River-Front Garden' layout pioneered by Shah Jahan in the Taj Mahal, where was the primary tomb situated?
qh: मुगल शासकों द्वारा अपनाई गई 'रिवर-फ्रंट गार्डन' (River-Front Garden) शैली में मुख्य इमारत या निवास कहाँ स्थित होता था?
o: Directly in the geometric center of the Chahar Bagh
At the edge of the garden on a high terrace adjacent to the river bank
e: Traditional Chahar Bagh ke center me tomb rakhne ke bajay Taj Mahal me white marble tomb ko Yamuna riverfront edge ke terrace par place kiya gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mugal shasakon dvara apanai gai 'rivar-phrant gardan' (River-Front Garden) shaili mein mukhy imarat ya nivas kahan sthit hota tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par At the edge of the garden on a high terrace adjacent to the river bank hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Directly in the geometric center of the Chahar Bagh, On an elevated mountain outcrop, Outside the outer entrance gateway in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan At the edge of the garden on... hi milti hai. Exam point: At the edge of the garden on a high terrace adjacent to the river bank - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In his new imperial capital Shahjahanabad, to whom did Shah Jahan grant exclusive residential access to the Yamuna riverfront?
qh: शाहजहाँ ने अपनी नई राजधानी 'शाहजहाँनाबाद' में यमुना नदी के तट पर केवल किसे अपना घर बनाने की अनुमति दी थी?
o: Favoured royal princes like Dara Shukoh and top imperial nobles
e: Shahjahanabad me riverfront mansions sirf royal family aur Dara Shukoh jaise highest favoured aristocrats ko allotted the; baaki city walled interior me develop hui. Prashn yah batata hai ki shahajahan ne apani nai rajadhani 'shahajahannabad' mein yamuna nadi ke tat par keval kise apana ghar banane ki anumati di thi? Isi baat se Favoured royal princes like Dara Shukoh and top imperial nobles sahi sabit hota hai. Common retail merchants, Foreign trading emissaries only, All urban subjects equally is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Favoured royal princes like Dara Shukoh and top imperial nobles baithta hai. Exam point: Favoured royal princes like Dara Shukoh and top imperial nobles - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What architectural vaulting design developed in Bengal was integrated by Mughal emperors into their palatial architecture?
qh: बंगाल के स्थानीय शासकों द्वारा विकसित 'बाँध की झोपड़ी' वाली छत की शैली को मुगलों ने किस नाम से अपनाया?
o: Bangla Dome (Curved roof mimicking bamboo thatch)
e: Bengal ki traditional curved hut roof ko Mughals ne adopt kiya jise 'Bangla Dome' (chhajja) kehte hain, jo Agra Fort aur Red Fort me prominent hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki bangal ke sthaniy shasakon dvara vikasit 'bandh ki jhopadai' vali chhat ki shaili ko mugalon ne kis nam se apanaya? Isi aadhar par Bangla Dome (Curved roof mimicking bamboo thatch) chuna jaata hai. Octagonal minaret, Spherical Persian dome, True pointed vault is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Bangla Dome (Curved roof mimicking bamboo thatch) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Bangla Dome (Curved roof mimicking bamboo thatch) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The architecture of Jodh Bai's palace inside Fatehpur Sikri exhibits pronounced stylistic influences from which regional kingdom?
qh: फ़तेहपुर सीकरी के 'जोधाबाई महल' की वास्तुकला पर किस क्षेत्र की वास्तुकला शैली का गहरा प्रभाव दिखता है?
e: Fatehpur Sikri ke Jodh Bai palace ke brackets, pillars aur carved motifs par Gujarat aur Malwa ke Hindu-Jain temple architecture ka direct impact dikhta hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki phatehapur sikari ke 'jodhabai mahal' ki vastukala par kis kshetr ki vastukala shaili ka gahara prabhav dikhata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Gujarat and Malwa sahi nikalta hai. Kashmir valley, Bengal Sultanate, Dravidian South is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Gujarat and Malwa sahi hai. Exam point: Gujarat and Malwa - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which architectural style characterized by soaring heights, pointed arches, and stained-glass windows emerged in 12th-century France?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी के दौरान फ्रांस में बने ऊँचे और हल्के चर्चों की शैली को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: 12th century France me Gothic architecture originate hua jisme pointed arches, ribbed vaults, flying buttresses aur stained-glass windows use hoti thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 12vin shatabdi ke dauran phrans mein bane unche aur halke charchon ki shaili ko kya kaha jata hai? Isi karan se Gothic style sahi uttar hai. Nagara style, Dravidian style, Romanesque rustic style mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Gothic style hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Gothic style - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In early medieval South India, what did the administrative term 'Nagaram' designate?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'नगरम्' (Nagaram) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Guilds and administrative organizations of merchants in market towns
e: Chola administration me 'Nagaram' commercial market towns me traders aur merchants ki governing corporate body hoti thi jo civic affairs manage karti thi. Is prashn ka vishay Guilds and administrative organizations of merchants in market towns hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Guilds and administrative organizations of merchants in market towns nikalta hai. Pastoralist village communities, Assemblies of Brahmin priests, The emperor's imperial cooks alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Guilds and administrative organizations of merchants in market towns baithta hai. Exam point: Guilds and administrative organizations of merchants in market towns - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What ceremonial function did the 'Diwan-i-Aam' and 'Diwan-i-Khas' serve in Mughal imperial palaces?
qh: मुगल काल में 'दीवान-ए-आम' और 'दीवान-ए-खास' का मुख्य प्रयोजन क्या था?
o: Halls of audience for public petitions and confidential imperial council
e: Diwan-i-Aam public audience ke liye tha jahan emperor aam janta se petitions leta tha, aur Diwan-i-Khas private cabinet meetings aur foreign envoys ke liye tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mugal kal mein 'divan-e-am' aur 'divan-e-khas' ka mukhy prayojan kya tha? Isliye antim jawab Halls of audience for public petitions and... ke roop mein milta hai. Enclosed congregational mosques, Dining mess halls exclusively, Royal cavalry horse stables in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Halls of audience for public petitions and confidential imperial council hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Halls of audience for public petitions and confidential imperial council - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who founded the Mughal Empire in India following his military victory at Panipat in 1526?
qh: मुगल साम्राज्य की स्थापना 1526 में किसने की थी?
e: Fergana ke prince Babur ne 1526 me First Battle of Panipat jeet kar Delhi aur Agra me Mughal dynasty establish ki. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mugal samrajy ki sthapana 1526 mein kisane ki thi?
