Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi karan se Babur (Zahiruddin Muhammad) sahi uttar hai. Timur, Humayun, Akbar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Babur (Zahiruddin Muhammad) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Babur (Zahiruddin Muhammad) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From whom were the Mughal monarchs matrilineally descended on their mother's side?
qh: मुगल शासक अपनी माता की ओर से किसके वंशज थे?
e: Mughals mother's side se Mongol warlord Genghis Khan (Chingiz Khan) ke descendants the, halanki wo khud ko 'Timurids' kehlana pasand karte the. Prashn yah batata hai ki mugal shasak apani mata ki or se kisake vanshaj the? Isliye antim jawab Genghis Khan (Mongol conqueror) ke roop mein milta hai. Ibrahim Lodi, Sher Shah Suri, Timur anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Genghis Khan (Mongol conqueror) baithta hai. Exam point: Genghis Khan (Mongol conqueror) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Patrilineally on their father's side, which Central Asian empire-builder did the Mughals trace descent from?
qh: मुगल अपने पिता की ओर से किसके उत्तराधिकारी या वंशज माने जाते थे?
e: Father's side se Babur Central Asia, Iran aur Iraq ke conqueror Timur (Tamerlane) ka 5th generation direct descendant tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mugal apane pita ki or se kisake uttaradhikari ya vanshaj mane jate the? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi baat se Timur (Tamerlane) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Genghis Khan, Qutbuddin Aibak, Akbar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Timur (Tamerlane) hi milti hai. Exam point: Timur (Tamerlane) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Whom did Babur decisively vanquish in the Battle of Khanwa in 1527 to secure his hold over Northern India?
qh: बाबर ने 1527 में खानवा के युद्ध में किसे पराजित किया था?
e: 1527 me Battle of Khanwa me Babur ne Mewar ke Rana Sanga aur unke Rajput confederacy alliance ko defeat kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki babar ne 1527 mein khanava ke yuddh mein kise parajit kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Rana Sanga of Mewar hi sahi baithta hai. Ibrahim Lodi, Hemu, Medini Rai mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Rana Sanga of Mewar hi milti hai. Exam point: Rana Sanga of Mewar - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Mughal Emperor lost his throne to Sher Shah Suri, went into exile in Safavid Persia, and recaptured Delhi in 1555?
qh: किस मुगल सम्राट को दो बार शासन करना पड़ा और बीच में उसे ईरान भागना पड़ा था?
e: Humayun Battle of Chausa (1539) aur Kannauj (1540) me Sher Shah se har kar Persia bhag gaya tha; 1555 me usne Safavid help se wapas Delhi recapture ki. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kis mugal samrat ko do bar shasan karana pada aur bich mein use iran bhagana pada tha? In tathyon ke chalte Humayun hi sahi hai. Jahangir, Babur, Shah Jahan is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Humayun hi hai. Exam point: Humayun - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: At what tender age did Jalaluddin Muhammad Akbar ascend the Mughal throne following Humayun's death in 1556?
qh: अकबर मात्र कितने वर्ष की आयु में सम्राट बना था?
e: Humayun ki sudden death ke baad 1556 me Kalanaur (Punjab) me Akbar ko sirf 13 years ki age me coronation karwaya gaya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki akabar matr kitane varsh ki ayu mein samrat bana tha? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isliye sahi nateeja 13 years old nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - 21 years old, 18 years old, 10 years old - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 13 years old hi hai. Exam point: 13 years old - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who served as the guardian regent (Ataliq) of young Emperor Akbar during the initial years of his reign (1556-1560)?
qh: अकबर के शासनकाल के शुरुआती वर्षों में उसका संरक्षक (Regent) कौन था?
e: Bairam Khan Akbar ka regent aur military commander tha jinhone Second Battle of Panipat (1556) me Hemu ko defeat kiya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki akabar ke shasanakal ke shuruati varshon mein usaka sanrakshak (Regent) kaun tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Bairam Khan (Khan-i-Khanan) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - Raja Man Singh, Abul Fazl, Todar Mal - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Bairam Khan (Khan-i-Khanan) hi hai. Exam point: Bairam Khan (Khan-i-Khanan) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In the administrative bureaucracy of the Mughal Empire, what did a 'Mansab' designate?
qh: मुगल प्रशासन में 'मनसब' (Mansab) शब्द का क्या अर्थ था?
o: A standardized institutional rank or position
e: Mansab ka matlab imperial hierarchy me rank ya position hota tha, jo official ka pay (zat) aur military troop requirement (sawar) fix karta tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki mugal prashasan mein 'manasab' (Mansab) shabd ka kya arth tha? Isi aadhar par A standardized institutional rank or position chuna jaata hai. Vikalp A judicial priest, A seasonal crop tax, A minted gold coin bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab A standardized institutional rank or position hai. Exam point: A standardized institutional rank or position - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which innovative land revenue assessment system based on 10-year crop surveys was instituted by Raja Todar Mal?
qh: अकबर के राजस्व मंत्री टोडरमल ने कौन सी नई राजस्व प्रणाली शुरू की थी?
e: Akbar ke finance minister Raja Todar Mal ne 1580 me 'Ain-i-Dahsala' (Zabt) system introduce kiya jo past 10 years ke crop yields aur average prices par based tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki akabar ke rajasv mantri todaramal ne kaun si nai rajasv pranali shuru ki thi? iqta ek jagir wali vyavastha thi jismein sultan sipahiyon ko zameen ki aay ka haq deta tha. Isi karan se Zabt (Dahsala system) sahi uttar hai. Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari system, Iqta system is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Zabt (Dahsala system) hi milti hai. Exam point: Zabt (Dahsala system) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who authored the official court chronicle 'Akbarnama' documenting the life and reign of Emperor Akbar?
qh: अकबर की जीवनी 'अकबर नामा' के लेखक कौन थे?
e: Akbar ke close friend aur navratna Abul Fazl ne Persian language me official three-volume biography 'Akbarnama' compose ki. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki akabar ki jivani 'akabar nama' ke lekhak kaun the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Abul Fazl sahi nikalta hai. Gulbadan Begum, Birbal, Faizi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Abul Fazl hi milti hai. Exam point: Abul Fazl - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which volume of the Akbarnama comprises the statistical, legal, and administrative compendium known as 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qh: 'आईने-अकबरी' (Ain-i-Akbari) अकबर नामा का कौन सा खंड (Volume) है?
e: Akbarnama ka third volume 'Ain-i-Akbari' hai jisme Mughal administrative machinery, rules aur economic survey data codified hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 'aine-akabari' (Ain-i-Akbari) akabar nama ka kaun sa khand (Volume) hai? ain-i-akbari Akbarnama ka hissa thi jismein sasan ke aankde the. Isliye sahi nateeja Third volume nikalta hai. Fourth volume, First volume, Second volume is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Third volume hi milti hai. Exam point: Third volume - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the major administrative provinces of the Mughal Empire called?
qh: मुगल साम्राज्य में प्रांतों (Provinces) को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Mughal Empire provinces me divided tha jinhe 'Subas' kehte the, aur har Suba ka head political-military officer 'Subadar' hota tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mugal samrajy mein pranton (Provinces) ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi tathya par Subas tika hua hai. Vikalp Parganas, Iqtas, Grams bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Subas hai. Exam point: Subas - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the foundational philosophical principle behind Emperor Akbar's policy of 'Sulh-i-kul'?
qh: अकबर द्वारा शुरू किए गए 'सुलह-ए-कुल' (Sulh-i-kul) के विचार का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Universal peace, ethical tolerance, and justice across all religions
e: Sulh-i-kul ka literal meaning 'Universal Peace' tha; ye state policy thi jisme religion ke basis par discrimination nahi hota tha aur justice par focus tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki akabar dvara shuru kie gae 'sulah-e-kul' (Sulh-i-kul) ke vichar ka kya arth tha? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi karan se Universal peace, ethical tolerance, and justice across all religions sahi uttar hai. Galti Rigid tax collection policy, Exclusive military alliance, Expansionist warfare doctrine chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Universal peace, ethical tolerance, and justice across... hi milti hai. Exam point: Universal peace, ethical tolerance, and justice across... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In provincial Mughal administration, which executive was charged with financial management and revenue audits?
qh: मुगल प्रशासन में 'दीवान' (Diwan) किस विभाग का प्रमुख अधिकारी होता था?
e: Suba level par 'Diwan' financial aur revenue officer hota tha jo center ke directly report karta tha aur Subadar ki powers ko counterbalance karta tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki mugal prashasan mein 'divan' (Diwan) kis vibhag ka pramukh adhikari hota tha? Isi karan se Provincial Financial and Revenue Department sahi uttar hai. Town municipal police, Military recruitment, Religious charities and endowments in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Provincial Financial and Revenue Department hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Provincial Financial and Revenue Department - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan confined by his son Aurangzeb during his final years?
qh: शाहजहाँ को उसके अंतिम दिनों में कहाँ कैद कर दिया गया था?
e: War of succession ke baad Aurangzeb ne Shah Jahan ko Agra Fort ke Musamman Burj me confine kar diya jahan se wo Taj Mahal dekh sakte the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki shahajahan ko usake antim dinon mein kahan kaid kar diya gaya tha? Aurangzeb Mughal badshah tha jiske samay mein Maratha sangharsh tatha rajy ka vistar hua. In tathyon ke chalte Agra Fort (Shah Burj) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Red Fort, Delhi, Gwalior Fort, Lahore Fort - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Agra Fort (Shah Burj) hi hai. Exam point: Agra Fort (Shah Burj) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What imperial honorific title was conferred upon Mehrunnisa following her marriage to Emperor Jahangir?
qh: जहांगीर की पत्नी 'मेहरून्निसा' को किस उपाधि से सम्मानित किया गया था?
e: 1611 me Mehrunnisa se nikah ke baad Jahangir ne use 'Nur Mahal' aur baad me 'Nur Jahan' (Light of the World) ka title diya; unke naam par coins bhi issue hue. Prashn yah batata hai ki jahangir ki patni 'meharunnisa' ko kis upadhi se sammanit kiya gaya tha? Isi baat se Nur Jahan (Light of the World) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Maryam-uz-Zamani, Zeenat Mahal, Mumtaz Mahal - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Nur Jahan (Light of the World) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Nur Jahan (Light of the World) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the primary civil responsibility of the 'Kotwal' in Mughal urban governance?
qh: मुगल काल में 'कोतवाल' (Kotwal) का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Town police commander maintaining law, order, and night watch
e: Kotwal city ka chief police officer hota tha jo law and order, night patrolling, market pricing aur census records maintain karta tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki mugal kal mein 'kotaval' (Kotwal) ka mukhy kary kya tha? kotwal sheher mein aman tatha kanoon sambhalne wala adhikari tha. Isi baat se Town police commander maintaining law, order, and night watch sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Presiding over religious court disputes, Collecting agrarian land taxes, Agricultural field inspection chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Town police commander maintaining law, order, and night watch hai. Exam point: Town police commander maintaining law, order, and night watch - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which theological dialogue chamber did Akbar construct at Fatehpur Sikri in 1575 for interfaith debates?
qh: अकबर ने विभिन्न धर्मों के विद्वानों के साथ चर्चा करने के लिए किस स्थान का निर्माण करवाया था?
e: Akbar ne 1575 me Fatehpur Sikri me 'Ibadat Khana' construct kiya jahan pehle Muslim sects aur baad me Hindu, Christian, Jain aur Zoroastrian scholars debate karte the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki akabar ne vibhinn dharmon ke vidvanon ke sath charcha karane ke lie kis sthan ka nirman karavaya tha? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi karan se Ibadat Khana (Hall of Prayer) sahi uttar hai. Diwan-i-Aam, Panch Mahal, Buland Darwaza alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Ibadat Khana (Hall of Prayer) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Ibadat Khana (Hall of Prayer) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which Maratha sovereign was humiliated in the Mughal court at Agra by Aurangzeb in 1666, prompting his escape?
qh: औरंगजेब ने किस क्षेत्र के राजा 'शिवाजी' का अपमान किया था, जिसके बाद उन्होंने मुगलों के खिलाफ संघर्ष किया?
e: Treaty of Purandar ke baad 1666 me Shivaji Maharaj Agra court gaye jahan Aurangzeb ne unhe low rank mansabdars ke peeche khada karke insult kiya, jahan se wo escape hue. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki aurangajeb ne kis kshetr ke raja 'shivaji' ka apaman kiya tha, jisake bad unhonne mugalon ke khilaph sangharsh kiya? Shivaji Maratha raj ke sansthapak the jinhone apne rajy mein vyavasthit sasan khada kiya. Isi tathya par Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj tika hua hai. Vikalp Raja Amar Singh, Maharaja Suraj Mal, Rana Pratap bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj hi hai. Exam point: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the institutional role of the imperial official designated as 'Mir Bakshi' in the Mughal Empire?
qh: मुगल काल में 'बख्शी' (Bakshi) नामक अधिकारी का क्या उत्तरदायित्व था?
o: Military paymaster in charge of mansabdars' records and military inspection
e: Mir Bakshi head of military department tha jo mansabdars ke appointment, military muster verification aur salary payment certificates issue karta tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki mugal kal mein 'bakhshi' (Bakshi) namak adhikari ka kya uttaradayitv tha? mir bakshi Mughal darbar ka mukhya fauji adhikari tha. Isliye antim jawab Military paymaster in charge of mansabdars' records... ke roop mein milta hai. Supreme civil judge, Imperial master of the kitchen, Inspector of religious endowments is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Military paymaster in charge of mansabdars' records and military inspection hi milti hai. Exam point: Military paymaster in charge of mansabdars' records... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under which medieval Rajput dynasty did Delhi first rise to prominence as a kingdom's capital in the 12th century?
qh: दिल्ली पहली बार किस राजवंश के शासनकाल में साम्राज्य की राजधानी बनी?
e: 12th century ke middle me Tomar Rajputs (Anangpal Tomar) ke rule ke under Delhi (Dhillika) pehli baar capital bani. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki dilli pahali bar kis rajavansh ke shasanakal mein samrajy ki rajadhani bani? Isi baat se Tomar Rajputs sahi sabit hota hai. Tughlaq dynasty, Chauhan dynasty, Mamluk Slave dynasty alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Tomar Rajputs hai. Exam point: Tomar Rajputs - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which regional power defeated the Tomars in the mid-12th century to capture sovereign control over Delhi?
qh: तोमर राजपूतों को 12वीं शताब्दी के मध्य में किसने पराजित कर दिल्ली पर अधिकार किया था?
e: Ajmer ke Chahamanas (Chauhans) ne 12th century me Tomars ko defeat karke Delhi ko apne kingdom me merge kiya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki tomar rajaputon ko 12vin shatabdi ke madhy mein kisane parajit kar dilli par adhikar kiya tha? Isi aadhar par Chauhans (Chahamanas) of Ajmer chuna jaata hai. Shamsuddin Iltutmish, Qutbuddin Aibak, Mahmud of Ghazni is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Chauhans (Chahamanas) of Ajmer hai. Exam point: Chauhans (Chahamanas) of Ajmer - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the official administrative and court language throughout the tenure of the Delhi Sultanate?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत के सुल्तानों के शासनकाल में प्रशासन की भाषा कौन सी थी?
e: Delhi Sultanate ke administrative offices, chronicles aur court proceedings me Persian (Farsi) official language thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki dilli saltanat ke sultanon ke shasanakal mein prashasan ki bhasha kaun si thi? Isliye sahi nateeja Persian (Farsi) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Urdu, Arabic, Hindustani - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se Persian (Farsi) sahi hai. Exam point: Persian (Farsi) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the historiographical term 'Tawarikh' (singular: Tarikh) denote during the Sultanate era?
qh: इतिहास में 'तवारीख' (Tawarikh) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Chronicles and written historical narratives composed by learned court secretaries
e: Tawarikh (Tarikh ka plural) un historical chronicles ko kaha jata tha jo literate secretaries, poets aur courtiers Persian me compose karte the. Is prashn ka vishay Chronicles and written historical narratives composed by learned court secretaries hai. Isi tathya par Chronicles and written historical narratives composed by... tika hua hai. Military garrison barracks, Minted copper coins, A customs border tariff in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Chronicles and written historical narratives composed by learned court secretaries baithta hai. Exam point: Chronicles and written historical narratives composed by... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Whose daughter was Raziyya Sultan, who ascended the throne of the Delhi Sultanate in 1236 CE?
qh: सन् 1236 में दिल्ली की सुल्तान बनने वाली रजिया सुल्तान किसकी पुत्री थी?
e: Raziyya Sultan Iltutmish ki daughter thi; Iltutmish ne apne incompetent sons ke bajay Raziyya ko apna heir nominate kiya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki san 1236 mein dilli ki sultan banane vali rajiya sultan kisaki putri thi? Yahi wajah hai ki Sultan Shamsuddin Iltutmish sahi hai. Vikalp Alauddin Khalji, Qutbuddin Aibak, Ghiyasuddin Balban bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Sultan Shamsuddin Iltutmish hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Sultan Shamsuddin Iltutmish - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What ideological judgment did chronicler Minhaj-i-Siraj render regarding the reign of Raziyya Sultan?
qh: इतिहासकार मिन्हाज-ए-सिराज ने रजिया सुल्तान के बारे में क्या विचार व्यक्त किए थे?
o: She was far more capable than her brothers, but her rule violated the divinely ordained gender hierarchy
She was a brilliant general who conquered the Deccan
She was entirely incompetent to rule
She had no understanding of statecraft
e: Minhaj-i-Siraj ne maana ki wo apne sabhi bhaiyo se zyada capable aur qualified thi, par medieval patriarchal mindset ke chalte female rule unhe unacceptable laga. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki itihasakar minhaj-e-siraj ne rajiya sultan ke bare mein kya vichar vyakt kie the? Isi baat se She was far more capable than her brothers, but her rule violated the divinely ordained gender hierarchy sahi sabit hota hai. She was a brilliant general who conquered the Deccan, She was entirely incompetent to rule, She had no understanding of statecraft is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav She was far more capable than her brothers, but her rule violated the divinely ordained gender hierarchy hi thehrta hai. Exam point: She was far more capable than her brothers, but her rule violated the divinely ordained gender hierarchy - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the military definition of a 'Garrison Town' in the early Delhi Sultanate?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत में 'गैरिसन टाउन' (Garrison Town) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: A heavily fortified urban settlement housing a stationed standing military garrison
A hospice for foreign caravan travelers
e: Garrison town (jaise Siri ya Hansi) ek walled fortified settlement hota tha jahan soldiers troops ke sath stationed hote the taaki border secure rahe. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki dilli saltanat mein 'gairisan taun' (Garrison Town) ka kya arth tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par A heavily fortified urban settlement housing a stationed standing military garrison hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. A hospice for foreign caravan travelers, An open weekly trading market, A centralized granary depot alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar A heavily fortified urban settlement housing a stationed standing military garrison hi hai. Exam point: A heavily fortified urban settlement housing a... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the spatial term 'Hinterland' denote in the context of medieval Sultanate garrison towns?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत के आरंभिक काल में 'हिंटरलैंड' (Hinterland) शब्द किसके लिए प्रयुक्त होता था?
o: The adjacent countryside and agricultural land that supplied goods, grain, and provisions to a city
The inner residential sanctum of a royal fort
e: Hinterland city ke surrounding us rural agricultural area ko kehte the jo city ya port ko food, supplies aur trade raw materials provide karta tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki dilli saltanat ke aranbhik kal mein 'hintaralaind' (Hinterland) shabd kisake lie prayukt hota tha? Yahi wajah hai ki The adjacent countryside and agricultural land that supplied goods, grain, and provisions to a city sahi hai. Unconquered hostile enemy territory, Inaccessible rugged mountain peaks, The inner residential sanctum of a royal fort anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar The adjacent countryside and agricultural land that... hi hai. Exam point: The adjacent countryside and agricultural land that supplied goods, grain, and provisions to a city - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Whom did Sultan Iltutmish elevate into trust-bound provincial military governors in preference to hereditary aristocrats?
qh: इल्तुतमिश ने विश्वसनीय गवर्नर और प्रशासक बनाने के लिए किन लोगों को प्राथमिकता दी थी?
e: Iltutmish ne aristocrats par trust na karke Persian elite-trained military slaves 'Bandagan' ko governors banaya kyunki unki loyalty sirf Sultan ke prati thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki iltutamish ne vishvasaniy gavarnar aur prashasak banane ke lie kin logon ko prathamikata di thi? Isi karan se Specially trained military slave-officers termed 'Bandagan' sahi uttar hai. Foreign mercantile financiers, Hereditary noble land barons, Local Rajput chieftains is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Specially trained military slave-officers termed 'Bandagan' hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Specially trained military slave-officers termed 'Bandagan' - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the territorial revenue assignment granted to military commanders in the Delhi Sultanate called?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत में सैन्य कमांडरों को दी जाने वाली ज़मीन को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Military commanders ko di gayi territorial revenue assignments ko 'Iqta' kehte the aur unke holders ko 'Iqtadar' ya 'Muqti' kaha jata tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki dilli saltanat mein sainy kamandaron ko di jane vali jamin ko kya kaha jata tha? iqta ek jagir wali vyavastha thi jismein sultan sipahiyon ko zameen ki aay ka haq deta tha. Isi baat se Iqta sahi sabit hota hai. Kharaj, Inam, Zakat ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Iqta hai. Exam point: Iqta - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the primary constitutional duty expected of an Iqtadar or 'Muqti' in his assigned province?
qh: इक्तादार या 'मुक्ति' (Muqti) का मुख्य कर्तव्य क्या था?
o: Leading military campaigns and maintaining provincial law and order with assigned troops
e: Muqti ka main obligation military campaigns me troops provide karna, revenue collect karna aur apne assigned territory me law and order maintain karna tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki iktadar ya 'mukti' (Muqti) ka mukhy kartavy kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Leading military campaigns and maintaining provincial law... sahi nikalta hai. Minting imperial currency coins, Farming his own estate plots, Religious conversion campaigns mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Leading military campaigns and maintaining provincial law and order with assigned troops hai. Exam point: Leading military campaigns and maintaining provincial law... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What proportion of peasant harvest was extracted as 'Kharaj' under the agrarian regulations of Alauddin Khalji?
qh: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी के शासनकाल में कृषि पर लगाए जाने वाले कर 'खराज' की दर क्या थी?
e: Alauddin Khalji ne standard land tax 'Kharaj' ko enhance karke standard 50% of total agricultural produce fix kiya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki alauddin khilaji ke shasanakal mein krishi par lagae jane vale kar 'kharaj' ki dar kya thi? kharaj kheti ki paidawar par lagne wala mukhya lagaan tha. Isliye antim jawab 50% of the peasant's agricultural yield ke roop mein milta hai. 75% of grain production, 10% of total harvest, 25% of agricultural produce is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 50% of the peasant's agricultural yield hi milti hai. Exam point: 50% of the peasant's agricultural yield - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Mongol conqueror founded the steppe empire whose successors launched repeated raids on Delhi under Khalji and Tughluq?
qh: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी और मोहम्मद तुगलक के समय में भारत पर आक्रमण करने वाले मंगोल नेता कौन थे?
e: Genghis Khan ke under unite hue Mongols ne 1219 me Transoxiana invasion ke baad Sultanate frontiers par continuous pressure banaya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki alauddin khilaji aur mohammad tugalak ke samay mein bharat par akraman karane vale mangol neta kaun the? Yahi wajah hai ki Genghis Khan (and his descendants) sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Timur, Hulagu Khan, Babur - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Genghis Khan (and his descendants) hi milti hai. Exam point: Genghis Khan (and his descendants) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which new fortified garrison town was constructed by Alauddin Khalji in Delhi to station his standing army against the Mongols?
qh: मंगोल आक्रमणों से सुरक्षा के लिए अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने दिल्ली में कौन सा नया गैरिसन टाउन (शहर) बसाया था?
e: Alauddin Khalji ne Mongol threat se deal karne ke liye Delhi me 'Siri' namak new circular garrison city construct kiya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki mangol akramanon se suraksha ke lie alauddin khilaji ne dilli mein kaun sa naya gairisan taun (shahar) basaya tha? Isliye antim jawab Siri ke roop mein milta hai. Jahanpanah, Daulatabad, Tughluqabad ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Siri hi hai. Exam point: Siri - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Sultan of Delhi ordered the forced migration of Delhi's urban population to his southern capital of Daulatabad?
qh: किस सुल्तान ने दिल्ली के निवासियों को जबरन दक्षिण भारत की नई राजधानी 'दौलताबाद' स्थानांतरित किया था?
e: Muhammad bin Tughluq ne South India par control rakhne ke liye 1327 me capital Delhi se Daulatabad (Devagiri) shift karwayi jisse logo ko immense misery hui. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kis sultan ne dilli ke nivasiyon ko jabaran dakshin bharat ki nai rajadhani 'daulatabad' sthanantarit kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Muhammad bin Tughluq nikalta hai. Alauddin Khalji, Ghiyasuddin Balban, Firuz Shah Tughluq mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Muhammad bin Tughluq baithta hai. Exam point: Muhammad bin Tughluq - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why did the brass and copper 'Token Currency' introduced by Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq collapse in disaster?
qh: मुहम्मद तुगलक द्वारा शुरू की गई 'टोकन करेंसी' (सांकेतिक मुद्रा) असफल क्यों रही?
o: The coins were excessively heavy to transport
The coins were struck in rare metals
The state failed to control minting, leading to massive domestic counterfeiting of copper/brass tokens
e: Token coins me state monopoly na hone se har house mint ban gaya aur log easily counterfeit coins forge karke taxes pay karne lage. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki muhammad tugalak dvara shuru ki gai 'tokan kareinsi' (sanketik mudra) asaphal kyon rahi? Isi tathya par The state failed to control minting, leading... tika hua hai. Foreign maritime trade was terminated, The coins were excessively heavy to transport, The coins were struck in rare metals mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar The state failed to control minting, leading to massive domestic counterfeiting of copper/brass tokens hai. Exam point: The state failed to control minting, leading to massive domestic counterfeiting of copper/brass tokens - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What interdependent societal relationship was conceptualized by medieval Islamic chroniclers as the 'Circle of Justice'?
qh: इतिहासकार 'सर्कल ऑफ जस्टिस' (न्याय चक्र) का संबंध किससे मानते हैं?
o: The mutual dependence binding the King, the standing army, state revenue, and prosperous peasantry
e: Circle of Justice state karta hai: King army par depend karta hai, army salary par, salary taxes par, aur taxes tabhi aayenge jab peasants prosperous aur protected honge. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki itihasakar 'sarkal oph jastis' (nyay chakr) ka sanbandh kisase manate hain? Isi karan se The mutual dependence binding the King, the standing army, state revenue, and prosperous peasantry sahi uttar hai. Prison detention procedures, A physical courtroom design, A military defense ring is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab The mutual dependence binding the King, the... hai. Exam point: The mutual dependence binding the King, the... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Afghan ruler defeated Humayun in the battles of Chausa and Kannauj to seize the throne of Delhi in 1540?
qh: 15वीं शताब्दी में शेरशाह सूरी ने किस मुगल सम्राट को हराकर दिल्ली पर अधिकार किया था?
e: Sher Shah Suri ne Humayun ko 1539 (Chausa) aur 1540 (Kannauj/Bilgram) me defeat karke Sur Empire establish kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 15vin shatabdi mein sherashah suri ne kis mugal samrat ko harakar dilli par adhikar kiya tha? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi karan se Humayun sahi uttar hai. Jahangir, Babur, Akbar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Humayun hai. Exam point: Humayun - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which institutional administrative structure instituted by Sher Shah Suri served as the direct operational model for Akbar?
qh: शेरशाह सूरी के प्रशासन का वह कौन सा मॉडल था जिसे बाद में सम्राट अकबर ने अपनाया था?
o: His systematic land measurement, revenue assessment, road network, and administrative divisions
e: Sher Shah ki systematic revenue system (ray), pargana administration aur Grand Trunk road networks ko Akbar ne adopt aur refine kiya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki sherashah suri ke prashasan ka vah kaun sa modal tha jise bad mein samrat akabar ne apanaya tha? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi karan se His systematic land measurement, revenue assessment, road... sahi uttar hai. His orthodox religious policies, His marriage treaties, His cavalry army exclusively is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar His systematic land measurement, revenue assessment, road network, and administrative divisions hai. Exam point: His systematic land measurement, revenue assessment, road... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What rural defensive strategy used by Indian forest chieftains to resist Sultanate forces was described by Ibn Battuta?
qh: प्रसिद्ध मोरक्कन यात्री इब्न बतूता ने दिल्ली सल्तनत के बारे में किस पक्ष का विस्तृत वर्णन किया है?
o: Fortifying themselves inside dense, impassable bamboo groves impervious to fire
e: Ibn Battuta ne describe kiya ki local chieftains impenetrable bamboo forests me hide ho jaate the jahan sword aur fire ka asar nahi hota tha aur wahi se resist karte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki prasiddh morakkan yatri ibn batuta ne dilli saltanat ke bare mein kis paksh ka vistrit varnan kiya hai? Isi baat se Fortifying themselves inside dense, impassable bamboo groves impervious to fire sahi sabit hota hai. Hiring foreign archers, Subterranean tunnel combat, Naval river warfare only anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Fortifying themselves inside dense, impassable bamboo groves impervious to fire hai. Exam point: Fortifying themselves inside dense, impassable bamboo groves impervious to fire - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What political title was conferred upon wealthy landowners and warrior chieftains by early medieval monarchs in the 7th century?
qh: सातवीं शताब्दी के दौरान बड़े भूस्वामियों या योद्धा सरदारों को राजाओं द्वारा किस रूप में मान्यता दी गई थी?
e: Kings influential landlords ko 'Samantas' ke roop me acknowledge karte the jo court me gifts laate the aur wars me military help dete the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki satavin shatabdi ke dauran badae bhusvamiyon ya yoddha saradaron ko rajaon dvara kis rup mein manyata di gai thi? amatya Maurya kal ke bade adhikari ya mantri the. Isliye antim jawab Samantas (Subordinate Feudatories) ke roop mein milta hai. Galti Amatyas, Senapatis, Maharajas chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Samantas (Subordinate Feudatories) hi milti hai. Exam point: Samantas (Subordinate Feudatories) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Rashtrakuta chieftain overthrew his Badami Chalukya overlord and performed the royal 'Hiranya-Garbha' ritual?
qh: राष्ट्रकूट वंश के किस शासक ने अपने चालुक्य स्वामी की अधीनता से इनकार कर दिया और 'हिरण्य-गर्भ' नामक अनुष्ठान किया?
e: Dantidurga ne 8th century me Chalukyas ko overthrow karke Rashtrakuta kingdom banayi aur Ujjain me 'Hiranya-Garbha' mahadana perform kiya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki rashtrakut vansh ke kis shasak ne apane chaluky svami ki adhinata se inakar kar diya aur 'hirany-garbh' namak anushthan kiya? Isliye sahi nateeja Dantidurga nikalta hai. Amoghavarsha I, Govinda III, Krishna I mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Dantidurga baithta hai. Exam point: Dantidurga - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the ritualistic theological objective of conducting the 'Hiranya-Garbha' ceremony?
qh: 'हिरण्य-गर्भ' (Hiranya-Garbha) अनुष्ठान का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: Golden Womb ritual symbolizing the rebirth of a non-Kshatriya sacrificer as a legitimate Kshatriya
e: Hiranya-Garbha (Golden Womb) ritual Brahmins dwara perform karwaya jata tha taaki non-Kshatriya ruler symbolically Kshatriya rebirth claim kar sake. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 'hirany-garbh' (Hiranya-Garbha) anushthan ka shabdik arth kya hai? vedic kaal woh samay hai jab ved tatha yagya-karm pramukh the. Isi baat se Golden Womb ritual symbolizing the rebirth of a non-Kshatriya sacrificer as a legitimate Kshatriya sahi sabit hota hai. Vedic horse sacrifice, Consecrating river water, Imperial chariot race is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Golden Womb ritual symbolizing the rebirth of a non-Kshatriya sacrificer as a legitimate Kshatriya hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Golden Womb ritual symbolizing the rebirth of a non-Kshatriya sacrificer as a legitimate Kshatriya - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which two learned Brahmin lineages abandoned their priestly professions to carve out independent warrior kingdoms in Karnataka and Rajasthan?
qh: कदम्ब मयूरशर्मन और गुर्जर-प्रतिहार हरिश्चंद्र ने अपना पारंपरिक पेशा छोड़कर क्या अपनाया?
o: Taking up arms and establishing kingdoms (Kadamba Mayurasharman & Gurjara-Pratihara Harichandra)
e: Kadamba Mayurasharman (Karnataka) aur Gurjara-Pratihara Harichandra (Rajasthan) Brahmins the, jinhone traditional duties chhodkar military kingdoms establish kiye. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kadamb mayurasharman aur gurjar-pratihar harishchandr ne apana paranparik pesha chhodakar kya apanaya? In tathyon ke chalte Taking up arms and establishing kingdoms (Kadamba Mayurasharman & Gurjara-Pratihara Harichandra) hi sahi hai. Stone sculpture masonry, Maritime trading, Subsistence farming alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Taking up arms and establishing kingdoms (Kadamba... hi milti hai. Exam point: Taking up arms and establishing kingdoms (Kadamba... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What sovereign political claim was asserted by early medieval monarchs when adopting the title 'Maharajadhiraja'?
qh: मध्यकाल में राजाओं द्वारा धारण की गई उच्च ध्वनि वाली उपाधि 'महाराजाधिराज' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Great King, Overlord of subordinate kings
e: Maharajadhiraja ka matlab 'King of Kings' hota tha, jisse ruler apne subordinate samantas aur chote kings par superior suzerainty assert karta tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki madhyakal mein rajaon dvara dharan ki gai uchch dhvani vali upadhi 'maharajadhiraj' ka kya arth hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Great King, Overlord of subordinate kings sahi nikalta hai. High priest, Protector of the poor, Monarch of the ocean anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Great King, Overlord of subordinate kings hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Great King, Overlord of subordinate kings - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Among the 400 taxes recorded in Chola epigraphs, how was the ubiquitously cited 'Vetti' tax exacted?
qh: चोल शिलालेखों में वर्णित 400 से अधिक करों (taxes) में सबसे अधिक उल्लेखित 'वेट्टि' (Vetti) कर किस रूप में लिया जाता था?
o: In the form of uncompensated forced labour
e: Chola inscriptions me 'Vetti' sabse frequently mentioned tax tha jo cash me nahi balki free forced labour ke roop me liya jata tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki chol shilalekhon mein varnit 400 se adhik karon (taxes) mein sabase adhik ullekhit 'vetti' (Vetti) kar kis rup mein liya jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par In the form of uncompensated forced labour hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - In silver coins, In measured paddy sacks, In gold ingots - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab In the form of uncompensated forced labour hai. Exam point: In the form of uncompensated forced labour - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Gurjara-Pratihara king's martial conquests across Northern India are commemorated in the Sanskrit Gwalior Prashasti?
qh: ग्वालियर (मध्य प्रदेश) से प्राप्त प्रशस्ति में किस गुर्जर-प्रतिहार शासक की उपलब्धियों का वर्णन मिलता है?
e: Gwalior Prashasti Gurjara-Pratihara ruler Nagabhata I ki military victories aur Arab invasions ko resist karne ke achievements record karti hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gvaliyar (madhy pradesh) se prapt prashasti mein kis gurjar-pratihar shasak ki upalabdhiyon ka varnan milata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Nagabhata I sahi nikalta hai. Vikalp Vatsaraja, Mihira Bhoja, Mahendrapala I bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Nagabhata I hi milti hai. Exam point: Nagabhata I - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who authored the historical chronicle 'Rajatarangini' (River of Kings) documenting the dynastic history of Kashmir?
qh: कश्मीर के राजाओं का इतिहास बताने वाली प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत कविता 'राजतरंगिणी' के लेखक कौन थे?
e: 12th century me Kashmiri scholar Kalhana ne 'Rajatarangini' likhi, jise critical historical method (inscriptions, coins, records) ka pioneer text maana jata hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kashmir ke rajaon ka itihas batane vali prasiddh sanskrit kavita 'rajatarangini' ke lekhak kaun the? Isi karan se Kalhana sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Bilhana, Chanakya, Banabhatta bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Kalhana hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Kalhana - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which three rival dynasties engaged in the centuries-long 'Tripartite Struggle' for control over the city of Kanauj?
qh: गंगा घाटी में स्थित 'कन्नौज' शहर पर नियंत्रण के लिए किन तीन पक्षों के बीच 'त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष' (Tripartite Struggle) हुआ?
e: Ganga valley ke fertile Kanauj trade center par supremacy ke liye Gurjara-Pratiharas (West), Palas (East) aur Rashtrakutas (Deccan) centuries tak aapas me ladte rahe. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki ganga ghati mein sthit 'kannauj' shahar par niyantran ke lie kin tin pakshon ke bich 'tripakshiy sangharsh' (Tripartite Struggle) hua? Isi karan se Gurjara-Pratiharas, Rashtrakutas, and Palas sahi uttar hai. Mauryas, Guptas, and Kushanas, Cholas, Cheras, and Pandyas, Mughals, Marathas, and Sikhs in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Gurjara-Pratiharas, Rashtrakutas, and Palas hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Gurjara-Pratiharas, Rashtrakutas, and Palas - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which wealthy Gujarat temple along the Arabian Sea was repeatedly plundered by Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni?
qh: अफगानिस्तान के सुल्तान महमूद गजनी ने भारत के किस प्रसिद्ध मंदिर पर 17 बार आक्रमण कर उसकी संपत्ति लूटी?
e: Mahmud of Ghazni ne 1025-26 CE me coastal Gujarat ke rich Somnath temple ko raid karke immense gold aur wealth plunder ki. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki aphaganistan ke sultan mahamud gajani ne bharat ke kis prasiddh mandir par 17 bar akraman kar usaki sanpatti luti? Isi baat se Somnath Temple sahi sabit hota hai. Sun Temple of Konark, Khajuraho Temple, Meenakshi Temple anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Somnath Temple hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Somnath Temple - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which court scholar was commissioned by Mahmud of Ghazni to author an account of India, resulting in the 'Kitab-al-Hind'?
qh: महमूद गजनी ने किस विद्वान को उपमहाद्वीप का लेखा-जोखा लिखने का काम सौंपा था, जिसने 'किताब-उल-हिंद' लिखी?
e: Al-Biruni ne Sanskrit seekhkar Indian texts ka study kiya aur Ghazni ke command par comprehensive Arabic text 'Kitab-al-Hind' likha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mahamud gajani ne kis vidvan ko upamahadvip ka lekha-jokha likhane ka kam saunpa tha, jisane 'kitab-ul-hind' likhi? Isi aadhar par Al-Biruni chuna jaata hai. Amir Khusrau, Firdausi, Ibn Battuta ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Al-Biruni hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Al-Biruni - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Afghan Sultan defeated the Chahamana ruler Prithviraj III at the historic Second Battle of Tarain in 1192?
qh: तराइन के युद्ध (1191 और 1192) में पृथ्वीराज तृतीय का मुकाबला किस अफगान शासक से हुआ था?
e: 1191 me First Battle of Tarain me Prithviraj Chauhan jeete, lekin 1192 me Second Battle me Muhammad Ghori ne unhe defeat kiya jisse Sultanate rule ki neenv padi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki tarain ke yuddh (1191 aur 1192) mein prithviraj tritiy ka mukabala kis aphagan shasak se hua tha? Isi aadhar par Mu'izz al-Din Muhammad Ghori chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - Genghis Khan, Mahmud of Ghazni, Babur - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Mu'izz al-Din Muhammad Ghori baithta hai. Exam point: Mu'izz al-Din Muhammad Ghori - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which ancient Chola chieftain captured the Kaveri Delta from the Muttaraiyar and founded Thanjavur in the 9th century?
qh: उरैयूर के प्राचीन चोल परिवार के 'विजयालय' ने 9वीं सदी के मध्य में मुत्तरैयार को हराकर किस शहर पर कब्जा किया?
e: Vijayalaya ne 850 CE me Muttaraiyar chiefs ko defeat karke Thanjavur capture kiya aur Imperial Chola dynasty ki foundation rakhi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki uraiyur ke prachin chol parivar ke 'vijayalay' ne 9vin sadi ke madhy mein muttaraiyar ko harakar kis shahar par kabja kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Thanjavur sahi nikalta hai. Mysore, Kanchipuram, Madurai in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Thanjavur baithta hai. Exam point: Thanjavur - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who ascended the throne in 985 CE as the greatest imperial consolidator and reformer of the Chola Empire?
qh: चोल वंश का सबसे शक्तिशाली शासक किसे माना जाता है, जो 985 ईस्वी में राजा बना?
e: Rajaraja I (985-1014 CE) ne Chola navy organize ki, administrative land surveys conduct karwaye aur Thanjavur ka grand temple banwaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki chol vansh ka sabase shaktishali shasak kise mana jata hai, jo 985 isvi mein raja bana? Isi baat se Rajaraja I sahi sabit hota hai. Vijayalaya, Rajendra I, Aditya I is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Rajaraja I hi milti hai. Exam point: Rajaraja I - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which military branch was extensively expanded by Rajendra I to launch overseas naval expeditions to Srivijaya and the Ganges?
qh: चोल शासक राजेंद्र प्रथम ने गंगा घाटी, श्रीलंका और दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया के देशों पर विजय के बाद कौन सी नौसेना विकसित की थी?
e: Rajendra I ne powerful Chola Navy use karke Bay of Bengal cross kiya, Srivijaya (Sumatra/Malay) ko raid kiya aur 'Gangaikonda Chola' title liya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki chol shasak rajeindr pratham ne ganga ghati, shrilanka aur dakshin-purv eshiya ke deshon par vijay ke bad kaun si nausena vikasit ki thi? In tathyon ke chalte Imperial Maritime Navy hi sahi hai. Siege artillery corps, Foreign mounted archers, Heavy elephant cavalry ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Imperial Maritime Navy baithta hai. Exam point: Imperial Maritime Navy - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In Chola society, beyond functioning as sanctums of worship, what broader role did temples play?
qh: चोल काल के मंदिर केवल पूजा के स्थान नहीं थे, बल्कि वे किस चीज के केंद्र भी थे?
o: Nuclei of civic, economic, craft production, and cultural life
e: Chola temples large landholders, major employers, banks aur bronze casting jaise craft industries ke central economic hubs the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki chol kal ke mandir keval puja ke sthan nahin the, balki ve kis chij ke keindr bhi the? Isi karan se Nuclei of civic, economic, craft production, and cultural life sahi uttar hai. Galti Foreign merchant encampments, Isolated monastic retreats, Restricted royal bunkers chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Nuclei of civic, economic, craft production, and... hai. Exam point: Nuclei of civic, economic, craft production, and... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In the administrative hierarchy of the Chola Empire, what were individual peasant settlements termed?
qh: चोल प्रशासन में किसानों की बस्तियों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Common non-brahmanical peasants (Vellalar) ki agricultural village settlements ko 'Ur' kaha jata tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki chol prashasan mein kisanon ki bastiyon ko kya kaha jata tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isliye antim jawab Ur ke roop mein milta hai. Sabha, Nadu, Brahmadeya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Ur hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Ur - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was an administrative cluster or grouping of multiple villages called in the Chola governance system?
qh: चोल काल में गाँवों के समूह को क्या कहा जाता था, जो न्याय करने और कर वसूलने जैसे कार्य करते थे?
e: Multiple 'Ur' villages milkar larger administrative unit 'Nadu' banate the jo justice aur revenue collection functions manage karti thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki chol kal mein ganvon ke samuh ko kya kaha jata tha, jo nyay karane aur kar vasulane jaise kary karate the? Isi karan se Nadu sahi uttar hai. Galti Mandalam, Nagaram, Pattinam chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Nadu hai. Exam point: Nadu - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under the Chola land classification system, what was 'Shalabhoga' land?
qh: चोल अभिलेखों के अनुसार 'शालाभोग' (Shalabhoga) किस प्रकार की भूमि को कहा जाता था?
o: Tax-free land allotted to learned Brahmins
Land granted for the maintenance and upkeep of a school
Land gifted directly to temple deities
e: Chola inscriptions me school ke maintenance aur running ke liye reserved land ko 'Shalabhoga' kaha gaya hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki chol abhilekhon ke anusar 'shalabhog' (Shalabhoga) kis prakar ki bhumi ko kaha jata tha? Isi tathya par Land granted for the maintenance and upkeep... tika hua hai. Tax-free land allotted to learned Brahmins, Common pasture land, Land gifted directly to temple deities ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Land granted for the maintenance and upkeep of a school baithta hai. Exam point: Land granted for the maintenance and upkeep of a school - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: According to the Uttaramerur inscriptions, how were members of the governing committees of the village Sabha elected?
qh: उत्तरमेरुर (तमिलनाडु) के शिलालेख के अनुसार सभा (Sabha) की समितियों के सदस्यों का चुनाव किस पद्धति से किया जाता था?
o: Direct royal appointment by the monarch
Lottery/Ticket selection (Kuduvalai system using palm leaves drawn from an earthen pot)
e: Uttaramerur inscription batata hai ki eligible candidates ke naam palm leaf tickets par likhkar pot me daale jaate the aur chota bacha draw karta tha (Kuduvalai system). Prashn ka saar yah hai ki uttaramerur (tamilanadu) ke shilalekh ke anusar sabha (Sabha) ki samitiyon ke sadasyon ka chunav kis paddhati se kiya jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Lottery/Ticket selection (Kuduvalai system using palm leaves drawn from an earthen pot) hi sahi baithta hai. Exclusive election by wealthy guilds, Strict hereditary lineage succession, Direct royal appointment by the monarch is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Lottery/Ticket selection (Kuduvalai system using palm leaves drawn from an earthen pot) hi milti hai. Exam point: Lottery/Ticket selection (Kuduvalai system using palm leaves drawn from an earthen pot) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What unusual geographical orientation was depicted in the 1154 CE world map drawn by Arab cartographer Al-Idrisi?
qh: 1154 ईस्वी में अरब भूगोलवेत्ता अल-इदरीसी ने जो मानचित्र बनाया था, उसमें आधुनिक मानचित्र की तुलना में क्या प्रमुख अंतर था?
o: The map was rendered as a flat disc
South India was placed at the top and Sri Lanka was oriented towards the north
e: Al-Idrisi ke map me South direction upar top par thi aur North niche, isliye South India upar aur Sri Lanka island top par dikhaya gaya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1154 isvi mein arab bhugolavetta al-idarisi ne jo manachitr banaya tha, usamein adhunik manachitr ki tulana mein kya pramukh antar tha? Isliye antim jawab South India was placed at the top... ke roop mein milta hai. Rivers were omitted entirely, The map was rendered as a flat disc, The Indian subcontinent was omitted is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar South India was placed at the top... hi hai. Exam point: South India was placed at the top and Sri Lanka was oriented towards the north - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In the 13th century, for which geographical territory did chronicler Minhaj-i-Siraj apply the term 'Hindustan'?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'हिंदुस्तान' शब्द का प्रयोग 13वीं शताब्दी में मिन्हाज-ए-सिराज ने किन क्षेत्रों के लिए किया था?
o: The Punjab, Haryana, and the agricultural lands between the Ganga and Yamuna
e: Minhaj-i-Siraj ne 'Hindustan' political sense me un lands ke liye use kiya jo Delhi Sultan ke territorial domain me aati thi (Punjab, Haryana, Ganga-Yamuna doab). Prashn ka saar yah hai ki madhyakal mein 'hindustan' shabd ka prayog 13vin shatabdi mein minhaj-e-siraj ne kin kshetron ke lie kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja The Punjab, Haryana, and the agricultural lands between the Ganga and Yamuna nikalta hai. The entire peninsular South India, Modern Pakistani territory alone, Only deltaic Bengal and Bihar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav The Punjab, Haryana, and the agricultural lands between the Ganga and Yamuna hi thehrta hai. Exam point: The Punjab, Haryana, and the agricultural lands... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In what comprehensive ecological and cultural context did Babur employ the term 'Hindustan' in his 16th-century memoirs?
qh: 16वीं शताब्दी में बाबर ने 'हिंदुस्तान' शब्द का प्रयोग किस संदर्भ में किया था?
o: To describe the geography, fauna, flora, and customs of the subcontinent's inhabitants
To describe an Islamic political nation
Exclusively for the walled city of Delhi
e: Babur ne 'Hindustan' term subcontinent ke overall geography, natural vegetation, animals aur local people ke lifestyle ko describe karne ke liye use kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 16vin shatabdi mein babar ne 'hindustan' shabd ka prayog kis sandarbh mein kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par To describe the geography, fauna, flora, and... sahi nikalta hai. To describe an Islamic political nation, Exclusively for the walled city of Delhi, To denote anti-colonial unity alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan To describe the geography, fauna, flora, and customs of the subcontinent's inhabitants hi milti hai. Exam point: To describe the geography, fauna, flora, and customs of the subcontinent's inhabitants - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What did the term 'Foreigner' (Pardesi / Ajnabi) convey in medieval village society?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'विदेशी' (Foreigner) शब्द का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Someone hailing from outside the borders of India
Any stranger who appeared in a village and was not part of that local society or culture
e: Medieval period me 'Foreigner' (pardesi) ka matlab desh ke bahar ka vyakti nahi tha; ek gaon ke liye padosi gaon ka koi bhi unknown stranger pardesi hota tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki madhyakal mein 'videshi' (Foreigner) shabd ka kya arth tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Any stranger who appeared in a village and was not part of that local society or culture nikalta hai. Someone who spoke English, Someone hailing from outside the borders of India, An ordained foreign merchant alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Any stranger who appeared in a village... hi milti hai. Exam point: Any stranger who appeared in a village and was not part of that local society or culture - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which primary historical source expanded massively for historians studying the medieval period due to cheaper paper?
qh: इतिहासकारों के लिए मध्यकाल की जानकारी का सबसे प्रमुख और बढ़ता हुआ स्रोत कौन सा बन गया था?
o: Textual records and manuscripts written on paper
e: Paper ka manufacturing cheap aur widely available hone ke chalte chronicles, holy texts, letters aur accounts jaise Textual Records exponentially badh gaye. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki itihasakaron ke lie madhyakal ki janakari ka sabase pramukh aur badhata hua srot kaun sa ban gaya tha? Isi tathya par Textual records and manuscripts written on paper tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - Epigraphic stone pillar steles, Numismatic coin hoards, Prehistoric cave murals - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Textual records and manuscripts written on paper hi milti hai. Exam point: Textual records and manuscripts written on paper - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Before the invention of mechanical printing, what were the professional copyists who handwrote manuscripts called?
qh: पाण्डुलिपियों (Manuscripts) की नकल करने वाले 'नकलनीस' या 'लिपिक' को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Printing press na hone ki wajah se learned copyists haath se manuscripts copy karte the jinhe 'Scribes' ya 'Katib' kaha jata tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki pandulipiyon (Manuscripts) ki nakal karane vale 'nakalanis' ya 'lipik' ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi baat se Scribes (Katibs / Naql-navis) sahi sabit hota hai. Illuminators, Engravers, Archivists anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Scribes (Katibs / Naql-navis) hi milti hai. Exam point: Scribes (Katibs / Naql-navis) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the cumulative textual consequence of scribes introducing small scribal errors while hand-copying manuscripts over centuries?
qh: हाथ से नकल करते समय लिपिकों (Scribes) द्वारा किए गए छोटे-छोटे बदलावों का क्या परिणाम हुआ?
o: Texts remained identical to the original
Different handwritten copies of the same text developed substantial variations over time
e: Continuous hand copying me words aur sentences alter hote gaye, jisse centuries baad same book ke alag-alag manuscript versions me substantial differences aa gaye. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki hath se nakal karate samay lipikon (Scribes) dvara kie gae chhote-chhote badalavon ka kya parinam hua? Yahi wajah hai ki Different handwritten copies of the same text developed substantial variations over time sahi hai. Original authors were forgotten, Languages became simplified, Texts remained identical to the original is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Different handwritten copies of the same text developed substantial variations over time hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Different handwritten copies of the same text developed substantial variations over time - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the 14th-century chronicler Ziyauddin Barani complete his first version of the 'Tarikh-i Firuz Shahi'?
qh: 14वीं सदी के इतिहासकार जियाउद्दीन बरनी ने अपना पहला वृत्तांत (Chronicle) कब लिखा था?
e: Barani ne apna first historical chronicle 1356 CE me likha aur iska second revised version 1358 me nikala, jo 1960s tak historians ko pata nahi tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 14vin sadi ke itihasakar jiyauddin barani ne apana pahala vrittant (Chronicle) kab likha tha? Yahi wajah hai ki 1356 CE sahi hai. 1400 CE, 1346 CE, 1358 CE in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar 1356 CE hai. Exam point: 1356 CE - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which hydraulic innovation transformed agricultural irrigation in medieval India?
qh: मध्यकाल के दौरान सिंचाई के क्षेत्र में किस नई तकनीक का प्रयोग शुरू हुआ?
e: Persian wheel (Rahat) geared mechanism tha jisse draught animals use karke deep wells se continuously water lift kiya jata tha, transforming irrigation. Prashn yah batata hai ki madhyakal ke dauran sinchai ke kshetr mein kis nai takanik ka prayog shuru hua? Isi aadhar par Persian Wheel (Saqiya / Rahat) chuna jaata hai. Electric tubewells, Brick canals, Sprinkler nozzles anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Persian Wheel (Saqiya / Rahat) hai. Exam point: Persian Wheel (Saqiya / Rahat) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: During the period 700-1750 CE, to which martial group claiming Kshatriya status did the term 'Rajput' apply?
qh: 700 से 1750 ईस्वी के बीच 'राजपूत' शब्द का महत्व किस समूह के लिए बढ़ा?
o: A collective class of warriors and chieftains claiming Kshatriya descent
e: 'Rajaputra' (son of a king) se derive hua Rajput term 8th-14th century me chivalric warrior class ke liye use hone laga jo heroic martial codes follow karte the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 700 se 1750 isvi ke bich 'rajaput' shabd ka mahatv kis samuh ke lie badha? Yahi wajah hai ki A collective class of warriors and chieftains claiming Kshatriya descent sahi hai. Brahmin administrators, Peasant cultivators, Monarchs exclusively is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar A collective class of warriors and chieftains... hi hai. Exam point: A collective class of warriors and chieftains... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why were many forest-dwelling tribes (Vanavasis) compelled to migrate or become settled agrarian peasants during the medieval era?
qh: जंगलों की कटाई के कारण किन लोगों को अपना निवास स्थान छोड़ना पड़ा और वे किसान बन गए?
o: Forest clearance for agricultural expansion disrupted their natural habitat
e: Population badhne se kings ne forests clear karwake agriculture extend kiya, jisse forest dwellers ka habitat khatam hua aur unhe settled peasantry adopt karni padi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki jangalon ki katai ke karan kin logon ko apana nivas sthan chhodana pada aur ve kisan ban gae? Isi tathya par Forest clearance for agricultural expansion disrupted their... tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - Mandatory military service, To conduct mercantile trade, To build urban cathedrals - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Forest clearance for agricultural expansion disrupted their natural habitat sahi hai. Exam point: Forest clearance for agricultural expansion disrupted their natural habitat - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Into what sub-caste social rankings were individuals grouped based on lineage, occupation, and wealth in medieval India?
qh: समाज में बढ़ते अंतर के कारण लोग किन समूहों में बँटने लगे, जिनकी अपनी रस्में और नियम थे?
e: Complex social division me 4 broad varnas ke andar hazaro 'Jatis' (sub-castes) bani jinki social status region aur occupation ke hisaab se vary karti thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki samaj mein badhate antar ke karan log kin samuhon mein bantane lage, jinaki apani rasmein aur niyam the? Isi tathya par Jatis (Sub-castes) tika hua hai. Parties, Guilds, Nations anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Jatis (Sub-castes) hi hai. Exam point: Jatis (Sub-castes) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the governing responsibility of the rural 'Jati Panchayat' in medieval society?
qh: 'जाति पंचायत' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Enforcing internal behavioral conduct, marriage rules, and customs of its community members
e: Jati Panchayat caste elders ki council hoti thi jo apne jati members ke social behavior, marriage customs aur moral codes ko enforce karti thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 'jati panchayat' ka mukhy kary kya tha? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi tathya par Enforcing internal behavioral conduct, marriage rules, and... tika hua hai. Collecting crown customs taxes, Founding temples, Waging offensive wars is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Enforcing internal behavioral conduct, marriage rules, and customs of its community members hai. Exam point: Enforcing internal behavioral conduct, marriage rules, and customs of its community members - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to a hyperbolic Sanskrit eulogy (Prashasti), Sultan Ghiyasuddin Balban's empire stretched across which vast territories?
qh: गयासुद्दीन बलबन की संस्कृत प्रशस्ति के अनुसार, उसका साम्राज्य कहाँ से कहाँ तक फैला था?
o: From Gauda (Bengal) in the east to Ghazni (Gajjana in Afghanistan) in the west
e: Sanskrit Prashasti me court poet ne claim kiya ki Balban ka empire east me Gauda (Bengal) se lekar west me Gajjana (Ghazni, Afghanistan) tak faila tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gayasuddin balaban ki sanskrit prashasti ke anusar, usaka samrajy kahan se kahan tak phaila tha? In tathyon ke chalte From Gauda (Bengal) in the east to Ghazni (Gajjana in Afghanistan) in the west hi sahi hai. From Gujarat to Assam, From Kashmir to Kanyakumari, Delhi alone is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar From Gauda (Bengal) in the east to Ghazni (Gajjana in Afghanistan) in the west hi hai. Exam point: From Gauda (Bengal) in the east to Ghazni (Gajjana in Afghanistan) in the west - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which theological and cultural developments characterized the transformation of Hinduism during the medieval period?
qh: मध्यकाल में हिंदू धर्म में आए प्रमुख परिवर्तनों में से कौन सा एक सही है?
o: Worship of new local deities, royal temple construction, and the rise of personal Bhakti
Total cessation of all temple building
e: Medieval period me local deities ko integrate kiya gaya, grand temple architecture build hui, Brahmin status rise hua aur direct personal Bhakti movement popular hua. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki madhyakal mein hindu dharm mein ae pramukh parivartanon mein se kaun sa ek sahi hai? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Isi tathya par Worship of new local deities, royal temple... tika hua hai. Total cessation of all temple building, Complete abandonment of Sanskrit, Eradication of the priestly order mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Worship of new local deities, royal temple construction, and the rise of personal Bhakti hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Worship of new local deities, royal temple construction, and the rise of personal Bhakti - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the foundational doctrinal schism that historically divided Shia and Sunni Muslims?
qh: इस्लाम धर्म में 'शिया' और 'सुन्नी' के बीच मुख्य मतभेद क्या था?
o: The authenticity of the Arabic Quran
The legitimate succession to Prophet Muhammad (Ali and the Imams vs. the early Caliphs)
e: Shia Muslims Prophet ke son-in-law Ali ko unka rightful divine successor maante the, jabki Sunni community early Caliphs (Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman) ki political authority accept karti thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki islam dharm mein 'shiya' aur 'sunni' ke bich mukhy matabhed kya tha? Isi karan se The legitimate succession to Prophet Muhammad (Ali and the Imams vs. the early Caliphs) sahi uttar hai. The daily direction of Mecca, The ritual of pilgrimage, The authenticity of the Arabic Quran alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan The legitimate succession to Prophet Muhammad (Ali and the Imams vs. the early Caliphs) hi milti hai. Exam point: The legitimate succession to Prophet Muhammad (Ali and the Imams vs. the early Caliphs) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Into which three periods did 19th-century British colonial historians (like James Mill) divide Indian history?
qh: ब्रिटिश इतिहासकारों ने भारतीय इतिहास को किन तीन कालखंडों में विभाजित किया था?
e: James Mill ne 1817 me rulers ke religion ke basis par Indian history ko 'Hindu Period', 'Muslim Period' aur 'British Period' me divide kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki british itihasakaron ne bharatiy itihas ko kin tin kalakhandon mein vibhajit kiya tha? Isliye antim jawab Hindu, Muslim, and British periods ke roop mein milta hai. Galti Primitive, Feudal, and Industrial, Ancient, Medieval, and Modern, Aryan, Dravidian, and European eras chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Hindu, Muslim, and British periods hai. Exam point: Hindu, Muslim, and British periods - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What critical structural defect marred the British periodization of Indian history into 'Hindu' and 'Muslim' periods?
qh: इतिहास में 'युगों' (Periods) का विभाजन करते समय ब्रिटिश इतिहासकारों ने किस महत्वपूर्ण पक्ष की अनदेखी की?
o: They reduced historical evolution solely to the religion of rulers, ignoring profound socio-economic transformations
e: Britishers ne sirf ruling monarch ke religion ko importance di aur hazaro saalo me hue deep economic, agrarian, cultural aur technological developments ko ignore kar diya. Prashn yah batata hai ki itihas mein 'yugon' (Periods) ka vibhajan karate samay british itihasakaron ne kis mahatvapurn paksh ki anadekhi ki? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par They reduced historical evolution solely to the religion of rulers, ignoring profound socio-economic transformations hi sahi baithta hai. They omitted dynastic family trees, They ignored battle dates, They focused on architecture alone anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan They reduced historical evolution solely to the religion of rulers, ignoring profound socio-economic transformations hi milti hai. Exam point: They reduced historical evolution solely to the religion of rulers, ignoring profound socio-economic transformations - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is an institutional repository where valuable historical manuscripts, charters, and state documents are preserved called?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'पाण्डुलिपियों' को सुरक्षित रखने के स्थान को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: State legal records, treaties, administrative registers aur manuscripts ko safely preserve karne wale place ko 'Archives' (Abhilekhagar) kehte hain. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki madhyakal mein 'pandulipiyon' ko surakshit rakhane ke sthan ko kya kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Archives (Abhilekhagar) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Monastery, Guildhall, Treasury chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Archives (Abhilekhagar) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Archives (Abhilekhagar) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What primarily motivated the unprecedented physical mobility of people and groups across the subcontinent between 700 and 1750 CE?
qh: 700 से 1750 ईस्वी के इन हजार वर्षों में 'मोबिलिटी' (Mobility) बढ़ने का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: The pursuit of abundant agricultural wealth, territorial frontiers, and fortune-building opportunities
e: Indian subcontinent me immense land resources, fertile soil aur wealth thi, isliye groups (jaise Rajputs, pastoralists, traders) fortunes banane ke liye continuously travel karte the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 700 se 1750 isvi ke in hajar varshon mein 'mobiliti' (Mobility) badhane ka mukhy karan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par The pursuit of abundant agricultural wealth, territorial... sahi nikalta hai. Modern leisure tourism, Attending single scholastic universities, Purely royal diplomatic embassies is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar The pursuit of abundant agricultural wealth, territorial... hi hai. Exam point: The pursuit of abundant agricultural wealth, territorial frontiers, and fortune-building opportunities - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.
